title: Mayflower Guild Cook Book (1930)
compiler: Mayflower Guild of First Congregational Church, Kalamazoo, Michigan

recipes.title: BREAD PUDDING
directions: Soak bread crumbs in milk. When cool add sugar, slightly beaten eggs, salt and flavoring. Bake in moderate oven about 1 hour or until set and firm.
**Variations:**
1. Use brown sugar.
2. Caramelize 1/3 cup sugar, add milk and scald. When smooth proceed as given.
3. Melt 2 squares of chocolate. Add milk and scald.
4. Add 1/2 cup raisins and 1/2 cup currants.
5. Save one egg white. When pudding is baked spread with jelly and meringue and brown.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE CORNSTARCH PUDDING
directions: Mix cornstarch, cocoa, sugar and salt with a little cold milk (1/4 cup). Add to scalded milk in top part of double boiler. Stir constantly until thick. Cover and cook ½ hour. Add vanilla and put in molds.

recipes.title: CORNSTARCH PUDDING
directions: Mix cornstarch, sugar, and salt with cold milk. Add to hot milk and stir until thick. Cover and cook ½ hour. Add vanilla and put in molds in a cool place.
**To vary:**
Color half the pudding pink, or other desired color with vegetable coloring. Or all of the pudding may be colored. Flavor with orange, lemon, maple or strawberry flavoring.

recipes.title: STEAMED CUSTARD
directions: Beat eggs, add sugar, salt and vanilla; beat well. Then add hot milk slowly. Place in glass bowl or other serving dish. Add a little grated nutmeg. Steam about 10 minutes or until mixture is thick in center. Serves four. Fine for children.

recipes.title: MACARONI WITH CARROTS AND EGGS
directions: Boil macaroni. Drain. Slice eggs. Put ingredients by layers into a casserole. Top with fine crumbs. Bake in moderate oven until crumbs are brown. Time in combining, 5 minutes. Time in cooking, 20 minutes. Temperature, 350 degrees. Recipe makes four servings.

recipes.title: CHILDREN'S SALAD
directions: Put all through grinder and mix with a very little dressing. Serves 3 to 5. Increase as desired.

recipes.title: CREAM OF SPINACH SOUP
directions: Put water in kettle and when boiling add washed spinach. Cook uncovered until tender. Rub through a ricer. Make white sauce, season and add spinach. Reheat and serve.

recipes.title: VEGETABLE SANDWICHES
ingredients: 1 carrot, turnip, or small handful shredded cabbage
directions: Grind 1 carrot, or turnip, or a little cabbage, and mix with a little cream cheese and spread on whole wheat bread. Very hearty for school lunches.

recipes.title: CHILDREN'S RAISIN CANDY
ingredients: enough boiling water to mix stiff
directions: Take a little of the mixture on the end of a spoon and form into a ball, taking 2 raisins to each ball and press together until nearly flat. If white candy is preferred, omit cocoa.

recipes.title: CARAMEL MILK
directions: Caramelize half the sugar. Add boiling water. When smooth add remaining sugar and milk. Serve hot or very cold. Serves one. (To caramelize sugar, place it in an iron or aluminum spider. Heat it slowly stirring constantly until sugar melts. )

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE EGG AND MILK SHAKE
directions: Put ingredients in glass and shake thoroughly (using one of the shakers that may be bought at any kitchen furnishing store), and strain into another glass for serving. A few gratings of nutmeg or a few sprinklings of cinnamon may be placed on top. The ice may be omitted if the ingredients have been thoroughly chilled in the ice box.

recipes.title: GINGER ALE SODA
ingredients: 1 large tbsp. vanilla ice cream in each glass.
directions: Fill glass with ice cold ginger ale. Stir until frothy. Serve at once.

recipes.title: GRAPE JUICE
directions: Put in quart jar and fill with boiling water. Seal. Let stand until after the Holidays.

recipes.title: HOT CHOCOLATE
directions: Place in double boiler until chocolate melts, then whip with dover eggbeater.

recipes.title: ICED COCOA
directions: Mix dry ingredients in top of double boiler, add boiling water. Cook until smooth, cool and add vanilla. Put 2 tbsp. in glass with cracked ice and fill glass with milk.

recipes.title: ICED TEA
ingredients: Ginger ale, half as much as the tea
directions: Place mint in the bottom of a pitcher, pour hot tea over it, then add half as much ginger ale as tea. Serve over ice.

recipes.title: ICED TEA WITH GINGER ALE
directions: Pour the tea over the cracked ice, and when thoroughly chilled add ginger ale. Serve with sugared lemon slices, made by covering the thin slices with sugar and allowing them to stand until syrupy.

recipes.title: MINT GINGER
directions: Rub mint leaves and sugar together until well mixed, and add lemon juice and orange juice. Allow to stand at least 15 minutes in a cold place. Strain, add ginger ale and pour into glasses a third full of crushed ice. Garnish each glass with a sprig of mint and a half slice of lemon.

recipes.title: ORANGE GRAPE JUICE PUNCH
directions: Stir the sugar into the orange and lemon juices until dissolved. Add grape juice and chilled water. Pour into glasses containing half an orange slice, one cherry and a small piece of ice.

recipes.title: ORIENTAL PUNCH
directions: Slice lemons through rind and pulp. Put with cloves and sugar in pitcher or bowl and pour hot tea over them. Cover and let stand until chilled. Add orange and grape juice and serve, iced.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLEADE
directions: Boil the sugar and 1 cup water for ten minutes. Add ingredients as given. Serve iced. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: SPICED BLOCKS
directions: Put in a small sauce pan the water and sugar and bring to the boiling point. When the sugar is dissolved add the cloves and cinnamon and boil 10 minutes. Add juice of lemons and water. Strain through fine strainer into mold and put in glasses with cubes of ice.

recipes.title: SOFT DRINK
directions: Mix, fill glasses half full of ice, add sprig of mint.

recipes.title: VARSITY PUNCH
directions: Boil sugar and water 3 minutes and chill. Add fruit juices and crushed pineapple and pour over ice in pitcher or glasses.

recipes.title: WATERMELON QUENCHER
directions: Crush watermelon pulp. Add strained lemon and orange juice and water. Let stand 4 hours; strain. Stir in sugar until dissolved and serve.

recipes.title: SOUR MILK GRIDDLE CAKES
directions: Mix above ingredients in order given, and add enough flour for a smooth batter. Bake on a hot and well greased griddle.

recipes.title: GRIDDLE CAKES
directions: Sift dry ingredients, add milk and eggs, beat well, add melted butter. Bake on an ungreased aluminum griddle or on a greased griddle iron. Huckleberries or corn may be added. For waffles add more butter. Serves six.

recipes.title: WAFFLES
directions: Beat yolks, add salt and milk. Add baking powder and flour, which have been sifted together twice. Add melted butter. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Makes ten waffles.

recipes.title: WAFFLES
directions: Beat eggs separately. To the yolks add milk and sifted dry ingredients and melted butter. Fold in beaten egg whites. Sour milk may be substituted for sweet in which case add ½ tsp. soda.

recipes.title: WAFFLES
directions: Sift together the dry ingredients. Add the egg yolks, beaten and mixed with the milk, then the melted butter. Fold in the egg whites beaten stiff. Have both sides of the waffle iron hot and well greased. Put a tablespoon of the mixture in each compartment and let down the top. When the mixture is baked on one side, turn the iron to brown the other side. Remove the cooked waffles with a fork. Serve with butter and syrup.

recipes.title: WAFFLES ( WITH ELECTRIC IRON)
directions: Sift dry ingredients together, then add melted butter, milk and yolks which have been beaten. Stir until batter is evenly formed. Beat whites of eggs to a stiff froth and add last. Bake in electric waffle iron.

recipes.title: DELICIOUS WAFFLES
ingredients: ½ cup butter, melted and slightly cooled
directions: Whisk flour, baking powder, salt and sugar. Beat egg yolks with milk, then stir into dry ingredients. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites and finally the melted, cooled butter. Bake in a thoroughly heated waffle iron until golden and crisp.

recipes.title: EXCELLENT WAFFLES
directions: Mix dry ingredients, add milk, butter, and egg yolks. Fold in whites just before baking.

recipes.title: WAFFLES, EASY
ingredients: 1 heaping tsp. baking soda, stirred into milk
Flour, enough to make a thin batter
directions: Try a little batter in the waffle iron.

recipes.title: UNIVERSAL WAFFLE RECIPE
directions: Sift dry ingredients into mixing bowl. Beat yolks of eggs well; add milk, and beat well, adding this to dry ingredients, slowly, beating until smooth. Add 4 tbsp. melted butter, and fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.

recipes.title: ICE BOX BISCUITS
directions: Pour boiling water over lard. When melted add cold water, beaten eggs and sugar. Dissolve cakes of yeast in lukewarm water, and add to first mixture. Add salt and flour. Put in ice box over night. When ready to use pinch off piece the size of a walnut. Roll in melted butter. Put 3 in each muffin tin. Let stand 2½ hours. Bakes at 400 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes. Dough will keep a week, at least.

recipes.title: BAKING POWDER BISCUIT
ingredients: milk enough for a soft dough
directions: Mix in order given. Roll out lightly to ½ inch thick, and cut with biscuit cutter. Place in greased pan, and bake for 15 minutes at 450 degrees.

recipes.title: BAKING POWDER BISCUIT
directions: Sift dry ingredients; rub in fat with tip of fingers; add milk to make soft dough and toss on well floured board roll to one inch thick and cut. Bake 10 or 15 minutes.

recipes.title: BAKING POWDER BISCUITS
directions: Sift dry ingredients three times, and mix in lard well. Add milk. Flour board well. Roll out dough and cut. Bake at 400 degrees about twelve minutes. This makes about fifteen medium sized biscuits.

recipes.title: CHEESE BISCUITS
directions: Mix dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Add grated cheese and then milk. Roll ½" thick and cut with small cutter. Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: COFFEE CAKE
directions: Save out a small portion of the butter and sugar. Mix the rest of the ingredients in the manner of a muffin recipe. Bake in a shallow, square pan. When done and still hot, sprinkle butter, sugar and cinnamon over the top and put back in oven for about 5 minutes. Will serve 4.

recipes.title: GERMAN COFFEE CAKE
directions: Sift dry ingredients together, rub in butter. Beat egg, add milk to egg to make 1¼ cups, stir all together. Turn into biscuit pan, and spread evenly. Brush top with melted butter. Bake at 400 degrees for about fifteen minutes. Sprinkle top with sugar and cinnamon.

recipes.title: SHORT CAKE SOUR MILK
directions: Mix well. Add enough sour milk to make a stiff dough. Bake in greased pans in a hot oven, 425 degrees for fifteen minutes.

recipes.title: SHORT CAKE - SWEET MILK
directions: Combine flour, baking powder and sugar. Cut in lard until crumbly, then add enough milk to form a stiff dough. Pat into greased shallow pans and bake at 450°F for about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: GINGER BREAD
ingredients: 1 tsp. soda in 1 tbsp. hot water
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add egg and flour. Add molasses mixed with soda and tsp. hot water. Last add spices and 1/3 cup of hot water. Beat well. Bake about 25 minutes in medium oven.

recipes.title: GINGER BREAD
ingredients: 2 tsp. soda, dissolved in hot water
2 eggs, well beaten (specified in printed directions)
directions: Add 2 well beaten eggs the last thing. Bake slowly in moderate oven. Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: GINGER BREAD
ingredients: ½ cup butter and lard mixed
½ tsp. soda dissolved in boiling water
directions: Put together in order given and bake in a quick oven. Nice for small family.

recipes.title: SOFT MOLASSES GINGERBREAD
directions: Put milk and molasses into mixing bowl. Sift and add all dry ingredients; beat vigorously; add melted butter. Bake in pan nine inches square, 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: GINGER CAKE
ingredients: 2 tsp. soda dissolved in 1 cup boiling water
directions: Add eggs, well beaten, the last thing before baking. Bake in a large square pan, 45 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: GINGERBREAD SOFT
ingredients: ½ cup hot water or ¾ cup sour milk
¼ tsp. soda with the sour milk
directions: Heat oven to 325°F and grease an 8-inch square pan. Cream shortening and sugar; beat in egg and molasses. Combine flour with cinnamon, ginger and salt. Stir in the dry mixture alternately with hot water, or use sour milk instead and dissolve baking soda in it. Spread in pan and bake 30–40 minutes, until center tests clean.

recipes.title: SOFT GINGER BREAD
directions: Mix in order given. Bake 45 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: SOFT GINGER BREAD
directions: Cream butter and molasses, add sugar, spices, eggs, then sour milk and soda dissolved in a little boiling water. Add flour and raisins if desired. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350 degrees in two medium sized loaf pans.

recipes.title: STEAMED BROWN BREAD
directions: Mix in order and half fill empty one pound baking powder cans. Steam three hours. This recipe may be divided in half.

recipes.title: BROWN BREAD
directions: Bake slowly 1¼ hours. This makes 3 loaves.

recipes.title: BROWN BREAD
directions: Mix in order given; let stand 1 hour and bake in slow oven about 1 hour. This makes 1 loaf. Nuts can be added if desired.

recipes.title: BROWN BREAD
directions: Mix and let stand in greased bread tin 20 minutes. Bake in a slow oven.

recipes.title: BOSTON STEAMED BROWN BREAD
directions: Mix all ingredients and then add graham flour to make a moderately stiff batter. Steam 3 hours in coffee cans.

recipes.title: BREAD, GRAPE NUTS
directions: Mix the first three ingredients (Grape-Nuts, milk, and sugar) and let stand ½ hour.

Add the egg, salt, flour, and baking powder; mix in order given. Put in tins and let stand 15 minutes. Bake at 325°F. When done, remove from tins and roll in a towel to soften and season. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: GRAPENUT BREAD
directions: Mix in order given. Put in 3 buttered coffee cans, with covers on. Bake 50 minutes at 325 degrees.

recipes.title: JOHNNY CAKE
directions: Mix in order given, beating soda into sour milk thoroughly, and sifting baking powder with flour. Bake at 425 degrees for fifteen minutes.

recipes.title: SPIDER CORN CAKE
ingredients: Soda (amount before tsp. illegible in scan; per cup of sour milk)
1 cup sweet milk and 1 cup sour milk, or 2 cups sour milk
directions: Mix together and put into a smoking-hot skillet in which 1 tsp. shortening has been melted. Spread 1 cup sweet milk over the top with a spoon and place in a hot oven.

recipes.title: CORN BREAD
directions: Mix and sift dry ingredients. Add rest as given. Bake in pan nine inches square. Bake 30 minutes at 400° or more.

recipes.title: DATE BREAD
ingredients: 1 package dates (about 8 oz.), pitted and chopped
directions: Heat oven to 325°F. Grease a 9 × 5-inch loaf pan. Beat eggs with brown sugar; stir in sour milk. Sift flour, salt and baking soda together. Combine wet and dry ingredients, fold in dates and walnuts and spread in the pan. Bake about 55–65 minutes, until a tester comes out clean. Cool before slicing.

recipes.title: DATE AND NUT BREAD
directions: Beat egg and sugar together, add butter. Over the cut dates sprinkle soda, then pour hot water over all. Then add flour, salt and nutmeats. Beat all well. Bake in one loaf or muffin tins. If baked in loaf, bake slowly for one hour at 300 degrees; in muffin tins at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: GRAHAM PRUNE BREAD
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan, or heat to 375°F for muffins. Mix bread flour, graham flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Beat egg with sugar, melted butter, sour milk and prune juice. Stir wet mixture into dry just until combined; fold in prunes and nuts. Bake a loaf about 60–85 minutes, until a tester comes out clean; for muffins bake about 18–25 minutes.

recipes.title: GRAHAM BREAD
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and grease two loaf pans. Whisk graham flour, white flour and baking soda. Mix egg, brown sugar, molasses, sour milk and melted fat; combine with dry ingredients without overmixing. Divide between pans and bake 40–55 minutes until set.

recipes.title: GRAHAM BREAD
ingredients: Graham flour, enough to make a stiff batter
directions: Mix in order given, using enough graham flour to make a stiff batter. Bake at 385 degrees, in loaf 35 minutes, in gems 10 to 15 . minutes.

recipes.title: NUT BREAD
directions: Sift dry ingredients, add nuts. Put milk and beaten egg together. Stir liquid ingredients into dry ingredients, and let rise for 20 minutes before putting into oven. Bake in loaf tin 1 hour at 325 °.

recipes.title: NUT BREAD
directions: Mix egg and milk and add sifted dry ingredients. Let stand 25 minutes. Bake in moderate oven 40 minutes or until done when tried with a straw.

recipes.title: NUT BREAD
directions: Mix ingredients in order given. Pour into two loaf pans, and bake in a moderate oven for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: NUT BREAD
directions: Sift flour before measuring. Sift flour, salt, sugar and baking powder together. Mix with whole wheat flour. Add milk slowly, then well beaten egg, beat well, and add chopped nuts. Put in well greased tin and let stand 20 minutes. Bake 1 hour in moderate oven, 350 degrees.

recipes.title: NUT BROWN BREAD
ingredients: 1 tsp. soda in 1½ cups sour milk
½ cup molasses filled up with sugar
directions: Mix in order given, and put in 2 coffee or 4 baking powder cans, uncovered. Bake 1½ hours at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: WHITE NUT BREAD
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Sift flour with baking powder, sugar and salt. Stir in milk and chopped nuts, mixing only until combined. Transfer to a greased 9 × 5-inch loaf pan and bake 40–50 minutes or until a tester comes out clean.

recipes.title: QUICK NUT BREAD
directions: Sift together well the first 4 ingredients. Add the well beaten egg to the milk, then add nutmeats cut fine and melted Crisco. Mix all together and bake one hour in moderate oven.

recipes.title: PEANUT BUTTER BREAD
directions: Sift dry ingredients together. Put shortening and peanut butter into dry ingredients. Add milk and eggs, beat well. Turn into a medium sized bread pan and bake for 1½ hours at 350 °.

recipes.title: PEANUT BUTTER BREAD
directions: Sift dry ingredients, work in peanut butter with fingers, add sugar, eggs and milk. Bake in bread tin 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: WHOLE WHEAT BREAD
directions: Cream shortening and sugar, add egg, molasses, and milk, unsifted wholewheat flour and rest of the dry ingredients sifted. Put in greased coffee cans half full and bake in moderae oven for about 50 minutes or until firm to the touch.

recipes.title: MUFFINS
directions: Mix ingredients in order given, drop into muffin pans, and bake at 375 degrees for about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: " MUFFINS FOR TWO "
ingredients: Milk to make a soft dough
directions: Bake moderately. Makes four large muffins.

recipes.title: BREAKFAST MUFFINS
directions: Sift dry ingredients. Beat egg until light, add milk and shortening, and add to dry ingredients. Bake 25 minutes at 325 degrees. Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
directions: If canned blueberries are used, have them well drained. Beat egg light with Dover egg beater, add sugar gradually. Then add butter and milk, then flour sifted with baking powder and salt, and then berries. Beat well. Should make 12 large muffins. Bake about 20 minutes at 425 degrees.

recipes.title: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
directions: Sift sugar, flour, baking powder and salt, add berries and mix. Add beaten egg, milk and butter. Bake in greased muffin tins in a quick oven about 20 minutes. 12 muffins.

recipes.title: 12 MINUTE BRAN BISCUIT
directions: Drop on large cookie tin and bake 12 minutes in quick oven.

recipes.title: CORN MEAL GEMS
directions: Sift dry ingredients, add sour milk and beaten egg. Bake 30 minutes at 400 degrees.

recipes.title: CORN MUFFINS
directions: Mix dry ingredients, add beaten eggs, milk and butter. Bake in greased muffin tins 20 minutes.

recipes.title: CORN MEAL MUFFINS OR JOHNNY CAKE
directions: Let corn meal and sour milk soak for an hour or more. Beat sugar and egg together, then add butter, then milk and corn meal. Then add flour to which has been added baking powder and soda, and salt. Beat well. Bake in a sheet pan for Johnny Cake, or muffin pans 20 minutes at 375 degrees.

recipes.title: DATE MUFFINS
directions: Cream butter, add beaten eggs, flour, in which baking powder and salt have been sifted, and milk. Stir in dates, which have been pitted and cut up in small pieces. Bake 25 minutes in greased muffin tin at 375 degrees. For sweet muffins sift 1/4 cup sugar with dry ingredients.

recipes.title: GRAHAM GEMS
directions: Mix dry ingredients, add milk, egg and melted butter. Bake in quick oven in heated greased muffin tins.

recipes.title: MARSHALL FIELD: POTATO FLOUR MUFFINS
directions: Keep the ingredients chilled. Beat egg whites with salt until stiff. Beat the yolks with sugar and fold into the whites. Sift potato flour with baking powder and fold gently into the egg mixture. Add ice water last. Spoon into greased muffin tins and bake 15–20 minutes in a moderate oven (about 350°F). Makes about 8 muffins.

recipes.title: PRUNE - NUT MUFFINS
ingredients: ½ cup cooked prunes, drained and cut up
directions: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, nut meats, and prunes. Add egg, melted fat, and milk. Mix quickly and drop into muffin tins. Bake in hot oven 20–25 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

recipes.title: POP - OVER MUFFINS
directions: Beat eggs light, add part of milk, all of flour, then rest of milk. Bake 20 minutes in a hot oven in gem pans. Makes 8 gems. Serve hot.

recipes.title: WHITE MUFFINS
ingredients: 1½ cups white bread flour (measured before sifting)
directions: Beat eggs light with Dover egg beater. Add sugar gradually, then butter and milk, then flour to which baking powder and salt have been added. Beat well. Bake at 425 degrees for about 20 minutes. Graham Muffins I make as above, substituting 1 cup graham flour for 1 cup of white flour.

recipes.title: DOUGHNUTS
directions: handle)

Beat egg, add sugar, then melted lard, and other ingredients in order given. Add flour gradually, using just enough to make a soft dough. Roll a small portion out on board, and cut with a doughnut cutter. Fry in deep Jewel Shortening or " Silverleaf" Lard.
**Variation: Roll dough ¼ inch thick. Cut in strips one inch**
wide and about two inches long. Wrap each strip around a date which has been stuffed with a pecan nutmeat, and fry in deep Jewel Shortening or " Silverleaf " Lard.

recipes.title: SOUR CREAM DOUGHNUTS
ingredients: ½ nutmeg (unit not given in source)
1 tsp. baking powder added to enough flour to make soft dough
directions: Put together in order named and add only enough flour to handle.

recipes.title: SWEET MILK DOUGHNUTS
directions: Mix in order given; mix just soft enough to handle, roll out and cut and fry in deep fat. This makes about 3½ dozen.

recipes.title: COCOANUT KISSES
directions: Moisten cocoanut, and fold into egg whites, adding cornflakes, sugar and vanilla to flavor. Drop on shallow tin and bake until crisp, 15 minutes at 375 degrees.

recipes.title: SOUR CREAM COCOANUT COOKIES
directions: Cream sugar and butter. Add other ingredients in order named, sifting in dry stuffs. Best rolled but can be dropped. If rolled use less flour and put some on board. Bake at 450 degrees.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients: About 3 doz. raisins, dredged in flour
directions: Cream sugar and butter, and add the beaten egg, milk and soda, and melted chocolate. Add 1½ cups flour, or enough to make a stiff batter. Broken nutmeats and raisins should be added last. Drop from teaspoon onto buttered pan. Bake in medium hot oven, about 375 degrees.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE DROP COOKIES
directions: Drop from tsp. and bake in moderate oven, 350 degrees, 15 minutes. Frost with chocolate frosting.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE COOKIES
directions: Melt chocolate, and add sugar. Mix and sift flour and baking powder. Add to first mixture. Beat eggs, butter and vanilla together, and add to first mixture, slowly beating well. Drop on greased and floured sheet. Bake in moderate oven 350 ° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE COOKIES
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add beaten egg, chocolate melted, milk and dry ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls on greased tin and bake in a moderate oven. Nuts, dates or raisins may be added.

recipes.title: DROP DATE COOKIES
directions: Melt butter or crisco, add brown sugar, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg. Then one beaten egg, ⅓ cup milk and oatmeal. Sift flour and baking powder together several times then add cup of chopped dates dredged in flour. Stir into batter. On greased pan drop good sized teaspoons of batter. Bake in moderate oven. Makes about 2 dozen.

recipes.title: QUICK DROP COOKIES
directions: Beat butter, egg and sugar. Add milk and dry ingredients. Beat well and drop from teaspoon on buttered baking dish. Bake 12 minutes in quick oven.

recipes.title: MOTHER'S JUMBLES
directions: Mix in order given, using enough flour to make batter stiff enough to drop from spoon.

recipes.title: FRUIT JUMBLES
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs and milk and sifted dry ingredients, and fruit. Drop by spoonfuls on greased pan and bake in a moderate oven.

recipes.title: LACE CAKES
directions: Beat eggs, add sugar and other ingredients. Drop a teaspoonful at a time on a greased tin and bake in a quick oven. Take from tin while still hot.

recipes.title: HUB COOKIES
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add part of flour, then eggs well beaten. Add raisins with remaining flour sifted over them. Add soda dissolved in a little warm water. Add salt and mix well at each step. Drop from a spoon and bake in a hot oven 375° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: NUT AND RAISIN CAKES
ingredients: 1 level tsp. soda dissolved in a
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs and milk, soda, flour, raisins and nuts. Drop from spoon on greased pan and bake slowly.

recipes.title: HERMITS
directions: Stir vinegar into milk and let stand about 5 minutes. Cream butter and brown sugar, beat in eggs and molasses. Sift flour with baking soda and spices. Stir dry ingredients into creamed mixture alternately with soured milk, then fold in raisins and nuts. Drop by spoonfuls on greased baking sheets and bake at 375°F for about 10–12 minutes, until lightly set.

recipes.title: HERMITS
directions: Mix in order given. Mix soft, and drop with teaspoon. Bake at 350 degrees, 15 minutes.

recipes.title: HERMITS
directions: Mix in order given. Drop in heaping teaspoonfuls on flat pans. Bake 15 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: ROLLED OATS CQOKIES
directions: Cream butter and sugar, and add eggs well beaten. Dissolve soda in milk and add to first mixture. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Drop from spoon onto a well greased and floured sheet. Bake in a hot oven 385 ° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients: ⅔ cup lard or vegetable shortening
½ tsp. ground cloves and nutmeg
directions: Dissolve baking soda in cold water. Cream shortening with sugar; beat in eggs. Stir in baking soda mixture. Fold in flour, oats, spices, salt, nuts and raisins to make a soft drop-cookie dough. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased baking sheets; bake at 375°F for about 10 minutes.

recipes.title: OATMEAL COOKIES
directions: Dissolve soda in molasses. Mix in order given. Drop from spoon and bake at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: OATMEAL DROP CAKES
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs, milk, oatmeal, nuts and dry ingredients sifted. Drop by spoonfuls on greased tin and bake in moderate oven.

recipes.title: OATMEAL COOKIES
directions: Mix ingredients in order given. Drop on tins and bake 10 minutes at 375 degrees.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE ROCKS
directions: Cream sugar and butter, add egg, melted butter, chocolate, milk and vanilla. Dissolve soda and add dry ingredients. Drop from spoon and bake at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: SCOTTISH FANCIES
directions: Beat egg until light, add sugar gradually, then stir in remaining ingredients. Drop by tsp. on greased sheet about 2 inches apart. Spread into circular shape with fork dipped in cold water. Bake at 350 degrees until brown.

recipes.title: ROCKS
ingredients: ½ cup nut meats and raisins
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs and dry ingredients sifted, nuts, raisins and vanilla. Drop from spoon on greased pan. Bake in moderate oven about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: SOUR CREAM COOKIES
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add egg and cream, mixing well. Sift dry ingredients, and add to mixture. Drop from a spoon and bake 15 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: COCOANUT COOKIES
directions: Mix in order given, roll and cut. Bake at 375 degrees about 10 minutes. Sugar may be sprinkled over top.

recipes.title: MOLASSES COOKIES
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add molasses. Stir soda into sour milk; sift ginger in with flour. Add milk and flour alternately to creamed mixture. Bake in hot oven about ten minutes at 375 °.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE DELIGHTS
directions: Beat eggs until creamy and add all ingredients beating.

recipes.title: MOLASSES GINGER COOKIES
directions: Cream sugar and shortening and add rest of the ingredients. Add enough sifted flour to roll out on board and cut with a cookie cutter. Bake on a greased pan in a moderate oven.

recipes.title: MOLASSES COOKIES
ingredients: Flour enough to make them stiff enough to roll thin
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add water, molasses, soda, salt and ginger and flour.

recipes.title: ORANGE COOKIES
directions: Cream shortening, add sugar gradually, and eggs well beaten. Add juice and grated rind of orange, and flour mixed and sifted with baking powder and salt. Roll thin, cut, and bake. Time in combining 25 minutes. Time for baking 15 minutes. Temperature 400 degrees. Recipe makes ten dozen small cookies.

recipes.title: RAISIN FILLED COOKIES
directions: Mix and cook until thick. For dough, cream butter and sugar, add milk and sifted dry ingredients with flour enough to make a dough that can be rolled out. Cut cookies and place 1 tsp. of filling on cookie and place another cookie on top and press edges together. Bake on greased pan in moderate oven.

recipes.title: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients: flour to make a dough to roll
directions: Cream butter and sugar, beat eggs until light, add to creamed mixture, beat well, add water and extract. To 1/2 cup sifted flour add baking powder and sift into other ingredients and beat until light. Add about 2 level cups of flour or enough for soft dough. Turn on to a floured board and knead lightly, roll out very thin and cut with cookie cutter and bake in a quick oven (400 ° ) for ten minutes. These cookies are as good at two weeks as when baked. One tsp. of crushed caraway seeds may be substituted for vanilla. Sufficient for 50 cookies. They are delicious when filled with the following filling: 12 package of dates, one cup black walnut meats, one cup sugar and one cup water, and two tbsp. flour. Mix flour, sugar, nuts and dates together, then add water and cook until thick. Let cool before putting between cookies. Chill dough before rolling.

recipes.title: SUGAR COOKIES
directions: Cream sugar and fat; beat in eggs and milk. Sift together flour as needed, soda, baking powder and nutmeg, and work in enough flour to make a soft rollable dough. Chill briefly, roll ¼ inch thick, cut into shapes and place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 375°F for about 12–15 minutes.

recipes.title: SOUR MILK COOKIES
directions: Beat eggs well, add sugar, and beat. Add lard, and continue beating. Sift dry ingredients together, and add. Cut out, and bake 12 minutes at 375 degrees.

recipes.title: BUTTERSCOTCH COOKIES
ingredients: 1 cup nuts or mixture of raisins
directions: Mix ingredients in order given, and let stand in icebox a few hours or over night. Slice thin and bake.

recipes.title: ICE BOX COOKIES
directions: Mix sugar, butter, eggs and add the dry ingredients sifted together. Add nuts. Make into a roll and place in icebox and when wanted slice into cookies and bake in moderate oven.

recipes.title: SLICED LOAF COOKIES
directions: Mix and shape in roll about 22 or 3 inches in diameter. Put in greased pan in ice box over night. When ready to bake, slice thin, and bake in hot oven.

recipes.title: ICE BOX COOKIES
ingredients: juice of ½ lemon or extract
directions: Mix; put in bread tin in icebox overnight. Slice off and bake.

recipes.title: BUTTER SCOTCH COOKIES
ingredients: 1 cup nuts or mixture of raisins
directions: Mix ingredients and let stand in ice-box over night or a few hours. Slice thin and bake.

recipes.title: ICE BOX COOKIES
directions: A “Leviathan” recipe. Pack in pan and put in refrigerator. Bake at pleasure.

recipes.title: ICE BOX COOKIES
directions: Cream butter (or margarin) until very soft, add sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Sift flour, soda and salt three times, and add with nut meats to first mixture. Pack in a mold, leave in refrigerator over night or longer. Then turn out on a board and slice as thin as possible. Makes 60 cookies. Bake 15 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: CARAMEL COOKIES
ingredients: ¼ tsp. baking soda, dissolved in a little hot water
Raisins, nuts or citron, for decorating
directions: Cream butter and brown sugar. Beat in egg, then soda dissolved in a little hot water. Add cream of tartar, salt and flour. Chill in a narrow loaf or roll until firm; slice, decorate each cookie with a raisin, nut or citron and bake at 350°F until lightly golden, about 10–12 minutes.

recipes.title: YUM -YUM COOKIES
directions: Mix and bake on sheet and cut in squares.

recipes.title: DATE BARS
directions: Add sugar to beaten eggs. Then add dates and nuts; flour and baking powder sifted together; and last the vanilla. Bake in a shallow pan. Dust with powdered sugar when first removed from oven. When almost cool, cut into 1 inch bars. Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: DATE BARS
directions: Beat eggs and sugar. Add dry ingredients sifted and dates and nuts. Spread on greased shallow pan and bake in moderate oven. Cut into bars.

recipes.title: MOLASSES CREAM BARS
directions: Mix eggs, sugar, molasses, add lard melted in hot water, add sifted dry ingredients. Pour into greased pans ¼ inch thick and bake in a slow oven. Nuts may be added. Cut in bars while warm and frost with powdered sugar frosting.

recipes.title: ANGEL FOOD
ingredients: 1 cup Swansdown cake flour (sifted once before measuring, then sifted four times)
½ tsp. each almond, vanilla, and lemon extract
directions: Beat egg whites with salt until frothy. Add cream of tartar and beat until it stands alone, but not until dry. Fold in sugar gradually, add extract, and fold in flour. Pour into ungreased angel food tin, and place in cold oven. Increase heat gradually every fifteen minutes, for one hour, when cake should be done. Temp. 300 degrees.

recipes.title: ANGEL CAKE
directions: To the sugar add water and 1/4 tsp. cream of tartar. Stir until sugar is dissolved, and boil until a little tried in cold water forms a firm ball ( 250 ° F. ). While the syrup is cooking beat the egg whites until stiff and dry, adding the salt before beating. Pour the syrup slowly on to the whites, beating constantly, and beat until cool. Add vanilla. Fold in the flour, which has been sifted several times with the remainder of the cream of tartar. Turn into an ungreased tube pan, place in a cold oven, and raise temperature gradually to 300°. Time in combining, 30 minutes; time in cooking, 1 hour 10 minutes. Temperature, 300°. Recipe makes loaf in tube pan 8 inches in diameter.

recipes.title: ECONOMY ANGEL FOOD CAKE
ingredients: ¼ tsp. almond or rose extract
directions: Break eggs into a measuring cup until 3/4 full. Fill cup with cold water. Pour on a large platter, add salt and beat with a flat wire egg beater until foamy. Add cream of tartar and beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Fold in the sugar one tbsp. at a time. Add flavoring. Have flour previously sifted, measured and sifted again three times. Fold flour in in the same manner as sugar. Bake in an angel cake tin in a slow oven ( 315 ° ) from 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: ANGEL FOOD CAKE
directions: Beat egg whites lightly, adding cream of tartar when partly beaten. The source lists sugar, flour and vanilla without specifying how to incorporate them. Bake in a moderate oven at first, increasing the heat near the end, about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: YELLOW MOCK ANGEL FOOD
ingredients: 1½ cups flour (sifted twice with cream of tartar)
directions: Beat sugar, yolks and cold water 10 minutes. Add other ingredients in order given, folding in egg whites last. Bake in ungreased angel cake pan for 50 to 60 minutes at 325 degrees. Let stay in pan until cold.

recipes.title: MOCK ANGEL FOOD CAKE
directions: Sift dry ingredients 3 times. Add scalded milk while hot. Fold in beaten whites. Bake slowly in an ungreased angel food pan. Remove from oven, invert pan, put wet cloth over whole pan until cake leaves sides of pan.

recipes.title: YELLOW ANGEL FOOD CAKE
directions: Beat the sugar, egg yolks and cold water 10 minutes. Add the boiling water, sifted flour and cream of tartar. Fold in the beaten egg whites. Bake in an ungreased and unfloured pan for 50–60 minutes in a slow oven. Leave in pan until cold.

recipes.title: YELLOW CAKE
directions: Boil water and sugar until it hairs, pour hot syrup over egg yolks and let stand. Beat whites of eggs with cream of tartar until stiff but not dry. Add to yolks alternately with flour sifted 3 times. Bake in angel food pan that has been rinsed in cold water but not dried. Bake in warm oven about 55 minutes, about 325 degrees F. Turn upside down on rack and cake will come out.

recipes.title: FRUIT ANGEL FOOD CAKE
ingredients: ¼ cup candied cherries, cut fine
directions: Beat eggs until foamy, add cream of tartar and salt. Beat until stiff but not dry, add sugar 2 or 3 tbsp. at a time and beat. Do this until all sugar has been used up. Then sprinkle all the flour carefully over the top, and fold into the batter. Add extract just as carefully. Pour 1½ batter into tube pan, then sprinkle the cherries and nuts over this, then add the rest of the batter. Run a knife to the bottom of the pan, and gently mix the fruit all around. Start cake in a cold oven, and bake 60 minutes from the time it reaches 300 degrees, and then 15 minutes at 325 degrees.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE ANGEL FOOD CAKE
directions: Beat egg whites until foamy, add cream of tartar and salt and beat until stiff enough to make a dog ear when you lift out your whip. Add sugar 2 or 3 tbsp. at a time and beat with your whip until all has been used. Then sprinkle in all of the flour carefully so as not to break down the beaten whites. Fold in the flour. Bake in tube pan at 300 degrees for 1 hour, then for 15 minutes longer at 325 degrees. Start cake in a cold oven. Count the time from the time the temperature reaches 300 degrees. Never use a Dover egg beater, use a flat wire whip.

recipes.title: SUNSHINE CAKE
directions: Beat yolks of eggs until thick and lemon color. Beat whites until stiff. Into these whites put cream of tartar and salt. Add sugar, beaten yolks and flavoring. Last sift flour four times before measuring and then fold into the mixture. Bake in an angel cake tin for 45 minutes in a slow oven at 325 °. Invert tins when cooling.

recipes.title: CREAM SPONGE CAKE
ingredients: Flour, enough to fill the measuring cup containing the cornstarch and baking powder
directions: Beat egg yolks with cold water until thick and lemon-colored. Add sugar gradually; beat two minutes. Place cornstarch in a cup and fill with flour, together with baking powder and salt. Add to the egg mixture. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites and add lemon extract. Bake 30 minutes in a moderate oven (325°F). The source recommends the cake for whipped-cream pies.

recipes.title: SPONGE CAKE USING YOLKS ONLY
directions: Beat yolks until light with dover egg beater; add sugar gradually then hot water, beating meanwhile. Add sifted flour with baking powder and salt and heat thoroughly. Bake in moderate oven 45 minutes or in 2 layers about 25 minutes. Put layers together with jelly, caramel or cream filling.

recipes.title: SPONGE CAKE
ingredients: Flour, enough to fill measuring cup with cornstarch and baking powder
directions: Mix ingredients in order given. Place cornstarch and baking powder in cup and fill with flour, sifting several times. Bake in moderate oven, 350 to 325 degrees.

recipes.title: HOT WATER SPONGE CAKE
directions: Beat yolks until lemon colored and thick, add sugar and beat. Add flour sifted with baking powder and salt. Stir in hot water and fold in whites beaten stiff. Flavor with lemon juice or extract. Bake at 325 ° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: COCOANUT SPONGE CAKE
directions: Beat eggs until light with dover beater; add sugar gradually and continue beating. Add boiling water, then flour which has been sifted, then measured and baking powder added, then sifted 3 times. Add flavoring. Beat all with dover beater and bake in two layer tins in a medium oven. Put together with any good custard with cocoanut added. Ice with boiled icing and sprinkle with cocoanut.

recipes.title: APPLE SAUCE CAKE
ingredients: 1 tsp. each cloves, cinnamon and nutmeg
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Mix soda in apple sauce and add to butter and sugar. Mix and sift flour and spices reserving a little flour to mix with raisins. Add flour and spices and raisins last. Bake in loaf tin 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: APPLE SAUCE CAKE
directions: Cream sugar and butter, add applesauce, flour and fruit. Bake in greased pan in slow oven.

recipes.title: APPLE SAUCE CAKE
directions: Heat oven to 325°F and grease an 8-inch square cake pan. Cream fat with brown sugar. Stir baking soda into applesauce, then add to sugar mixture. Whisk flour, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg and salt, and fold into wet mixture. Stir in raisins; spread in pan and bake 35–45 minutes, until cake tests clean.

recipes.title: BROWNIES
ingredients: ½ cup walnut meats cut in pieces
directions: (bitter)

Mix ingredients in the order given. Line a seven inch square pan with paraffin paper. Spread evenly, and bake in a slow oven. Turn from the pan, remove the paper, and cut the cake into strips, using a sharp knife.

recipes.title: BROWNIES
directions: Mix eggs and sugar, add flour, melted butter and chocolate and nuts. Pour out 1/4 inch deep in greased pan and bake in a very slow oven. Cut in squares as soon as taken from the oven.

recipes.title: BROWNIES
directions: **Method:**
1. Cream sugar and butter.
2. Add well beaten eggs.
3. Add sifted flour, melted chocolate and nutmeats which have been broken.
4. Spread on cookie sheet.
5. Cut in strips when baked. Time, 15 to 20 minutes. Temperature 400° F. ( Moderately hot oven). Amount, 2 dozen average sized strips.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE BROWNIES
ingredients: 2 eggs beaten wth pinch of salt
directions: Cream butter, add sugar and mix well. Add beaten eggs, then flour, cocoa, and nutmeats. Bake slowly about twenty minutes. To be baked in a cake pan and cut in squares before cold.

recipes.title: BUTTER CAKE
directions: Cream butter and sugar and add beaten eggs, then milk and flour sifted with baking powder, and add vanilla last. Bake in sheet or layers, 30 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE LOAF CAKE
directions: Mix in order given. Bake in a slow oven, 350 degrees, in a loaf, 30 minutes.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE CAKE
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks beaten and melted chocolate. Add water and sifted dry ingredients, vanilla and beaten egg whites. Bake in 2 large layers, in a moderate oven.

recipes.title: COCOA CAKE
directions: Mix sugar and butter, add egg, dissolve cocoa in water add to above, add milk and soda, and flour. Bake in moderate oven.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients: 2 tbsp. cocoa dissolved in ½ cup boiling water
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and grease an 8-inch square cake pan. Dissolve cocoa in boiling water and cool. Cream shortening and brown sugar, beat in egg, then stir in cocoa. Sift baking soda with flour and add alternately with sour milk. Bake 25–35 minutes, until a tester comes out clean.

recipes.title: SWEET MILK CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients: For chocolate paste: ⅓ cup milk
For chocolate paste: ⅓ cup powdered sugar
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg and milk, then sifted dry ingredients. Separately melt the chocolate with the milk, powdered sugar, and vanilla to make a paste. Combine the two mixtures and bake in two layers in a moderate oven.

recipes.title: DEVIL'S FOOD
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and grease an 8-inch round or square cake pan. Blend cocoa with boiling water and set aside to cool slightly. Cream butter and brown sugar until light, then beat in the egg. Whisk flour, salt and baking soda separately. Add dry ingredients alternately with sour milk; mix in cocoa. Pour into the pan and bake 25–35 minutes, or until a tester inserted at the center comes out clean. Cool before frosting.

recipes.title: QUICK DEVIL'S FOOD
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add egg, milk and soda, chocolate melted in hot water and the other dry ingredients. Bake in layers in a moderate oven.

recipes.title: DEVIL'S FOOD CAKE
directions: **Method:**
1. Cream sugar and shortening together
2. Add the well beaten eggs.
3. Sift flour, salt and soda together.
4. Add to the above mixture alternately with the milk.
5. Add melted chocolate.
6. Add vanilla.

7. Mix well and pour into well greased oblong pans or layer pans. Time: Bake 40 minutes. Temperature: 350° F. Size of pan: layer pans, 9 inch diameter; oblong, 9x16 in. Amount: Layer, 16 servings; oblong pan, 32 servings, 2 in. square.

recipes.title: COCOA CAKE
directions: Cream shortening and add sugar. Add beaten eggs, then add alternately the sour milk and flour into which the baking powder has been sifted. Either loaf or layer. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: HOT WATER CHOCOLATE CAKE
directions: Cream butter, sugar, cocoa and beaten egg. Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Stir soda into sour milk. Add flour and milk alternately to creamed mixture. Before putting in oven add ½ cup boiling water. Bake in 3 layers, 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: FILLING FOR CHOCOLATE CAKE
directions: Mix together and stir in 1 cup boiling water. Cook until thick and add butter size of a walnut. Beat well. Ice with a beaten powdered sugar frosting.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE CAKE
directions: To 3 tbsp. cocoa gradually add ½ cup hot water. When smooth add to rest of cake mixture. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: SIMPLE CHOCOLATE TWO LAYER CAKE
directions: After creaming sugar and butter together, add cocoa, cream. add egg beaten light. Then add sour milk and soda dissolved in the boiling water. Into the flour, put the baking powder, and then sift into the batter. The flour should be measured after sifting. After adding vanilla, beat hard, then place in two tins for layer cake. Bake 20 minutes at 350 degrees. Put together with filling.

recipes.title: DEVIL'S FOOD CAKE
directions: Mix sugar, butter, water, flour, baking powder, and egg yolks in order given. Add boiling water and soda to grated chocolate; stir until dissolved. Combine the mixtures, then add beaten egg whites, vanilla, and salt. Bake 30 minutes at 350°F.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE CAKE
directions: Melt chocolate in 1/2 cup milk. Cream butter, sugar, and egg. Add chocolate mixture, 1/4 cup milk. Add flour and salt, dissolve soda and vanilla in 1/4 cup milk and add last. Bake in loaf forty minutes at 350 degrees or in layers 30 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: RED DEVIL'S FOOD CAKE
ingredients: 1½ cups sifted Swans Down cake flour
directions: Mix first list by regular cake method. Mix second list in order given and add to first mixture. Bake in two layers for about 30 minutes at 325 degrees.

recipes.title: CHEAP LIGHT CAKE
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add egg yolks and milk, then sifted dry ingredients, vanilla, beaten egg yolks and salt. Bake in 2 layers in moderate oven. Put together with the following custard filling: 1 cup milk ½ cup sugar 1 sq. chocolate 1 tsp. cornstarch 1 tsp. vanilla 1 tbsp. water Dissolve cornstarch in water, add chocolate dissolved in hot milk with sugar and vanilla. Cool before spreading between layers of cake.

recipes.title: COLONIAL CAKE
ingredients: 1 egg in cup, fill with sweet
directions: Sift dry ingredients, add egg and cream and beat hard. Bake in moderate oven about 20 minutes. Chocolate, nuts or spices may be added to vary this cake. Use chocolate cream icing.

recipes.title: DATE CAKE
directions: Pour 1/4 cup water over dates and let stand. Cream butter and sugar and add beaten eggs. Mix and sift flour, salt, baking powder and soda. Add to first mixture. Add remaining water and beat until smooth. Add nuts and flavoring. Pour in well greased shallow tin and bake in moderate oven.

recipes.title: DUTCH APPLE CAKE
directions: Sift dry ingredients, work butter into them, add egg and milk. Pour batter on greased pan 1 inch thick. Press points of apple slices in dough, sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon, bake in quick oven.

recipes.title: DELICATE CAKE
directions: Mix ingredients in order given, folding in egg whites last. Bake 30 minutes at 350 degrees. Nice for a birthday cake.

recipes.title: ENGLISH WHITE FRUIT CAKE
directions: Prepare fruit and mix it with a spoonful of the dry flour. Cream butter and sugar, and add eggs one at a time, beating well between each one. Add sifted flour, baking powder and salt and milk slowly. When thoroughly beaten, stir in the fruit. Put in an angel food pan that has been lined with greased paper and bake in a moderate oven ( 340° ) from 1½ to 2 hours.

recipes.title: EASY CAKE -
ingredients: Whites of 2 eggs (in a measuring cup)
Melted butter, enough to fill that cup halfway
Milk, enough to fill the cup
directions: Put whites of two eggs into a measuring cup, fill halfway with melted butter, then fill the cup with milk. Sift sugar, flour, baking powder, and salt. Add the measuring-cup mixture and flavoring; beat 5 minutes until blended. Bake about 30 minutes in a moderate oven.

recipes.title: ENGLISH QUEENS CAKES
directions: Cream butter and sugar, drop one egg at a time unbeaten and mix well. Add sifted flour and baking powder and milk slowly and the fruit. Bake in small greased muffin tins in a warm oven. Turn oven full on for 3 minutes and then turn very low and bake 15 minutes.

recipes.title: CAKE
ingredients: 2 eggs (broken into the butter measuring cup)
Milk, enough to fill the butter-and-egg measuring cup
directions: Sift sugar, flour, and baking powder together twice. Into a quarter-filled measuring cup of soft butter break two eggs; fill the cup with milk. Add to the dry ingredients, beat with a spoon for 5 minutes, then add vanilla. Bake in a moderate oven. Makes two layers or one loaf.

recipes.title: FEATHER CAKE
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs, milk and sifted dry ingredients. Bake in a moderate oven.

recipes.title: FEATHER CAKE
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add water, sifted flour and baking powder and fold in beaten whites and vanilla. Bake in two layers in moderate oven.

recipes.title: FRUIT CAKE
directions: Cream butter, add sugar, egg. Sift and mix dry ingredients, and add to first. Add raisins, nutmeats and citron, cut up and dredged with a little flour. Apple may be ground in food grinder. Add vanilla.

recipes.title: GINGER CAKE
ingredients: 1 tsp. each ginger, cinnamon, and cloves
2 tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 cup boiling water
directions: Add the well beaten eggs the last thing before baking. Bake in a large square pan 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: SOFT HOT WATER GINGER CAKE
ingredients: ⅔ cup molasses dissolved in ⅓ cup cold water
directions: Sift all dry ingredients, add molasses and cold water, eggs and the shortening melted in the hot water. The batter will be very thin. Bake in a greased cake tin in a slow oven.

recipes.title: HOT WATER GINGER CAKE
directions: Mix in order given. Bake 40 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: GOLD MEDAL CAKE
directions: **Method:**
1. Cream shortening and sugar together.
2. Add the yolks, which have been beaten until light, with the water and flavoring.
3. Mix well.
4. Sift the dry ingredients together, and add to the first mix-ture alternately with the milk.
5. Fold in the beaten egg whites to which the salt has been added before beating.

6. May be baked as a loaf cake or in two layers. Time: Bake 40 minutes for loaf cake, 20 minutes for layer cake. Temperature: 325° F. for loaf cake and 375° for layer cake. Size of pan: Layer pans 9 inch diameter, oblong pan 9x16 in. Amount: 16 servings.

recipes.title: GOLD CAKE
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add yolks of eggs well beaten. Sift flour, baking powder and salt together, and add alternately with milk to egg mixture. Stir in extract and turn into a well greased and floured small loaf pan. Bake in moderate oven 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: GRANDMA'S SPECIAL CAKE (LARGE CAKE)
ingredients: 1 cup butter, creamed with granulated sugar
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and prepare a large tube pan or two 9-inch cake pans. Cream butter with granulated sugar. Mix cornstarch, flour and baking powder; add alternately with milk or cream. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites, powdered sugar and orange extract gently. Bake approximately 35–50 minutes, depending on pan depth, until cake tests clean.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE FILLING
directions: Place all together on stove and boil to a custard.

recipes.title: HOT MILK CAKE
directions: Sift the dry ingredients. Melt the teaspoon of butter in hot milk. Add eggs to flour and sugar and pour on hot milk and butter. Bake in slow oven in greased pan. Ice with 7 minute icing.

recipes.title: MOLASSES CAKE
ingredients: ½ cup part lard and butter
directions: Mix in order given. May be baked in 2 layers or in loaf. Bake at 325 degrees, about fifteen minutes for layers, longer for loaf.

recipes.title: MOLASSES CAKE
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add molasses, water and sifted dry ingredients and eggs. Bake in a moderate oven about 25 minutes.

recipes.title: MOLASSES CUP CAKES
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs, molasses, water and dry ingredients sifted. Bake in greased muffin tins or loaf tin in a moderate oven.

recipes.title: ORANGE CAKE
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add egg and yolks and beat well. Sift flour before measuring, then sift flour, baking powder and soda into mixture and add cream and beat until smooth. Makes two layers. Bake at 350° to 370° for 18-20 minutes. Use inch high icing flavored with orange.

recipes.title: ORANGE LAYER CAKE
directions: Cream shortening, add sugar gradually and beat until light. Add well-beaten yolks of eggs. Sift flour, measure, add salt and baking powder, and add alternately with the milk to whites of eggs. Bake in greased and papered layer cake tins in a moderate oven from 20 to 25 minutes. Spread orange filling and icing between the layers and on top of cake.

recipes.title: ORANGE FILLING AND ICING
ingredients: Juice, rind, and soft pulp of 1 orange
directions: Whip egg whites to a stiff froth; add sugar a little at a time. Beat in the orange pulp, juice, and rind.

recipes.title: PEANUT BARS
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten egg yolks and milk. Add sifted flour and baking powder; beat well. Add flavoring and fold in beaten egg whites. Bake in a 9- or 10-inch square sheet pan about 35 minutes at 350°F. Cool and cut into 1×2-inch bars.
Filling: Cream butter and powdered sugar; add cream and vanilla. Coat the bars with filling and roll in ground peanuts.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE BUTTER SCOTCH CAKE
ingredients: For pan: brown sugar (enough to cover bottom to ½-inch depth)
For pan: pineapple slices and maraschino cherries
directions: **Method:**
1. Sift dry ingredients.
2. Cream sugar and shortening together.
3. Add well beaten eggs.
4. Add milk alternately with the sifted dry ingredients.

5. Add the vanilla and mix well. Preparation of pan: Grease a round pudding pan, line with brown sugar about 1/2 inch deep. Dot with 3 tbsp. butter. Place in the pan slices of pineapple with maraschino cherry in center of each.
6. Pour the cake batter over the mixture in the pan. Time: Bake for 50 minutes. Temperature: 350° F. (moderate ). Size of pan: round pan, 10 inches diameter. Amount: 8 servings.

recipes.title: PECAN CHRISTMAS CAKE
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add beaten egg yolks. Then pour brandy on slowly. Add flour which has been sifted three times with nutmeg, raisins and nuts which have been dredged with some flour. Then fold in the beaten egg whites. This is a most delicious cake and will keep indefinitely. Should be baked in two tube pans for 60 minutes at 300 degrees.

recipes.title: HOT WATER SPICE CAKE
directions: Cream sugar and melted butter together, and add eggs beaten until thick and lemon colored. Then add Karo and molasses and chopped raisins. Sift flour and spices and add to above mixture, beating well as it is added. Last add boiling water to which soda has been dissolved. Bake in 3 layer tins in moderate oven, 350° for 25 minutes. Put together with white boiled frosting.

recipes.title: SPICE CAKE
ingredients: 3 eggs (use 3 yolks and 1 white in the cake; reserve 2 whites for frosting)
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Grease a 9-inch cake pan or two 8-inch layer pans. Cream butter and sugar. Beat in three egg yolks and one egg white, saving the remaining two whites for frosting. Stir baking soda into sour milk. Whisk flour, baking powder and spices; add to batter in alternating additions with sour milk. Bake about 30–40 minutes in one pan, or 22–30 minutes in two layer pans, until a tester comes out clean. Cool and frost with an icing made using the reserved whites.

recipes.title: SOUR MILK SPICE CAKE
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs and milk and sifted dry ingredients. Pour 1½ batter in greased tin, to other part add fruit and mix. Then spread over top of batter in pan. Bake in moderate oven.

recipes.title: SWEET MILK SPICE CAKE
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs and sifted dry ingredients and fruit. Bake in moderate oven in a greased pan.

recipes.title: SPICE CAKE
ingredients: ½ tsp. each ginger and cloves
directions: Cream butter and sugar, and add beaten eggs. Add soda to sour cream. Sift flour, baking powder and spices. Add sour cream and dry ingredients alternately to creamed mixture. Beat well. Bake in loaf tin, 40 minutes at 350 °.

recipes.title: SPICE CAKE WITH BROWN SUGAR FROSTING
directions: scant tsp. cloves
Mix in order given, and bake in layers 30 minutes at 350 degrees. Use Brown Sugar Frosting.

recipes.title: SOUR CREAM CAKE
directions: Beat eggs well; add sugar, then the sour cream. Mix and sift the dry ingredients and add to the first mixture. Flavor with vanilla, lemon or nutmeg. Bake in well greased muffin tins in moderate oven.

recipes.title: SNOWBALLS
directions: Mix in order given, bake in a sheet and when cold cut off the edges (this may be used in pudding). Dip 1 inch squares in boiled frosting made from white of 2 eggs. Roll in cocoanut and place on waxed paper. Bake 35 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: SOUR CREAM CUP CAKES
directions: Beat eggs, cream and sugar with an egg beater. Add sifted dry ingredients and vanilla. Bake in greased muffin tins or as a loaf cake in a moderate oven.

recipes.title: STRAWBERRY CAKE
directions: Cream together sugar, butter, cloves and cinnamon. Add strawberry jam, then the eggs beaten lightly. Add soda dissolved in milk. Sift flour and baking powder and add. Bake about 30 minutes in a loaf at 375 degrees. Cover with any desired icing. This cake keeps moist.

recipes.title: SOUR CREAM CAKE
ingredients: 1 egg and 1 egg yolk, placed in measuring cup
Sour cream, enough to fill that measuring cup
directions: Beat egg, yolk, and sour cream with a Dover egg beater. Sift sugar, salt, flour, soda, and baking powder together. Add the egg-and-cream mixture to the dry ingredients and beat well; flavor. Makes two layers. Bake 25 minutes at 350°F.

recipes.title: TEA CAKE
directions: Cream sugar and shortening, add beaten eggs, and molasses. Then add dry ingredients, which have been sifted together, alternately with water. Bake in two layers at 325 degrees, for about fifteen minutes.

recipes.title: WHITE CAKE THREE LAYERS
directions: Cream sugar and butter thoroughly. Add water, flour, baking powder, and lemon flavoring; beat well. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake in a moderate oven at 325°F. Intended for orange filling and boiled icing.

recipes.title: WHITE CAKE
directions: Mix ingredients in order given. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: WHITE LAYER CAKE
directions: **Method:**
1. Cream sugar and shortening together.
2. Add milk alternately with flour that has been sifted several times with the baking powder.
3. Add flavoring and mix well.
4. Fold in well beaten whites of eggs.
5. Put in two well greased layer cakes tins. Time: Bake 35 minutes. Temperature: Moderate oven 325-375 °. Size of pan: 9 in. diameter layer pan. Amount: 16 servings.

recipes.title: WHITE CAKE
directions: Cream butter, add sugar gradually, and milk and flour alternately. Fold in beaten whites and add vanilla. Bake in layer tins at 385°.

recipes.title: WHITE LAYER CAKE
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Sift flour 3 times with baking powder and salt. Add milk and flour alternately beating well after each addition. Add vanilla and last fold in stiffly beaten whites of eggs. Bake 25 minutes at 350 °.

recipes.title: WHITE CAKE
directions: last 1 tsp. vanilla Bake 25 minutes at 350 °.

recipes.title: FIG FILLING
directions: Mix ingredients in order given and cook in double boiler until thick enough to spread. Spread while hot.

recipes.title: CREAM CAKE FILLING
directions: Mix all ingredients and cook in double boiler until thick. Use extra egg white for frosting.

recipes.title: ORANGE FILLING FOR WHITE CAKE
directions: Cook to a thick custard, and, when cool, spread on cake.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE FILLING
directions: Boil all together, and cool before putting between layers.

recipes.title: STRAWBERRY FILLING FOR CAKE
directions: Beat all until smooth and creamy, and put between layers and on top of cake.

recipes.title: BOILED FROSTING
directions: Mix chocolate with sugar and water, and boil until it hairs. Beat into whites of eggs. Flavor with vanilla and salt.

recipes.title: BROWN SUGAR FROSTING
directions: Boil until it forms a ball in water, a little harder than a soft ball. Beat 1 egg white until stiff and add the syrup. Beat until stiff enough to spread.

recipes.title: BUTTER FROSTING
directions: cream vanilla
Cream butter and sugar, add cream slowly to the right consistency to spread.

recipes.title: COFFEE ICING
directions: Stir cocoa into powdered sugar. Add strong brewed coffee one teaspoon at a time, stirring until the icing is smooth and spreadable.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE FROSTING
directions: Mix and cook slowly until it forms a soft ball in water. Add 1 tbsp. butter and let stand until cool. Beat until creamy, add vanilla and spread on cake.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE CREAM ICING
ingredients: Part I: ¼ tsp. cream of tartar
directions: Part I: Boil sugar, water and cream of tartar until a little syrup forms a soft ball in water. Add butter and vanilla, and cool without stirring. Beat until creamy and spread on cake.
Part II: Melt chocolate with 1 tbsp. water until smooth; cool and spread thinly over the first icing.

recipes.title: CREAM COCOA ICING
directions: Blend Crisco with egg and salt. Add sugar and cocoa, which have been mixed together, alternately with boiling water. Beat well.

recipes.title: COMFORT ICING
directions: **Method:**
1. Cook together sugar, corn syrup and water until syrup spins a thread. (242° F. )
2. Pour the hot syrup slowly into the beaten egg whites, beat-ing during the addition.
3. Add vanilla and continue beating until the mixture will hold its shape. For Chocolate Comfort Icing, add two squares (each sq. one oz.) of melted chocolate to frosting during final beating.

recipes.title: FLUFFY BOILED ICING
ingredients: Water enough to wet sugar thoroughly.
directions: Boil sugar and water until it forms a soft ball in cold water. Beat the egg white until stiff, and add syrup gradually, beating with the dover egg beater until it is the right consistency to spread on cake. Add flavoring.

recipes.title: FROSTING FOR COOKIES
ingredients: Boiling water, enough to make a medium-thin icing
directions: Melt chocolate. Gradually stir in powdered sugar, adding sufficient boiling water to make a medium-thin icing. Let cool, add vanilla and beat.

recipes.title: ICING
directions: Mix powdered sugar, butter, cocoa and vanilla; thin with hot coffee.

recipes.title: INCH HIGH ICING
directions: Soak gelatine in cold water and dissolve over steam. Dissolve sugar in hot water and boil until the syrup will spin a thread. Strain gelatine into syrup. Have egg whites beaten very stiff on a platter, add syrup slowly, beating constantly with a wooden spoon. When icing is so thick that it holds to shape, it is ready for use.

recipes.title: LADY BALTIMORE ICING
directions: To boiled icing add ½ cup chopped raisins, ½ cup chopped walnut meats, and 6 figs cut in shreds.

recipes.title: MAPLE FROSTING
ingredients: 1 cup maple or coffee C sugar
directions: Boil fifteen minutes, take from fire and stir until it thickens. Spread immediately.

recipes.title: NUT CARAMEL FROSTING
directions: Cream together butter, 13/4 cups of the sugar, and flour. Add milk and cook until a little tried in cold water forms a soft ball. Caramelize the remaining quarter cup of sugar, and add carefully to the first mixture. Bring to boiling point, cool to lukewarm, add nuts and vanilla and beat until thick. Time in cooking, 30 minutes. Temperature, 238 °. Recipe covers cake 9x9.

recipes.title: RICH ICING
ingredients: 1 cup powdered sugar free from lumps.
directions: Add cocoa to give desired color and enough butter to cream well. Thin to desired consistency with cream and flavor with vanilla.

recipes.title: SEVEN MINUTE ICING
directions: Have water in lower part of double boiler boiling. Place the egg whites, water and sugar in double boiler and beat with Dover egg beater constantly for 7 minutes. Remove from stove and add vanilla.

recipes.title: SEVEN MINUTE ICING
directions: Put unbeaten egg white, sugar and water in double boiler over fire and beat with Dover egg beater exactly seven minutes. Remove from fire add vanilla and spread on cake.

recipes.title: CANDIED ORANGE PEEL
directions: Remove peel from oranges in quarters. Cover with cold water (pinch of salt) and cook until soft, drain. With a spoon remove white portion and cut yellow portion into thin strips with scissors. Boil water and sugar until syrup spins a thread. Cook peel in syrup 5 minutes, drain, and coat with fine granulated sugar.

recipes.title: BUTTER SCOTCH
directions: Boil until thick, then pour on buttered plate, and cut in squares, when cool. Peanuts stirred in, greatly improve the candy.

recipes.title: CARAMELS
directions: Mix and bring to boiling point. Add slowly 2 cups top milk. Stir until it boils. Add 1/2 cup butter and cook to quite hard ball. (250° ). Add 1 tbsp. vanilla and 1 cup nuts. Pour into greased tins and cut when cool.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE ORANGE CREAM WAFERS
ingredients: 3/4 cup finely cut crystallized orange peel
directions: Melt the bitter chocolate in a double boiler and spread with a knife on heavy waxed paper on which has been drawn an oblong six inches by twelve inches. To the confectioners sugar add one teaspoon grated orange peel and two tablespoons juice ( enough to moisten the sugar so that it will spread without running). Add the crystallized orange peel and when the oblong of chocolate is hard spread on it the orange mixture as evenly as possible. Melt the sweet chocolate and spread on another sheet of waxed paper, making an oblong the same size as the first. Turn the first sheet face

down on this melted chocolate and press with the hand over the wrong side of the paper. When the chocolate is hard pull off the papers and cut the candy in squares to serve as a confection. This is really a very simple process, and the wafers are delicious, something one cannot buy at any candy shop.

recipes.title: DE LEON CREAMS
directions: Put sugar, water, and cream of tartar in kettle on the stove. Stir gently until sugar is dissolved. Cook to soft ball stage (238 degrees F). Turn out on oiled platter (do not scrape kettle). Leave to cool until it will show the imprint of the finger. Beat until creamy. Work in the finely chopped orange peel, let stand until quite cool. Form into rolls about one inch thick. Roll in more chopped peel and slice. Set in a cool place before serving.

recipes.title: CREOLE PRALINES
directions: Boil syrup until it forms a thread from tip of spoon. Remove from fire, add nuts and stir until it begins to sugar. Drop in flat round shapes on greased paper.

recipes.title: FUDGE
ingredients: ¼ lb. bitter chocolate (or less, if desired)
directions: Cut up chocolate; add water, butter and salt. Cook over low heat, stirring until thick and smooth. Remove from heat and thoroughly stir in sugar. Return to heat and cook without stirring to the soft-ball stage when tested in cold water. Let cool completely, add vanilla and beat until creamy.

recipes.title: SOFT CHOCOLATE FUDGE
directions: Cook the sugar, milk and chocolate together till it will cling together when tested in cold water. Then add butter and vanilla. Let stand till entirely cold. Beat for about fifteen minutes. Pour on buttered plate and cut in squares.

recipes.title: FUDGE
directions: When it will harden in cold water, take from fire, stir until it is quite thick, then pour on buttered tins. Be sure to take from fire just the minute it will harden in cold water.

recipes.title: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
directions: Boil exactly 5 minutes. Remove from the fire and beat until thick.

recipes.title: ORIENTALS
directions: Put sugar and water into kettle and stir well until dissolved. Add glycerine and heat until it boils. Add acid, clean sides of kettle, and boil until it forms a soft ball. Let cool. Pour out. Beat in beaten whites and vanilla. Beat until it sets and mould. Dip into the melted chocolate.

recipes.title: SEA FOAM
directions: Mix sugar, water, Karo syrup and salt; boil until syrup spins a thread. Pour syrup slowly over stiffly beaten egg whites, beating constantly, until half the syrup is used. Boil remaining syrup until it forms a hard ball in cold water. Beat it into the first mixture and continue beating until the desired consistency.

recipes.title: APRICOT ICE CREAM
directions: Add juice of oranges and lemons to apricots. Add sugar to milk and cook until dissolved, cool and freeze to consistency of mush. Add fruit and continue freezing. Add whipped cream and finish freezing.

recipes.title: BAKED ALASKA
ingredients: 1 thin slice sponge cake, per serving
1 slice firm ice cream, per serving
directions: Thin slice of cake placed flat on dessert plate. Place slice of ice cream on top. Prepare meringue of egg whites and powdered sugar. Place meringue on ice cream and place in hot oven until brown.

recipes.title: BAKED INDIVIDUAL ALASKA
directions: Beat eggs adding sugar slowly until very stiff. Heat broiling oven very hot. Cut cake into individual servings, place on plates. On cake place a square of ice cream and cover with meringue. Put in oven for a moment to brown. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: FROZEN BISQUE
directions: Whip cream, add egg yolks well beaten, sugar, crackers rolled fine, cocoanut and vanilla. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Put in freezer, or mold, pack in ice and salt and let stand 2 hours.

recipes.title: COLD DESSERT
ingredients: Strawberry ice cream, or whipped cream
For pink sauce: ½ cup water
directions: Layer a scoop of chocolate ice cream with chocolate sauce, vanilla ice cream and pink sauce in tall glasses. Add a scoop of strawberry ice cream, or top with whipped cream and a cherry.
For pink sauce, boil sugar with water and color the syrup pink. Let stand 24 hours before using. Fresh orange, banana, pineapple or berries may be added just before serving.

recipes.title: GRAPE FRUIT SHERBET
directions: Time: Preparation and freezing, 50 minutes. Number served: 10 to 12 persons.
**Method:**

Chip the yellow rind, not taking any of the white pulp, from half a grape fruit; add this and the sugar to the water, boil five minutes; cool; add the juice of the fruit; strain into a freezer and freeze. Beat egg to a stiff froth, add powdered sugar; add to the frozen mixture; beat; repack until ready to use.

recipes.title: ICE CREAM
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch, egg, and moisten with a little cold milk. Add to scalded milk and cook until it thickens. When cold, strain and add cream and vanilla to taste. Freeze. For chocolate ice cream, add 2 squares Baker's Chocolate to Custard when cooking. For strawberry ice cream, add 1 qt. crushed berries, with 1 cup sugar. Add when cream begins to freeze. For peach ice cream, add about 3 or 4 cups crushed peaches, sweetened to taste, when cream begins to freeze.

recipes.title: LEMON ICE CREAM
directions: Scald and let cool thoroughly. Add:1 pt. cream. When half frozen add 1/2 cup lemon juice, and finish freezing.

recipes.title: LADY FINGERS - ICE CREAM
ingredients: 1 large scoop ice cream per serving
directions: ICE CREAM
Place large spoonful ice cream between two or three lady fingers. Top with colored whipped cream and nuts and cherry. Serve on lace doilies.

recipes.title: MAPLE MOUSSE
directions: Let syrup and gelatine come to a boil. Take from fire, and cool. When it begins to set, add whipped cream and whites. Mold and pack in ice and salt. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: MAPLE PARFAIT
directions: Beat eggs slightly; pour on slowly, the maple syrup and cook in double boiler until mixture thickens. Cool and add cream, whipped stiff. Mold and pack in ice and salt, and let stand for 3 or 4 hours.

recipes.title: MAPLE PARFAIT
directions: Beat eggs slightly, pour syrup on slowly. Cook in double boiler until thick. Freeze in icebox tray.

recipes.title: MAPLE PECAN MOUSSE
directions: Beat eggs well. Add maple syrup. Let this mixture come to a boil, stirring constantly. Take off fire, and let cool. Meanwhile whip cream, and grind nut meats. When syrup is cold, fold all ingredients together. Pour into a covered mold, and pack in a large kettle with ice and salt. In the winter the salt and ice pack is not necessary, as it will freeze nicely out of doors in three or four hours. Before I had a covered mold, I used the top of my double boiler, which worked fine. Serves four.

recipes.title: ORANGE ICE
directions: Boil water and sugar 20 minutes gently. Add juice and rind. Cool and strain. Freeze. 1 tsp. softened gelatine may be added to boiling syrup, when it is taken from stove.

recipes.title: PEANUT BRITTLE ICE CREAM
ingredients: ½ lb. peanut brittle ground fine
directions: Soak gelatine in water, melt over hot water. Add whipped cream and peanut brittle and freeze in ice box. Serve with 1 tbsp. maple syrup. Sugar stick candy or after dinner mints may be substituted for peanut brittle.

recipes.title: CHARLOTTE RUSSE
directions: Soak gelatin in 2 tbsp. of cold water for about 5 minutes. Dissolve in 2 tbsp. hot water. Let stand until cool, but not hard. Whip cream until stiff, add 2 tbsp. of above gelatin, and sugar, vanilla and coloring. Line serving dish with lady fingers, and fll with gelatin mixture. Serves 8.

recipes.title: FRESH STRAWBERRY CHARLOTTE RUSSE
ingredients: 1 pt. fresh strawberries, carefully cut up
directions: Soak gelatine in 1/4 cup cold water. Have cream and eggs beaten, ready for use. Mix sugar with berries. Heat milk and pour over gelatine. Add at once to eggs, cream, and berries. Pour in mold lined with lady fingers, or in individual molds without lady fingers. Garnish with whipped cream and whole berries. Serves 6.

recipes.title: DATE AND MACAROON DESSERT
directions: Place milk, egg yolks and sugar in double boiler. When it is boiling hot add gelatin which has been dissolved in cold water. Then remove from fire and pour over egg whites which have been beaten stiff. Fold the mixture until blended. Have dates, nuts and macaroons cut up in your mold, then pour this mixture over it. Let stand in ice box until it jellies and serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: ICE BOX DESSERT
directions: Whip cream. Put vinegar, salt and sugar in jello while hot. When cool and partly congealed, whip. Add pecans, marshmallows, cherries, and fold in whipped cream and macaroons, and pour into mold. Chill or freeze and serve in slices.

recipes.title: CHEESE RING
directions: Add 1/4 cup cold water to gelatin and melt over steam. Add to cream. Blend in the cheese and season. Place in mold and serve with crackers and jelly.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE ICE BOX PUDDING
ingredients: 2-10c cakes Baker Sweet Chocolate 3 tbsp. water
directions: Melt chocolate in double boiler; add water and sugar. Add beaten yolks of eggs and boil. When cold add beaten whites. When ready to serve pour over lady fingers and serve with whipping cream.

recipes.title: ICE BOX DESSERT
directions: Line bottom of dish with wafers, add bananas sliced, dates and nuts cut in pieces. Boil until thick, the sugar, cornstarch, and water, and pour over the contents of the dish. Cover with another layer of wafers and add rest of sauce. Chill. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: ICE BOX CAKE
ingredients: ½ lb. shelled almonds, blanched and ground
directions: Cream the butter with the powdered sugar. Add egg yolks, ground almonds, and crushed macaroons. Fold in beaten egg whites last. Assemble with lady fingers as indicated by the source. Let stand in the icebox at least 36 hours. Serves 16.

recipes.title: MAPLE GELATINE PUDDING
directions: Soak gelatine in water 10 minutes. Let syrup come to boil and pour on gelatine. Add beaten egg yolks and set mixture to cool. When it begins to thicken add beaten egg whites and whipped cream. Mold and chill. Serves 16.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE ICE BOX CAKE
ingredients: Whipped cream and maraschino cherries, to serve
directions: Cream softened butter with powdered sugar. Fold in drained pineapple, orange zest and vanilla, then gently fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Line a serving dish with ladyfingers and alternate layers with pineapple filling. Chill at least 4 hours, until firm. Garnish with whipped cream and cherries before serving.

recipes.title: MACAROON CHOCOLATE PUDDING
directions: Soak gelatine in water and melt over hot water. Whip cream and when gelatine has cooled slightly, add gelatine to cream and divide in two parts. To one half add the chocolate which has been melted over hot water, salt and vanilla. To the other half add the macaroons which have been pounded or ground up. Put in dish in layers and garnish with maraschino cherries and nuts. May be served with whipped cream.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE DESSERT
ingredients: 1 small can grated or crushed pineapple, juice drained
½ lb. marshmallows, cut in small pieces
