directions: Whip the cream stiff; gradually add drained pineapple and marshmallow pieces. Let stand about ½ hour on ice. Serve in sherbet glasses, sprinkled with chopped nutmeats and cinnamon.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE MARSHMALLOW PUDDING
directions: Put milk and marshmallows in double boiler and melt together. Add drained pineapple and orange juice. Cool and add 1 bottle whipped cream. Mold and chill.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients: ½ pt. whipping cream, whipped stiff
directions: Boil rice until done in plenty of boiling, salted water, and then wash in cold water. Sweeten a little and add pineapple, and let stand over night. Then add the other ingredients, and stir all together.

recipes.title: ORANGE APPLE JELLY
directions: To one cup of boiling sweetened apple sauce add a package of prepared jelly powder and one cup boiling water. Line a mold with orange sections which are free from all membrane. When the jelly begins to set pour into the mold. Serve with cream, plain or whipped. Time in combining, 20 minutes. Recipe makes six servings.

recipes.title: RICE AND PINEAPPLE BAVARIAN CREAM
directions: Boil rice in plenty of water (use cold water to start with). When kernels are tender, pour in a strainer and run cold water over it. Add pineapple. Heat pineapple juice, sugar and lemon extract to boiling point. Soak gelatine in 1/2 cup cold water, then add boiling pineapple juice. Let cool. When it begins to thicken, beat until it is white and foamy, fold in rice, pineapple, and whipped cream. Chill, and serve with whipped cream garnish.

recipes.title: JELLIED RHUBARB
directions: Bake (or simmer) slowly, the rhubarb covered with sugar and water until tender and pink. Strain. Soak gelatin in cold water, and add to the juice. Cool and stir in the grated rind and juice of the lemons. Pour in wet mold. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: TAPIOCA ICEBOX DESSERT
directions: Pour hot water over tapioca and let stand 1 hour. Cook in double boiler until transparent. Add milk, eggs, sugar and cook until mixture coats a silver spoon lightly. Set aside. Soak gelatine in a little cold water for 5 minutes, add to first mixture while it is hot. Let it harden. Line an angel food tin with halves of lady fingers. Whip cream very stiff adding sugar slowly. Fold the hardened custard in lightly. Pour into lined tin and cover with lady fingers. Chill 2 hours. Serve with plain or whipped cream.

recipes.title: BROWN SUGAR PUDDING
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt; add hot water; cook until thick then add butter and flavoring after it is removed from fire. Top with whipped cream. This is a very quick and easy dessert. Serves four.

recipes.title: CRANBERRY SAUCE
directions: Cover and bake in a moderate oven, 350 degrees for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: COCOANUT BLANC MANGE
directions: Cook milk and starch until thick, add other ingredients, folding in whites last. Serve with thin custard or fruit sauce.

recipes.title: COCOA PUDDING
directions: Mix all ingredients except vanilla and cook slowly in double boiler 25 minutes, stirring constantly until thick. Add vanilla, mold and cool. Serve with plain or whipped cream.

recipes.title: DATE DELIGHT
directions: Roll the crackers until fine. Cut the dates and marshmallowsthe marshmallows should be fresh-cut in small pieces. Chop the nuts. Mix well together, moistening with the cream. Mold in a roll with oiled paper. Place in refrigerator overnight. Serve cut in slices with whipped cream or hard sauce topping each slice. Mrs. James Rork.

recipes.title: DATE PUDDING
directions: Sift first three, mix and bake in shallow pan in water in moderate oven, 325 degrees, for 20 minutes. Serve cold with whipped cream. Serves 6.

recipes.title: DATE PUDDING
directions: Mix ingredients and bake in slow oven in small patty tins for individual portions.

recipes.title: DATE PUDDING
directions: This makes twelve pieces. Serve with whipped cream. Bake in slow oven 45 minutes.

recipes.title: DATE PUDDING
directions: Bake in muffin tins and serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: DATE PUDDING
directions: Beat egg until light and foamy; add the sugar. Mix the flour, baking powder and salt with the nuts and dates. ( Walnuts are excellent. ) Combine the two mixtures. Pour into an oiled pan. Bake in a slow oven about thirty minutes, or until firm. Serve with whipped cream. Six large, or eight medium helpings.

recipes.title: DATE PUDDING
directions: Chop dates and nuts, add flour, salt and baking powder, sugar and egg yolks, vanilla and egg whites. Bake in an angel food pan. Slice and serve with cream. Serves 12.

recipes.title: GRAHAM CRACKER PUDDING
directions: Mix dry ingredients, and add yolks, then whites and vanilla. Bake slowly, 45 or 50 minutes. 8 large servings.

recipes.title: LEFT OVER ICE CREAM
ingredients: Cornstarch, about 1 tbsp. per 2 cups thinned ice cream
directions: When ice cream is left over, add enough milk to thin slightly, scald and add a little cornstarch to thicken. Put in custard cups that have been rinsed in cold water.

recipes.title: LEMON SPONGE CUSTARD
directions: Mix first four ingredients. Beat egg yolks and add milk, then mix with above. Fold in whites and put in unbaked crust. Bake quickly, 400 degrees, 10 minutes and then reduce heat to about 350 degrees or less and bake very slowly until a silver knife will come out clean. This may be served in custard cups without pastry.

recipes.title: LEMON CREAM
directions: Separate eggs. In double boiler cook yolk, sugar, rind, and juice about 8 minutes or until like custard. Then add stiffly beaten whites and turn out in sherbet glasses. Serve cold.

recipes.title: LEMON PUDDING
directions: Heat milk, then add sugar. Meanwhile mix cornstarch with a little cold milk, and add the egg, well beaten. Add this mixture to the hot milk, and let boil till thick. Remove from fire, let cool, then add juice and grated rind of 1 lemon. Serve with whipped cream. This will make four servings.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE TAPIOCA
directions: Place all ingredients except tapioca in double boiler. When hot add tapioca; stirring until thick. Cook until tapioca is clear about 20 minutes. Serves 5 or 6. Serve with coffee cream or whipped cream.

recipes.title: ORANGE PARISIAN
ingredients: 2 fresh pears, or 4 canned pear halves
¼ cup fresh mint, finely chopped
2 tbsp. additional powdered sugar, for whipped cream
directions: Pare and slice oranges, reserving all juice that escapes. Cut pears in slices and mix with oranges. Divide into six portions, and place in sherbet glasses. Mix the juice from oranges, the sugar and the mint and pour over the fruit. Set in cold place until ready to serve. Serve topped with a spoonful of whipped cream, sweetened with 2 tbsp. powdered sugar.

recipes.title: FRESH PINEAPPLE CUP
directions: Boil sugar and water together for 5 minutes. Cool and add fruit juices. Cut fresh pineapple cylinders, using apple corer. Put in glasses with cocoanut and cover with the syrup.

recipes.title: TAPIOCA PUDDING
directions: Whipped cream

Soak tapioca over night in water to cover. In the morning add sugar and cook in double boiler until well done or tapioca is transparent. Cut and drain pineapple, and add it with nutmeats to whipped cream for top of pudding.

recipes.title: BLITZ TORTE
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add yolks and vanilla. Mix flour and baking powder. Add to first mixture, with milk. Spread in two shallow pans. Cover dough with 4 egg whites, beaten stiff, mixed with 3/4 cup sugar; and sprinkle with 1/4 cup almonds, sliced. Bake in moderate oven ( 300 degrees ) about 1/2 hour. Spread custard filling between layers. Custard filling: Beat 1 egg thoroughly, scald 1 cup milk, add ½ cup sugar. Stir 1 heaping tsp. cornstarch with a little of the milk and cook until thick. Remove from fire, and add ½ tsp. vanilla. Mrs. C. A. Buskirk.

recipes.title: CHEESE TORTE
directions: Outside: 1 pkg. zweibach or Holland rusk, put through food chopper, using finest knife. 1 cup sugar 1 tsp. cinnamon 1/4 cup melted butter Mix together. Butter tin and line bottom and sides, keeping out 1 cup of crumbs. Put in custard and cover with the remaining crumbs. Even off edge. Bake in torte pan 1/4 hours, at 350 degrees. Let cool. Remove sides of pan, place torte on platter and cut.

recipes.title: DATE TORTE
directions: Bake in slow oven about 3/4 hour in shallow pan. Top with whipped cream. Serves six people.

recipes.title: DATE TORTE
directions: Beat egg whites, then add yolks and other ingredients. Bake slowly in moderate oven, 325 degrees, for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: DATE DESSERT TORTE
directions: Beat egg yolks, add sugar gradually and beat well until they are light. Add chopped nuts and dates. Add flour and baking powder. Fold in beaten whites and the vanilla. Bake Torte in 2 layers in a slow oven ( 275 ° ) for 3/4 hour. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: NUT TORTE
ingredients: 1½ cups graham cracker crumbs, rolled medium fine
directions: Beat egg yolks, add sugar and cream well. Add cracker crumbs, baking powder, and pecans. Beat egg whites stiff, and fold into mixture. Bake at 300 degrees. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: MAPLE NUT TORTE
directions: Soak gelatine in water 5 minutes. Beat yolks lightly, add maple syrup and cook until well blended and thick. Add soaked gelatine and cool. Before it sets, fold in stiffly beaten egg whites, macaroons, nuts and whipped cream. Line mold with lady fingers, and pour in mixture. Chill. Unmold and garnish with whipped cream, whole nuts and candied fruits.

recipes.title: NUTZEN TART
ingredients: ½ cup plus 1 tbsp. flour, sifted with 1 tsp. baking powder
½ cup chopped nuts, for topping
directions: Put batter into two layer-cake pans. Make meringue with stiffly beaten egg whites and ½ cup sugar. Cover layers with meringue, sprinkle with ½ cup chopped nuts, and bake about 20 minutes in a slow oven (300°F). Use whipped cream and fruit, or custard, between layers. The source does not separately state a mixing method for the batter.

recipes.title: SCHAUM TARTE
directions: Beat egg whites lightly; add sugar gradually and beat vigorously until dissolved. Add vinegar and vanilla. Bake in two buttered cake tins lightly dusted with flour and sugar, in a very slow oven for 45 minutes.

Add one quart strawberries or other fruit. Crush half for the first layer and top with whole berries. At serving, cover with ½ pint whipped cream. The torte may be made a day ahead, but do not put fruit on until ready to serve. Serves eight.

recipes.title: DAINTY DESSERT
directions: Cut tops off of cream puff shells, fill with ice cream, and replace top. Serve with whipped cream and a cherry on top. It is not necessary to serve cake with this, as it is quite complete in itself.
**Variations:**
Fill shells with plain ice cream, leaving top off, cover with crushed strawberries, and whipped cream. Fill shells with pineapple sherbet, and cover with chocolate sauce.

recipes.title: STRAWBERRY CREAM PUFFS
directions: Cut berries into halves, cover with powdered sugar. Just before serving mix with whipped cream. Slit puff and insert filling.

recipes.title: STRAWBERRY MERINGUE CAKE
directions: Sift flour once, measure, add baking powder and sift together 3 times. Cream butter, add 1 cup sugar, and cream together until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks, then sifted flour, alternately with milk, a small amount at a time. Beat after each addition until smooth. Add vanilla. Bake in two 9 inch layer pans at 375 degrees for 25 minutes. Remove from pans and cool. Fold 1/2 cup sugar slowly into beaten whites. Place 2 layers on baking sheet. Pile meringue lightly on them and return to oven, baking 15 minutes at 350 degrees. Wash berries, and hull. Reserve choice ones for garnishing. Crush remainder of berries with ½ cup sugar. Spread between layers. Garnish top with whole berries and serve at once. Serves 8.

recipes.title: APPLE PUDDING
ingredients: Sliced apples, enough to cover bottom of dish
Sugar and butter, to sprinkle over apples (amounts not specified)
directions: Cover the bottom of a baking dish with sliced apples and sprinkle with sugar and dots of butter. Pour the batter over the apples. Bake 1 hour at 325°F.

recipes.title: APPLE ROLL
directions: Peel, core and slice apples. Put sugar and water in deep baking pan over slow fire. Make rich biscuit dough and roll out about 1/2 inch thick, spread with apples and roll into a long roll; cut into pieces about 1½ inches long; place with cut side down in hot syrup; put small piece of shortening on top and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake in a hot oven until apples are done and the crust a golden brown. Turn out on platter and pour syrup around them. May be served plain or with whipped cream. Cherries or peaches may be substituted for apples.

recipes.title: SCALLOPED APPLES
directions: Melt the butter and mix with the bread crumbs. Mix the apples, sugar, spices and water. Arrange the buttered crumbs and apple mixture in alternate layers. Reserve 1/2 the buttered crumbs for the top layer. Bake covered for 2½ hours. Serve with cream or fruit sauce.

recipes.title: APRICOT BREAD PUDDING
ingredients: Syrup from 1 can Del Monte peaches
directions: Soak bread crumbs in hot milk. Add sugar, syrup, beaten egg whites and a few apricots. Pour into a greased baking dish. Bake until firm and serve garnished with apricots.

recipes.title: BIRD NESTS
directions: sugar cinnamon
Pare, core and roll apples in sugar and cinnamon. Sift flour, baking powder and salt, add milk and beaten eggs. Pour over apples and bake until apples are done.

recipes.title: CHERRY PUDDING
ingredients: 1 egg, placed in a cup, with milk added to fill cup
directions: Sift dry ingredients and mix together; add to liquid ingredients gradually beating well as you go. Put a box of fresh cherries pitted and well sugared in bottom of baking dish. Cover with batter and bake until nice and brown about 35 minutes at 350 °. Other fruits may be used as well as cherries.

recipes.title: BROWN BETTY
ingredients: Water, to moisten the bottom of the dish
directions: Put in a baking dish a layer of sliced apples, sugar, butter and cinnamon. Add a layer of bread crumbs, alternate until dish is full with a layer of crumbs and butter on top. Cover bottom of dish with water. Bake 3/4 hour.

recipes.title: CHERRY CUP PUDDING
directions: Combine in order named. Butter cups, fill half full of cherries, then the batter. Steam about 15 minutes. Serve with the following sauce:
1 cup sugar 1 tbsp. flour butter size of a walnut

Juice from cherries. Add water if there is not enough juice. Let boil for a few minutes. This makes 4 cup puddings. Canned peaches make excellent puddings, using same batter and sauce recipes. If peaches are used add 1 teaspoon vanilla to sauce.

recipes.title: STEAMED CHERRY PUDDING
directions: Mix as you would a cake. Steam 1 hour. I use an angel food cake tin for mold. Serve with Foamy Sauce or a thickened sauce made of the juice.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE ROLL
directions: Beat egg yolks and sugar together. Add cocoa and vanilla. Add stiffly beaten whites. Spread in shallow pan, and bake 30 minutes at 300 degrees or less. Serves 4 or 5.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE STEAMED PUDDING
directions: Mix egg, sugar, milk, flour, salt and baking powder; add chocolate and butter melted together. Steam 1 hour in a coffee can or other suitable mold.
For the sauce, heat 1 cup cream; beat in ¾ lb. marshmallows with an egg beater until melted and foamy. Serve at once. Pudding can be kept and steamed again when wanted.

recipes.title: COTTAGE PUDDING
directions: Mix and bake like a cake 35 minutes at 350°. Serve with lemon or strawberry sauce.

recipes.title: LEMON SAUCE
ingredients: Lemon juice or zest, to taste
directions: Beat together until foamy 1 egg, and 1 cup sugar mixed with 1 scant tbsp. flour. Add nearly a pint of boiling water and butter size of a walnut. Let come to a boil and flavor with lemon. :

recipes.title: DATE PUDDING
directions: Soak dates cut up in boiling water until mixture cools. Cream butter and sugar, add eggs, flour, soda and grated rind of one orange. Add water and dates and bake in a greased pan in a very slow oven. Serve warm with the following sauce: 1 egg yolk, beaten 1 egg white beaten 2 tbsp. powdered sugar vanilla ½ bottle whipped cream Pudding may be kept and served later by steaming it when • wanted.

recipes.title: STEAMED DATE AND NUT PUDDING
directions: Mix as you would a cake, and steam 3 hours in a tube cake pan for mold. Serve with Foamy Sauce.

recipes.title: NEW ENGLAND INDIAN PUDDING
directions: Stir meal into hot water to make a mush, add other ingredients and bake very slowly 3 hours. Serve with melted butter or hardsauce.

recipes.title: FRUIT FRITTERS
directions: Thefruits that may be used in making these fritters are: thinly sliced apple, sliced fresh or canned peaches, stoned halved prunes, or sliced bananas. Sift together the dry ingredients, then beat in the milk, the egg yolks, beaten until creamy, and the Mazola. Stir in the fruit, fold in the egg whites, whipped, and drop by small tablespoonfuls into Mazola heated to 350 degrees F., sufficient to brown a bit of bread in a minute in a deep fat frying kettle. Cook ten minutes, drain on brown paper, dust with sugar and serve with fruit sauce or Karo.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE TART
directions: Arrange butter, brown sugar, pineapple and cherries in order in the bottom of a tart pan.

Batter: Beat eggs separately. Add water to yolks, then half the sugar. Add remaining sugar to stiffly beaten whites. Pour yolk mixture over whites and continue beating; add remaining batter ingredients and beat smooth. Pour over fruit and bake 1 hour at 325°F. Serve warm with whipped cream. Serves six.

recipes.title: PEACH COBBLER
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add egg beaten, milk and dry ingredients. In the bottom of a buttered baking dish put peaches. If canned peaches are used no sugar is needed, but sugar must be sprinkled on fresh peaches. Pour batter over peaches and bake 1 hour. Apples or other fruit may be substituted for peaches.

recipes.title: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients: 2 cups peaches, in bottom of basin
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Spread peaches in a buttered baking dish. Cream shortening and sugar; beat in egg, then add milk. Sift flour with baking powder and stir into the mixture. Pour batter over peaches and bake 35–45 minutes until the topping is golden and cooked through.

recipes.title: POOR MAN'S PUDDING
directions: Mix in order given, and steam 3 hours. 10 good sized servings. Sauce: 3 eggs vanilla 1 cup sugar nutmeg
Beat yolks, add sugar, and then beaten whites, and flavorings to taste. ( I use 1/3 or 23 of recipe, depending on number to be served).

recipes.title: PRUNE WHIP
directions: Whites of 3 eggs 3 lb. or 1 doz. prunes 1½ cup sugar 1 tbsp. lemon juice Cook prunes with sugar and lemon juice, then cool. Beat eggs and add prune mixture. Bake in buttered baking dish 20 or 30 minutes in hot oven. Set in pan of water to bake. Serve with soft custard or whipped cream.

recipes.title: RICE PUDDING
ingredients: 1 pint hot milk, for initial cooking
directions: Cook rice with 1 pint hot milk in a double boiler until tender. Add another pint hot milk, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and butter. Brown in oven, stirring several times.

recipes.title: RASPBERRY PUDDING
ingredients: ¾ tbsp. soda, dissolved in 1 tbsp. water
directions: Steam in small angel cake pan exactly 1 hour. Keep covered while steaming. Serve with whipped cream to which 3 tbsp. of Raspberry Jam has been added.

recipes.title: SAILOR'S DUFF PUDDING
ingredients: ½ tsp. soda, dissolved in ½ cup water
directions: Mix egg whites, molasses, butter, flour, and soda dissolved in water in order named. Steam ¾ hour.
Serve warm with a sauce of whipped cream, egg yolks, sugar and vanilla. Makes six servings.

recipes.title: STRAWBERRY MERINGUE
directions: Time: Preparation and baking, 30 minutes at 350°. 20 minutes at 335 °. Number served: 6 to 8 persons.
**Method:**

Soak bread crumbs in milk; when soft, add sugar, salt, beaten yolks, lemon rind, butter; mix. Pour into a shallow greased dish, and bake in a moderate oven until set about thirty minutes. When done, cover the top with berries, sweetened as necessary, and heap with stiff meringue made from the whites of eggs and powdered sugar. Brown in moderate oven. Serve cold. The pudding may be made several hours before serving, but the berries and meringue should both be added shortly before serving. Jam may be substituted for berries.

recipes.title: STEAMED MARMALADE PUDDING
directions: Cream shortening and sugar. Add beaten egg and marmalade. Mix baking powder and flour and add to mixture. Add milk if needed to moisten. Steam two and one-half hours. Time in cooking, 2½ hours. Recipe makes one small loaf. Serves four.

recipes.title: CARAMEL WHIPPED CREAM
ingredients: 3 tbsp. Karo, blue or orange label
directions: Beat the cream until thick, then gradually beat in the Karo and vanilla. The Karo keeps the cream from separating.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE SAUCE
ingredients: 4 sq. chocolate melted in double boiler
directions: Boil 10 minutes slowly then add ½ cup milk or cream gradually. Good hot poured over ice cream.

recipes.title: COLD CHOCOLATE SAUCE
directions: Scald milk, pour on flour and sugar mixed together, add egg beaten. Cook to a paste. Melt butter and chocolate and mix into the paste. Add powdered sugar, vanilla and salt and thin to desired consistency with milk. This will keep soft for days.

recipes.title: FLUFFY FRUIT SAUCE
directions: Use orange, pineapple, grape or loganberry juice. Beat the egg whites stiff and whip in the Karo and fruit juice. Serve at once. This is excellent instead of whipped cream.

recipes.title: FOAMY SAUCE
directions: have it) Beat eggs until yellow and thick, add sugar gradually, beating constantly. Fold in cream and flavoring.

recipes.title: LEMON SAUCE FOR PUDDINGS
directions: Boil mixture, then add small tbsp. cornstarch mixed with a little cold water. Add juice of 1 lemon and a little lemon extract, when you remove sauce from stove.

recipes.title: LEMON PUDDING SAUCE
directions: Boil sugar, butter and water, add beaten egg and cook gently until thick.

recipes.title: ORANGE SAUCE
ingredients: Grated rind and juice of 1 orange
directions: Cook sugar, lemon juice, orange rind and juice and egg yolks over a double boiler, stirring constantly until thick. Chill over ice; when cold, beat in ½ pint whipped cream. Serve with angel food cake. Makes a large recipe.

recipes.title: STRAWBERRY WHIP
directions: Beat with egg beater until the mixture is stiff. Serve as sauce for cake or custard.

recipes.title: PASTE
directions: Sift dry ingredients together into large mixing dish. Add lard, and mix with a pastry mixer, or lightly with the hands. Be careful not to mix too much. It is the small particles of lard which. rolled out, make the paste flaky. Store in a cold place. Add cold water to about 2 cups of this mixture for one double crust pie. Recipe makes about 5 double crust pies.

recipes.title: PIE CRUST
directions: together Mix ingredients in order given.

recipes.title: PIE CRUST
directions: Cut lard into flour and salt, add water slowly. Make into ball. put on floured board and roll out.

recipes.title: PIE CRUST
directions: Whisk flour, salt and baking powder. Cut in shortening until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add cold water a little at a time and gather into a dough. Chill 20–30 minutes, then roll out and fit a 9-inch pie dish; this amount makes one crust, not a full double-crust pie.

For a filled pie, start at 475°F for 5 minutes, then reduce to 375°F and bake until the filling is cooked and the pastry is golden; timing depends on the filling. For a blind-baked shell, line with weights, bake at 400°F for 12–15 minutes, remove weights and continue until golden.

recipes.title: HOT WATER PIE CRUST
directions: Add boiling water to lard and salt. Sift in flour and baking powder. Let stand until cold, and store in a covered glass jar in refrigerator. Makes 2 double crust pies.

recipes.title: APPLE PIE
directions: Line tin with pastry, building it up around the edge. Mix flour, sugars and spices. Sprinkle a very little flour over the bottom crust, and add a little of the sugar mixture, and mix gently with the fingers. ( This is to keep the bottom crust from becoming soggy. ) Place about half of the sliced apples in the tin, and add about half of the sugar mixture. Then add remaining apples and rest of sugar mixture. Dot generously with butter. Cut the top crust just large enough to cover apples without reaching under crust. Bake 400 degrees 10 minutes 375 degrees 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: BUTTERSCOTCH PIE
directions: Pour boiling water on sugar. Sift dry ingredients with 2 tbsp. white sugar. Add to first mixture. Cook in double boiler until thick. (About 30 minutes.) Separate eggs, beat yolks. Stir a little of thick mixture into eggs, then add eggs to mixture; cook 1 minute longer. Remove from fire, add vanilla and butter and put in baked pie crust. Beat egg whites, add ½ tsp. baking powder, beat till creamy. Put in oven and brown.

recipes.title: BUTTERSCOTCH PIE
directions: Melt together then add: 2 tbsp. corn starch Put 2 cups milk in double boiler, when warm add sugar mixture, yolks of 2 eggs and cook until thick. Flavor with vanilla. Beat whites of eggs and put on top and brown.

recipes.title: BUTTERSCOTCH PIE
directions: Beat egg yolks and milk together, add butter, place over fire in double boiler. Mix brown sugar and flour thoroughly. Add to first mixture when hot, stirring frequently. Add vanilla after taking off stove. Pour into the baked shell, cover with merigue made from the 2 egg whites beaten stiff with 2 tbsp. granulated sugar. Brown in medium oven 350 degrees for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: CHESS CAKES
directions: Cream sugar and butter, add egg yolks, and beat until creamy. Add vanilla and cocoanut. Line gem pans with rich pie crust, and place a spoonful of above mixture in each shell. Bake at 350 degrees until a golden brown. Makes one dozen. This is a splendid way of using egg yolks when making an angel food cake. Serve as French Pastry.

recipes.title: COCOANUT CREAM PIE
directions: Mix cornstarch with a little cold water. Add rest of water, milk, and salt. Cook in double boiler until thickened, stirring constantly. Add cocoanut, eggs slightly beaten, and vanilla. Pour into plate lined with pastry and bake until firm. Time in combining, 5 minutes. Temperature, 400° 10 minutes, 325° 30 minutes.

recipes.title: CREAM PIE
directions: Cook 6 tbsp. sugar, egg yolk, cornstarch, and milk until mixture thickens. Add vanilla, and pour into baked crust. Beat egg white until stiff, and fold in 1 tbsp. sugar. Place on top of filling. Bake for 20 minutes at 325 degrees.

recipes.title: CREAM PIE FILLING
directions: Beat well together. 1 pt. milk in double boiler heating. Cook till thick.

recipes.title: DATE PIE
directions: Cook all except the nutmeats together until thick. Cool and add the nutmeats. Place in a pastry shell, cover with meringue and brown.

recipes.title: LEMON FLUFF PIE FILLING
directions: Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored. Gradually add half of the sugar. Mix thoroughly and add grated rind and juice of lemon. Add boiling water slowly. Cook in top of double boiler to thin custard stage. Beat whites until firm. Gradually add remaining sugar. Fold the meringue into the custard. Fill baked crust.

recipes.title: LEMON PIE
ingredients: Grated rind and juice of 1–2 lemons
directions: Beat eggs well. Add cold water and lemon juice and rind. Mix the sugar and flour and add to the eggs. Cook slowly in double boiler, stirring constantly. When filling has thickened, remove from stove, add butter, and beat until cool enough to pour into baked pastry shell.

recipes.title: LEMON PIE FILLING
directions: Cook in double boiler until thick enough. Cover with stiffly beaten egg whites to which has been added 2 tbsp. confectioner's sugar. Fill pie crust. Place in hot oven to brown.

recipes.title: LEMON PIE
directions: Mix and cook in double boiler until thick, stirring constantly. When cool fold in beaten whites of 2 eggs to which 1 tablespoon of sugar was added after the whites are stiff. Put in baked pie shell. Beat remaining 2 egg whites, add 1 tablespoon sugar and beat again. Place on top of filling, and brown in oven at 325 degrees for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: LEMON PIE
directions: Mix flour, sugar, water, and egg yolks. Cook until thick. Take from fire and add butter and the grated rind and juice of the lemon. Use whites of eggs for meringue.

recipes.title: LEMON PIE
directions: Grate rind and extract juice of lemon. Put first four ingredients on stove to boil. Beat egg yolks well, add 2 to 3 tbsp. water and cornstarch, and add to first mixture when it boils. Cook until it thickens, and pour into a baked crust. Beat egg whites stiff. Sprinkle on 1 tbsp. sugar, and fold in. Add to top of pie, and bake 20 minutes at 325 degrees.

recipes.title: LUNCHEON PIES
ingredients: For shells: 1½ cups flour and ½ cup lard
directions: Make pastry from flour and lard with a little cold water. Roll and shape it over the backs of muffin tins; bake at 400°F until golden, about 12–15 minutes, then cool. For filling, simmer sugar, raisins, boiling water and butter until softened. Whisk egg yolks with cornstarch and some hot liquid to temper, then stir back into pan; cook gently until thick. Fold in nuts, cool completely and fill pastry shells. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: ORANGE PIE
directions: Mix sugar, flour, cornstarch and enough cold water to moisten. Add the hot water and bring to the boiling point directly over the heat, stirring continuously. Remove from the heat, add orange juice and rind, stir until well mixed and cook in double boiler for 20 minutes. Add butter, lemon, and slightly beaten egg yolks, and cook until eggs thicken, about 3 minutes. Cool slightly and pour into baked crust. Cover with meringue and bake at 325 degrees for about 12 minutes.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE PIE
directions: Time: Preparation and baking. Bake 30 minutes 400°. Bake meringue 15 minutes 325°.
**Method:**

Pare pineapple, chop fine. Measure three cupfuls. Add sugar, cook until tender, about thirty minutes. Add flour moistened with water cook five minutes. Remove from fire, add yolks and salt. Line a pie-plate with a well-made paste, rolled thin. Pour in the pineapple, bake in a hot oven thirty minutes. Beat whites until stiff,

adding pinch of salt; add powdered sugar gradually. Heap meringue on top of pie, sprinkle with sugar, brown in moderate oven. Serve cool. For a flaky paste, allow one-third cupful shortening to threefourths cupful flour. Work one-half into flour, moisten with ice water, pat, roll out; fold in remainder, pat, roll; repeat.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE PIE
directions: yolks 3 eggs Cream together sugar, butter and cornstarch, and then add egg yolks, then pineapple and juice. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites and bake in one rich crust which has not been previously baked. Bake 5 minutes at 400 degrees and 30 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: PUMPKIN PIE
directions: Mix in order given and bake slowly in raw crust. This recipe never fails. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes and then at 350 degrees for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: PUMPKIN PIE
directions: Mix pumpkin with milk, sugar, and well beaten eggs, ginger salt and cinnamon. Beat 2 minutes. Pour in unbaked pie crust. Put in hot oven, 400 degrees, for fifteen minutes. Reduce heat and bake forty- five minutes or more at 350 degrees. To bring out flavor of pumpkin it must be well baked.

recipes.title: RHUBARB CUSTARD PIE
directions: Pour enough boiling water over rhubarb to almost cover, add sugar, flour, butter. Bring to boiling point, cook until smooth and thick. Beat one whole egg and 1 yolk and stir in. Turn into piepan lined with unbaked shell. Bake until crust is done. Use white of egg to make merignue and brown in oven.

recipes.title: COCKTAIL SAUCE
directions: Mix and chill. Good for any meat. The amount of horseradish varies with the strength.

recipes.title: CHILI SAUCE
directions: Core and chop tomatoes, onions and peppers. Put cinnamon and cloves in a tied spice bag. Combine vegetables, vinegar, brown sugar and salt in a heavy pot; add spice bag. Simmer uncovered over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, about 60–90 minutes or until thick enough to spoon. Remove spice bag. Refrigerate after cooling.

recipes.title: A WINTER CHILI SAUCE
directions: Chop tomatoes, green peppers and onions. Combine with sugar, cloves, vinegar and cinnamon in a heavy saucepan. Simmer uncovered over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, about 45–75 minutes until reduced to a spoonable sauce. Cool and refrigerate.

recipes.title: UNCOOKED CHILI SAUCE
directions: Chop or grind vegetables, mix all ingredients and let stand in crock. It makes 1 gallon.

recipes.title: CHILI SAUCE
directions: Cook tomatoes, peppers, and onions 1 hour. Add the remaining ingredients and cook until thick.

recipes.title: PEPPER HASH
directions: Chop fine and cover with boiling water. Let stand 10 minutes, and drain water off and cover again with fresh water and let it come to a boil. Drain again and add 1 pt. of vinegar, 1½ cups white sugar, 1 tbsp. salt and boil 15 or 20 minutes. Put in cans.

recipes.title: RELISH
directions: Grind tomatoes, peppers, cucumber and onions. Add vinegar, sugar, seeds and salt. Cook for 30 minutes. Put in jars and seal.

recipes.title: WINTER SALAD
ingredients: 2 qts. vinegar, dilute if very strong
directions: Slice green tomatoes and let stand over night in brine. Then drain and chop. Parboil onions in weak vinegar water about 10 minutes. Chop red peppers and mix all together. Mix turmeric, mustard seed, salt and sugar and vinegar and heat. Then let cool and pour over chopped ingredients.

recipes.title: CORN RELISH
ingredients: 24 ears corn, kernels cut from cob
directions: Cook the corn, peppers, onions, cabbage, salt, and first quart of vinegar for 20 minutes. Add chopped cucumbers, sugar, ground mustard, mustard seed, celery seed, and another quart of vinegar. Mix and cook 20 minutes more. Seal tightly in jars.

recipes.title: CORN RELISH
directions: Cut corn from cob, put celery, cabbage, onions, and peppers through food chopper, using coarse knife. Add the mustard seed, vinegar, salt and sugar, and cook slowly for one hour. Recipe makes `eleven quarts of relish.

recipes.title: CUCUMBER RELISH
directions: Peel and slice thin. Soak in salt water for a few hours. Drain. Take 1 pt. of vinegar and add 1 cup sugar, 1 tsp. white mustard seed, 1 tsp. celery seed, 1 tsp. whole allspice and 2 level tsp. turmeric. Cook all together until tender and can.

recipes.title: SWEET TOMATO PICKLES
directions: Sprinkle salt on tomatoes and onions, and let stand over night. Drain, and add water and vinegar. Boil 15 minutes then drain again and throw the vinegar and water away. Add to the pickle: 2 lbs. sugar 2 tbsp. mustard 2 qts. vinegar 2 tbsp. allspice 2 tbsp. cloves 2 tbsp. cinnamon 2 tbsp. ginger 1 tsp. cayenne Boil 15 minutes. (Allspice and cloves should be tied in bag. ) Will keep in stone jar.

recipes.title: CELERY ICE PICKLES
ingredients: Medium cucumbers, enough to fill the jars
directions: Cut scrubbed cucumbers lengthwise and soak in ice water for 4 hours. Put an onion slice, celery pieces and celery seed in each clean jar; pack with drained cucumbers. Bring vinegar, sugar and salt to a boil, then cool completely before pouring over cucumbers. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: TURMERIC PICKLES
directions: Let stand in weak brine two hours. Boil together 1 qt. vinegar, 1/2 cup salt, 3 cups brown sugar, 1 tbsp. celery seed and ½ tsp. turmeric powder. Thicken with 2 tbsp. flour in a little water. Drain pickles and onions, put all together and boil ten minutes.

recipes.title: OIL PICKLES
directions: Let the sliced cucumbers stand with the salt for 3 hours. Drain; add small onions, white pepper, mustard seed, celery seed and olive oil. Cover with vinegar and seal in cans.

recipes.title: SLICED PICKLES
ingredients: 2 stalks celery. Slice and let stand in salt water over night.
directions: Do not peel cucumbers 1 qt. vinegar (dilute a little) 2 cups sugar 1 tsp. mustard seed 1 tsp. black pepper 1 tsp. turmeric powder Put all together and let boil up good, but not too long so as to make pickles soft.

recipes.title: SMALL CUCUMBER PICKLES
ingredients: Small cucumbers, enough to fill jars
directions: Scrub pickles and pack into jars. To one gallon of vinegar add 1 cup mustard, 1 cup salt and 2 cups sugar. Spice to taste. Mix and pour over pickles cold. Seal jars and invert for several days until mustard has worked through well.

recipes.title: ARISTOCRAT PICKLES
ingredients: Strong salt brine, to cover vegetables
directions: Slice the cucumbers. Blanch onions briefly with boiling water, then peel; chop sweet peppers. Soak cucumbers and onions separately in strong brine for 3 hours, then drain well. Bring vinegar, sugar, mustard seeds and celery seeds to a boil. Add vegetables and gently boil 10 minutes. Cool and refrigerate.

recipes.title: MUSTARD PICKLES
directions: To 1 Gal. of pickles add: - 1 cup salt 1 cup sugar Vinegar to cover 1 cup mustard

recipes.title: CHUNK PICKLES
ingredients: Pinch powdered alum (historical ingredient; omit in edited preparation)
directions: Soak whole cucumbers in strong brine for 3 days. Drain and soak in fresh water for 3 days, changing water daily. Cut into chunks and simmer gently in weak vinegar until tender, about 1–2 hours; drain. Boil brown sugar, vinegar, cinnamon, celery seed and allspice into a syrup and pour over the chunks. Drain, reheat and pour back the syrup once daily for 3 days. Cool and refrigerate.

recipes.title: CHUNK PICKLES
directions: Cover cucumber chunks and salt with water; let stand 3 days. Drain and soak in clear water 3 days. Drain, then cook in weak vinegar with a small piece of alum for 2 hours. Combine syrup ingredients and bring to a boil; pour over pickles and can.

recipes.title: RIPE CUCUMBER PICKLES
ingredients: 2 tsp. powdered alum (historical ingredient; omitted in edited preparation)
directions: Peel very ripe yellow cucumbers; discard seeds and soft centers, and cut firm flesh into strips. Simmer strips very briefly in water, then drain and chill. Tie cloves and cinnamon in a spice bag. Simmer vinegar, sugar, salt and spice bag until sugar dissolves. Add cucumber strips and simmer 10–15 minutes, then cool in syrup. Refrigerate overnight; drain and reheat syrup once more before storing refrigerated.

recipes.title: CURRANT RELISH
directions: Grate outside of orange, pare off white and slice inside. Mix, and cook until as thick as jelly.

recipes.title: SPICED CURRANTS
directions: Boil ½ hour, seal in glass jars. Brown sugar may be used and gooseberries or cherries may be used in place of currants.

recipes.title: CHERRY AND RASPBERRY CONSERVE
directions: Add raisins and nuts if desired. Boil until it jells.

recipes.title: SPICED GOOSEBERRIES
directions: Cook until thick. Put in jelly glasses. Delicious with meats.

recipes.title: MINT JELLY
directions: Let this come to boil. Strain and dissolve 1 pkg. lemon Jello in this liquid. As it begins to set stir ½ cup green cherries in it.

recipes.title: PEAR JAM
directions: The pears should be peeled and run through food chopper. The figs are also run through the chopper. Grate the yellow off the oranges and lemon, being careful not to get any of the white, as that makes it bitter. Remove the white and seeds, put rest of fruit through the chopper. Add the grated rind and sugar. Boil slowly. This doesn't have to be sealed air tight.

recipes.title: PEACH CONSERVE
ingredients: 3 oranges, grated rind of 2, juice of 3
directions: Combine peaches, pineapple, sugar, orange juice and grated orange zest in a wide heavy pan. Bring to a simmer; cook, stirring often, approximately 1¼ hours, until the fruit is translucent and the conserve has visibly thickened. Cool and refrigerate. Makes about 12–14 small glasses.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE JAM
ingredients: Sugar, 1 lb. per 1 lb. prepared pineapple
directions: Grate pineapples or put them through the grinder. Allow 1 lb. sugar to 1 lb. fruit. Cook 3/4 hour or until clear. Put in glasses and seal.

recipes.title: PEACH CONSERVE
directions: Slice peaches thin. Add sugar, and cook until it begins to thicken, then add cherries, cut in small pieces, and cook until thick as conserve.

recipes.title: ORANGE MARMALADE
directions: First day: Wash and slice whole fruit very thin. Cover with cold water. Second day: Put above on to boil, slowly, until tender, about 1 hour. Pinch between finger to try. Remove from fire, and add 4 lbs. sugar while mixture is hot. Stir several times while cooling. Third day: Put on stove again, and bring to boil, stirring often to prevent burning. Let boil several hours, until it will jell. Makes 11 glasses. Use porcelain, enamel, or aluminum kettle, and wooden spoon.

recipes.title: ORANGE MARMALADE
directions: Wash and slice fruit-the thinner the better and let stand 12 hours in 1 gallon water. Bring to boiling point, add sugar, which has been heated in the oven, and boil slowly for 1½ hour. If put in glasses it will thicken.

recipes.title: RHUBARB AND FIG PRESERVES
directions: Cut rhubarb into inch pieces and figs into strips. Add juice and grated rind of lemons, orange peel and sugar. Let stand in preserving kettle over night. Cook slowly about 1 hour or until figs are tender. Stir occasionally.

recipes.title: STRAWBERRY PRESERVES
directions: Put in large kettle, covering berries with sugar. Put over simmering burner, turned as low as possible, until sugar dissolves. Turn on gas full, and let cook vigorously for 10 minutes. Set aside to cool all night. Can cold in sterilized jars in the morning. 8 cups berries make 2/2 qts. preserves. 3 qts. berries make 8 cups. If you double recipe, use 2 kettles.

recipes.title: STRAWBERRY PRESERVES
directions: Cover with boiling water and let stand 5 minutes. Drain. Add 4 cups sugar and boil 7 minutes. Add 2 more cups sugar and let boil 5 minutes. Pour into glasses.

recipes.title: STRAWBERRY AND PINEAPPLE JAM
directions: Mix fruit and sugar and boil gently for ten minutes. Add pectin and boil rapidly for five minutes. Pour into hot sterilized jars. Time in combining, 5 minutes. Time in cooking, 15 minutes. Recipe makes six 6-ounce jars.

recipes.title: PICKLED PEACHES
directions: Pare peaches by pouring hot water over them, then put 3 cloves in each peach. For each quart of peaches, make a syrup of 2 cups of sugar and one cup of vinegar, with some stick cinnamon in it. After syrup boils put in peaches and boil (8) minutes.

recipes.title: WATER MELON RIND PICKLES
directions: Cut peeled rind in pieces, and put into kettle with 1 gal. water and salt. Let stand over night. Boil in same brine until tender. Rinse and drain well and wipe dry. Add sugar to vinegar, and spices in a bag, boil 20 minutes. Add fruit and boil 40 minutes. Let stand over night. Then bring to boiling point again; remove from stove and add cherries. Put into stone jar. (These are delicious, and look so pretty, with the red coloring. )

recipes.title: FRENCH DRESSING
directions: Beat or shake in closed bottle until creamy.

recipes.title: TASTY FRENCH DRESSING
directions: Mix well, chill and serve on crisp head lettuce. A hard boiled egg mashed may be added to this dressing just before serving.

recipes.title: FRENCH DRESSING, ONE PINT
directions: oil and vinegar

Put seasonings in a pint Mason jar, and fill one half full with a good salad oil or olive oil. Finish filling jar with one half cider vinegar and one half tarragon vinegar. Place rubber and top on jar, and shake hard until mixture is creamy.

recipes.title: TOMATO FRENCH DRESSING
directions: Put seasonings in a cold bowl, the inside of which has been rubbed with the clove of garlic. Then add the oil slowly, while beating constantly. Next add the lemon juice and catsup, continuing to beat until thickened. Serve very cold. Serves 8.

recipes.title: MAZOLA MAYONNAISE
directions: Mix dry ingredients; then add egg and stir. Add Mazola oil a tablespoon full at a time, beating continually with Dover egg beater. At last add vinegar or lemon juice and beat in thoroughly.

recipes.title: MAYONNAISE
directions: Make a paste of cornstarch and water and cook until thick. Mix all other ingredients, and add paste and beat well with rotary beater. Chill.

recipes.title: COOKED MAYONNAISE WITH OIL
ingredients: 1 cup cold water, for white sauce
1 cup oil, added gradually while hot
directions: Make a white sauce with 3 tbsp. oil, flour and cold water. While hot, gradually pour in 1 cup of oil. The source gives no further mixing directions for the egg yolks and seasonings. Nice for Thousand Island Dressing.

recipes.title: SALAD DRESSING
directions: Beat well egg yolks and the 2 tbsp. water. Put dry ingredients into a bowl, and beat in gradually the first mixture. Add vinegar and water. Cook until thick. Add butter. When cool add stiffly beaten egg whites.

recipes.title: SALAD DRESSING
directions: Put sugar, salt, flour, mustard, eggs in double boiler and mix well. Add diluted vinegar, stir and set on stove to cook. When thick add butter and milk, stirring continually. This will keep indefinitely.

recipes.title: SALAD DRESSING
directions: Sift dry ingredients, add eggs slowly, vinegar and butter. Cook until it thickens. Beat smooth with egg beater.

recipes.title: HOME SALAD DRESSING
directions: Mix dry ingredients, adding water, vinegar, and eggs. Cook in double boiler until thick and creamy, stirring frequently. Pour into jar and when cool, cover. Thin with whipped cream, sour or sweet cream, or French dressing.

recipes.title: BOILED DRESSING
directions: Mix dry ingredients, add egg yolks slightly beaten, butter, milk, and vinegar very slowly. Cook over boiling water until thick; strain and cool.

recipes.title: SALAD DRESSING
directions: Mix dry ingredients, add egg; mix well and stir in vinegar and water; cook in double boiler until thick. Very good and easy to make.

recipes.title: THOUSAND ISLAND DRESSING
directions: Chop green pepper, pimento, onion, parsley and eggs fine; mix in chili sauce. Beat vinegar with the Mazola oil. Add sugars, dry mustard, lemon juice and salt; mix and shake well. Serve over lettuce.

recipes.title: THOUSAND ISLAND DRESSING
directions: Run vegetables through a food chopper or chop fine with egg. Mix with mayonnaise and chili sauce.

recipes.title: THOUSAND ISLAND DRESSING
directions: Chop above very fine. Mix with 1/2 cup good oil mayonnaise and 1/2 cup chili sauce. Onion may be added if desired.

recipes.title: THOUSAND ISLAND DRESSING
ingredients: 1 bunch chives or a little onion
directions: Put olives, green pepper, pimento and beet through food chopper or chop fine. Press egg through sieve and add with mayonnaise vinegar and seasoning. Just before serving fold in whipped cream.

recipes.title: ONE PT. 1000 ISLAND DRESSING
directions: Chop eggs, pickles, pimento, onion and green pepper very fine. Finish filling a pint jar with one-third chili sauce and two-thirds oil mayonnaise.

recipes.title: DRESSING FOR CABBAGE SALAD
ingredients: ½ cup cream, sweet or sour
directions: Mix dry ingredients, and stir in hot vinegar slowly. Boil until very thick. Add cream immediately, stirring until smooth. Condensed milk may be used in place of cream, and add a little butter. Salt chopped cabbage and add dressing. Recipe makes enough for a large head of cabbage.
CREAM CHEESE DRESSING FOR FRUIT SALAD 1 cream cheese 2 tbsp. cream 1 tbsp. lemon juice 1 glass currant jelly 3/4 cup whipped cream salt
Mix cheese to a paste with the cream, add currant jelly and stir thoroughly. Add whipped cream. Use over fruit salad that has been mixed with regular dressing.

recipes.title: FRUIT SALAD DRESSING
directions: Mix in order given, and cook in double boiler until thick.

recipes.title: A GOOD CABBAGE DRESSING
directions: To condensed milk, gradually add vinegar to which salt, paprika and pepper have been mixed. Stir until thoroughly blended. Soak cabbage at least an hour in ice water to make crisp. Dry and cut fine. Mix with dressing when ready to serve. Finely chopped green pepper may be added.

recipes.title: ADIRONDACK SALAD
directions: Mix with mayonnaise (thinned with whipped cream if desired).

recipes.title: ALMOND AND PICKLE SALAD
directions: Cook vinegar and sugar until it spins a thread. Soak gelatine in pineapple juice, and dissolve in hot syrup. Blanch and slice almonds, slice pickles, and add with pineapple to first mixture when it is cool. Mold. Serve on lettuce with mayonnaise. Serves 12.

recipes.title: ALMOND PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients: ½ cup whipped cream (added before serving)
directions: Blanch almonds in boiling water, then pour off the water, cover with cold water, drain, and rub to remove skins. Split almonds and mix with sliced pineapple. For dressing, mix the eggs, sugar, pineapple juice, vinegar, salt, and butter; cook until thick. Cool and mix with fruit. Let stand overnight. Add ½ cup whipped cream before serving. Serves 4–6.

recipes.title: DELICIOUS CANNED ASPARAGUS SALAD
directions: Heat asparagus tips. Cover with french dressing while still hot. Stand aside to chill. Serve by draining stalks, laying on lettuce with portion of mayonnaise on plate.

recipes.title: RIPE BANANA SALAD
directions: Moisten cream cheese with cream until thin enough to pipe through a pastry tube. Make roses of cream cheese in nests of cut bananas and nuts. Put red cherry pieces in each center. Serve on lettuce. Time in combining: 20 minutes.

recipes.title: BREAKFAST SALAD
ingredients: 1 tomato slice, ½ inch thick, per serving
Scrambled eggs, about 1 egg per serving
3 thin slices cooked ham per serving
directions: On two or three leaves of head lettuce, place a center slice of tomato about half inch thick. In center of tomato place some scrambled eggs. On top of eggs place 3 very thin slices of boiled ham cut in two. Lay ham on top of eggs in a row. Add French dressing.

recipes.title: BUTTERFLY SALAD
directions: Cut slices of pineapple in half, and turn outside edges in, so as to give the appearance of the wings of a butterfly. Place as the body a date, sliced lengthwise. Use at the head 2 small, thin strips of pimento. Place on each wing slices of stuffed olive. Garnish with mayonnaise and serve on lettuce.

recipes.title: CABBAGE IN SOUR CREAM DRESSING
directions: Chop the cabbage very finely, and cook in boiling water for fifteen minutes. Drain and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Mix the egg, cream, butter, and sugar. Bring to the boiling-point and pour over the cabbage. Sprinkle with the paprika and the pepper.

recipes.title: CABBAGE AND SHRIMP SALAD
ingredients: Finely chopped green pepper, for garnish
directions: Clean shrimp and remove dark vein. Break into pieces and combine with shredded cabbage. Mix with French dressing; let stand 1 hour. Chill, moisten with mayonnaise and garnish with chopped green pepper.

recipes.title: CALIFORNIA SALAD
directions: Put all through food chopper raw. Press tightly into moulds. Serve on lettuce leaf and add mayonnaise on top.

recipes.title: CHERRY SALAD
directions: Drain 1 can of Del Monte cherries. Remove pits and put 1/2 pecan meat in each. Arrange on lettuce and serve with Mayonnaise.

recipes.title: OVERNIGHT WHITE CHERRY SALAD
ingredients: ½ pint cream, whipped, to fold in after dressing
directions: Drain the fruit and cut into pieces, halving the cherries. Cook the dressing ingredients in a double boiler until thick. Add the cooked dressing to fruit and mix thoroughly. Fold in ½ pint whipped cream; let stand until the following day.

recipes.title: CRAB MEAT SALAD
ingredients: 1/4 of a green pepper or pimentos
directions: Remove bones from crab meat and separate meat. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well and pile on nests of chilled lettuce. (Lobster may be used instead of crab meat. )

recipes.title: STUFFED CUCUMBER SALAD
directions: Cut a cucumber in pieces about 1½ inches long. Then cut away strips horizontally, leaving striped green and white effect. Now scoop out the centers of the cucumber slices to form cups. Marinate with French Dressing, and let stand in refrigerator for 1 hour. Chop pulp fine. Chop yolks of hard cooked eggs and add butter, the sardines and parsley. Mix well and add the cucumber pulp at the last moment. Fill the cucumber cups with the mixture piled high in the centers, and top with pimento and whites of eggs cut in long strips.

recipes.title: CUCUMBER, CELERY, AND ALMOND SALAD
directions: Chill the cucumber well. Then peel and cut crosswise into thin slices. Place the washed and chilled lettuce on eight individual plates. Arrange the cucumber and diced celery on same. Top with salted nuts and Tomato French Dressing.

recipes.title: MIXED FRUIT SALAD
directions: Mix fruit and nuts and chill. Serve with dressing. Time in combining, 15 minutes. Twice recipe enough for six large servings.

recipes.title: DRESSING
directions: Beat yolks of eggs, add butter and sugar creamed together, vinegar, lemon juice, oil, mustard, salt, and paprika. Cook in double boiler until thick, stirring constantly. Cool and add cream. Pour over salad and serve.

recipes.title: GRAPEFRUIT SALAD
directions: Arrange sections of grapefruit on individual salad plates to make a half sphere. Around in place half leaves of lettuce to form border. Just outside grapefruit, make a wreath of shreds of curled celery (stand cut celery in iced water several hours). Pour over Glace Fruit Dressing.

recipes.title: GLACÉ FRUIT DRESSING
directions: Make a French dressing of the first four and add the glaced fruits. Other glaced fruits may be substituted.

recipes.title: LOBSTER SALAD
ingredients: Cooked asparagus tips, about equal to the cucumber
Cooked lobster meat, about equal to the cucumber
directions: Dice a cucumber. Let stand in ice water to chill, then drain and dry on a food cloth. Measure the cucumber and add an equal amount of cold cooked asparagus tips and small firm bits of lobster. Season to taste with salt, pepper, and French dressing. Arrange in a mound on bed of lettuce leaves. Arrange the flesh from the large claws and the tail of the lobster around the mound. Garnish with quarters of chilled firm tomatoes. Press the coral of the lobster a sieve and add one-half cup of mayonnaise dressing. Serve the sauce separately. Time in combining, 15 minutes. Recipe makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: ITALIAN SALAD
directions: Cook macaroni in salted water, plunge it into cold water, and drain. Soak cucumber, onion, and celery (diced) in salt and water for a few moments. Drain. Mix all ingredients and let stand in a cool place one hour before serving. Time in combining, 20 minutes. Recipe makes eight servings.

recipes.title: MACARONI LUNCHEON SALAD
ingredients: 2 cups elbow macaroni, cooked and chilled
¼ cup stuffed olives, sliced crosswise
directions: Mix and serve on lettuce leaf. Garnish with mayonnaise, and stuffed olives. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: NATURE'S THUMB PRINT SALAD
directions: Mold in pt. of lemon Jello and serve on leaf lettuce with salad dressing.

recipes.title: ORANGE AND ONION SALAD
directions: Peel oranges and cut in thin slices. Cut onion in very fine shreds, add to orange and let stand for several hours in a cold place. Arrange on lettuce and serve with French dressing dressing.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE - GRAPEFRUIT SALAD
directions: Arrange on a lettuce leaf sections of grapefruit (taken out of the membrane) and pieces of pineapple. Dress with whipped cream made very sweet.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients: 1 cup pineapple juice, drained from can
½ lb. mild cream cheese, grated
Cold water, enough to soften gelatin
Lettuce leaves and mayonnaise, for serving
directions: juice from can of pineapple (1 cup) juice of 2 lemons 1 cup sugar 1 pkg. Knox's Gelatine ½ lb. cheese ( New York cheese or mild cream cheese) 1 can shredded pineapple drained from juice; Served with mayonnaise Cook juice with sugar until dissolved, when cool add gelatine which has been dissolved in enough cold water to moisten and dissolved with ½ cup boiling water; add juice of 2 lemons; when it starts to set fold it into shredded pineapple and grated cheese, then ½ pt. of whipping cream last. Secret is to have everything cold when mixed. Put into mold in individual molds or in large mold and cut and serve on lettuce leaf with mayonnaise.

recipes.title: PRINCESS SALAD
ingredients: 1 ripe tomato slice, peeled, per serving
directions: On bed of lettuce place a peeled slice of ripe tomato. On top of tomato place five asparagus tips. On tips put strips of green peppers and pimentos. Add French dressing.

recipes.title: POINSETTA SALAD
ingredients: Whipped cream or soft cheese, for rosettes
directions: On a bed of lettuce place a whole ripe tomato, peeled. Slit tomato 5 times from top to stem end, but base left intact. Fold back petals and place a short spear of asparagus in center of petals. Put a little rosette of whipped cream or cheese at each opening between petals. Sprinkle center with chopped green pepper and yolks of hard boiled eggs. Add French dressing.

recipes.title: SNOW SALAD
directions: Make a custard of the egg yolks and milk and sweeten with sugar. Cool. Remove stones from cherries. Mix pineapple and cherries and cut pears in dice. Add marshmallows cut in pieces and lemon juice to the fruit. Stir in custard and fold in cream, which has been whipped. Let stand in a cool place for twenty-four hours. Scoop out individual servings to represent snowballs. Serve on lettuce or as a dessert without the lettuce. Time in combining, 30 minutes. Recipe makes twenty- four servings.

recipes.title: SHRIMP SALAD
ingredients: 2 cans shrimp, drained, cleaned and chopped
directions: Stir relish into mayonnaise and set aside briefly. Reserve outer lettuce leaves for serving; shred inner leaves. Combine shrimp, eggs, celery and shredded lettuce with salt. Fold in dressing, then serve on reserved leaves. Serves 10–12.

recipes.title: TUNA FISH SALAD
directions: Shred tuna fish, and mix well with other ingredients, adding salad dressing enough to moisten. Serve on lettuce.

recipes.title: MOLDED ASPARAGUS
directions: Wash and scrape asparagus and cut into inch lengths. Put into a sauce pan with water and salt and cook until tender. Add boiling water to have 1 cup water on asparagus. Blend butter and flour and stir into asparagus. Stir with a fork and cook until thick. Beat eggs well with a Dover egg beater and stir until first mixture thickens. Remove from the fire and fold in the cream. Turn into six molds rubbed with olive oil, and when cool, place on ice to chill. Unmold and serve on lettuce.

recipes.title: JELLIED CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients: 1 cup boiling chicken broth, free from fat
directions: Dissolve Jello in boiling broth. Chill. When cold and slightly thickened, beat with egg beater until consistency of whipped cream. Mix chicken, celery, pimento, vinegar, and pepper. Serve with mayonnaise dressing mixed with 1/2 cup whipped cream.

recipes.title: RAW CARROT AND PINEAPPLE SALAD
directions: pineapple juice and water to make two cups Heat until boiling and pour over 1 package of lemon jello. When cool, add carrots and pineapple. Serve with mayonnaise. Serves 12.

recipes.title: MOLDED CARROT PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients: 1 tbsp. Knox gelatine dissolved in 1/4 cup cold water
directions: Melt gelatine over hot water. Combine with carrots and pineapple and chill. Serve on lettuce with salad dressing.

recipes.title: FANCY SALAD
directions: Dissolve Jello in hot water, cool, add fruit, nuts, maccaroons. Color with cherry juice and add cream whipped. Mold and chill.

recipes.title: FRUIT AND GINGER ALE SALAD
ingredients: ⅓ cup Malaga grapes, skinned, seeded and halved
⅓ cup apple, cored, pared and diced
directions: Soak gelatine in cold water and dissolve in boiling water. Add ginger ale, lemon juice, sugar and salt. When it begins to set, fold in the fruits. Mold, chill and turn out onto a serving dish. Garnish with parsley and celery tips; serve with mayonnaise.

recipes.title: GINGER ALE SALAD
ingredients: Hot water, enough to dissolve gelatin
directions: To 1 pkg. lemon jello dissolved in small amount of hot water, add 1 bottle ginger ale, and to this add pineapple, grapes, grapefruit, and bananas cut in small pieces.

recipes.title: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
directions: Mix, put in trays of icebox and freeze.

recipes.title: FROZEN PINEAPPLE AND CHEESE SALAD
ingredients: Fruit salad dressing (4 tbsp. for mixing and more for serving)
directions: Mix cheese and 4 tbsp. salad dressing until smooth, add pineapple, cherries, marshmallows cut in pieces with scissors dipped in hot water. Beat cream until stiff and fold into mixture. Pack in individual molds. Cover with a double thickness of wax paper held in place with elastic bands. Pack in equal parts of ice and salt, and let stand 3 hours or freeze in mechanical refrigerator. Unmold and put a green maraschino cherry on top. Serve on lettuce, with fruit salad dressing, or with sparkling French dressing.

recipes.title: SPARKLING FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients: ½ pkg. sweetened and flavored red gelatine
directions: Dissolve gelatine in boiling water. Chill and when nearly set add remaining ingredients. Let stand until thoroughly congealed and beat just before serving.

recipes.title: FRUIT SALAD DRESSING
directions: Put egg in top of double boiler and beat until light. Add butter, lemon juice, and salt. Cook and stir over hot water until mixture thickens. Remove from fire and add remaining ingredients except cream. Just before serving fold in cream, which has been beaten stiff.

recipes.title: PARTY SALAD
directions: Soak gelatine in 1/4 cup cold water, add 1 cup hot water. When dissolved, add lemon Jello dissolved in 1 pt. hot water, vinegar, lemon juice, sugar and salt. Cool. When beginning to thicken add celery, cucumber and pimento. Mold in fancy mold or in bread tin. When ready to serve, unmold, or cut in slices, and arrange on lettuce leaf, with mayonnaise. Serves 12.

recipes.title: SALMON SALAD
directions: Soak gelatine in cold water. Heat milk and add salt, mustard, paprika, butter and lemon and bring to boiling point and pour onto beaten eggs. Cook in double boiler until it thickens, add gelatine. Let cool and mix with salmon and boiled eggs and arrange in mold. Chill. Serve with lettuce and salad dressing.

recipes.title: CUCUMBER SAUCE
ingredients: ½ cup sour cream, beaten stiff
directions: Drain cucumber through cheese cloth. Add salt and a few grains pepper to whipped cream. Slowly beat in vinegar. Chill about 3/4 hour. When ready to serve add cucumber.

recipes.title: JELLIED SALMON
directions: If canned salmon is used, remove from can, and pour boiling water over salmon. Drain and remove skin and bones. Flake.. Mix and sift flour, mustard, sugar, salt, and paprika, and add to melted butter. Add egg slightly beaten with milk. Cook over hot water, stirring constantly until mixture is perfectly smooth and thickened. Soften gelatine in cold water for five minutes. Remove sauce from heat and stir in gelatine. Stir until gelatine is dissolved, and fold in fish flakes. Pour into individual molds and let stand several hours in cool place to set. Serve on lettuce, with cucumber sauce.

recipes.title: TOMATO ASPIC
directions: Soak gelatine in cold water 15 minutes. Season tomatoes with salt, sugar and pepper and bring to boiling point. Add the gelatine and stir until it is dissolved. Mold and chill. Place on lettuce leaf and serve with mayonnaise.

recipes.title: TOMATO CHEESE SALAD
directions: Dissolve gelatine in cold water. Heat soup to boiling point. Cream cheese to a paste and add to the soup, add gelatine. When cool add olives and celery.

recipes.title: MOLDED TOMATO SALAD
directions: Heat soup in double boiler. Add soaked gelatine. Add cheese and blend perfectly. When cool add remaining ingredients, and mold.

recipes.title: MOLDED VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients: ½ cup liquid from canned peas
directions: Soak gelatine in cold water, dissolve in hot liquid from peas. Cook peas gently five minutes. Add salt, paprika, peas, carrots, mint sauce and vinegar to gelatine mixture. Mould and chill. Serve on lettuce with salad dressing. Garnish with stuffed olives or pimento.

recipes.title: VEGETABLE JELLO SALAD
directions: Soak gelatine in cold water, dissolve in cup of boiling water. Add jello which has been dissolved in pt. of boiling water. Add sugar, vinegar, lemon juice, and salt. Strain and cool, and when it thickens, add celery, cucumber, pimento and onion. Chill. Serves 18.

DRESSING FOR VEGETABLE SALAD WITH LEMON JELLO 1½ cup sugar 1 cup milk 2 tbsp. flour 4 egg yolks 1 tbsp. cornstarch 1 cup vinegar 2 tsp. mustard, dry 2 or 3 tbsp. oil 1/4 tsp. paprika whipped cream 1 tsp. salt

Put first list of ingredients in double boiler. Moisten with part of milk. Add rest of milk, mixed with egg yolks. Cook until it starts to thicken. Add vinegar, and cook until thick. Add oil as you take it off the stove. More sugar or less vinegar may be used according to taste. Add whipped cream: 1/2 pt. to 1½ cup dressing.

recipes.title: HONEY CINNAMON TOAST
directions: Warm honey, add to creamed butter and then mix the cinnamon in thoroughly. Spread thinly sliced bread mixture. Put slices together and toast quickly. Time in combining, 10 minutes. Time in cooking, about 5 minutes. Temperature, 400 to 500 degrees.

recipes.title: EGG CREOLE SANDWICHES
ingredients: ½ hard-boiled egg, chopped, per sandwich
½ tbsp. chow-chow relish per sandwich
directions: For each sandwich allow one-half chopped bard-boiled egg, one shredded sardine, one-half tablespoon chow chow and Mazola Mayonnaise to blend. Spread on buttered bread, top with a second slice of bread, press together, and cut in triangles and serve.

recipes.title: CHEESE DREAMS
directions: Make sandwiches with thin sliced cheese. Fry in sufficient melted butter until bread is well browned.

recipes.title: SANDWICHES
ingredients: Equal parts grated carrots and chopped nuts
Orange juice, to moisten date filling
directions: Carrots and nuts, equal parts, with mayonnaise. (Grind carrots first, then nuts. ) Dates and nuts with orange juice. Cut sandwiches round.

recipes.title: ROLLED ASPARAGUS SANDWICHES
directions: Remove crusts from fresh sandwich bread and spread with soft butter. Put 1–2 asparagus spears cut to bread length on each slice; spread with a little mayonnaise. Roll tightly, wrap and chill until the butter firms enough to hold the rolls closed.

recipes.title: FRUIT AND CHEESE SANDWICHES
directions: Mix all together and spread between slices of buttered bread.

recipes.title: FRENCH TOAST CHICKEN SANDWICHES
directions: Mix the chicken, onion juice, salt, pepper, and paprika to taste. Spread between large slices of bread from which crusts have been removed. Mix the milk and egg well and dip the sandwiches one at a time into this mixture. Fry in a hot frying pan until brown on both sides.

recipes.title: ROLLED SANDWICHES WITH CHEESE
ingredients: Very fresh sandwich bread, cut lengthwise into thin slices
Spinach juice or green coloring, optional
directions: Remove all crusts from a fresh loaf of bread, and cut lengthwise in very thin slices. Spread with butter, then spread one end of each slice with pimento cheese, the middle portion of the slices with plain cream cheese, moistened if necessary with a little French dressing, and the remaining third of the slice with cream cheese mixed with chopped water cress and a bit of green color paste or spinach juice. Roll from end to end like a jelly roll. Wrap in cheese cloth and put in refrigerator until needed, then cut in thin slices diagonally.

recipes.title: HOT HAM SANDWICHES
directions: Lightly butter bread slices, spread half with deviled ham and top with remaining slices. Cut sandwiches in halves. Beat eggs with milk, dip sandwiches in mixture and sauté in a buttered skillet until golden on each side, about 10 minutes. Makes 6 sandwiches.

recipes.title: LOBSTER SALAD SANDWICHES
directions: Seasoning
Mix equal parts of lobster and diced celery, and moisten with mayonnaise. Place lettuce leaf and salad between slices of buttered bread. Chicken and crabmeat may be prepared in the same way.

recipes.title: SWEET SANDWICHES
ingredients: Orange juice, as needed to moisten filling
directions: Make a filling of dates and nut meats run through the food chopper.

recipes.title: ORANGE SANDWICHES
directions: Moisten sugar with orange juice, add finely cut crystallized orange peel. Spread thinly cut slices of bread with creamed butter and then with the mixture. Combine slices to make sandwiches.

recipes.title: DINTY MOORE SANDWICH
ingredients: Butter two slices of bread. Place a slice of corned beef between,
directions: and press together well. Toast outsides of sandwich on griddle, turning with a pancake turner. Use weight, such as a block of wood, to keep sandwich in shape while toasting. -Harry Cox.

recipes.title: SPANISH STEAK
directions: Steak cut 1½ inches thick, sear on both sides in hot frying pan. Put it in a casserole with 1/2 cup water and cover with thinly sliced onions. Cover the casserole and bake 30 minutes at 400 degrees, or less. Season with salt, pepper and pour 3 cups strained tomatoes over the meat. Bake about 40 minutes longer, uncovered. Place meat on platter, cover with grated cheese, and return to oven just long enough to melt cheese. Serve any gravy left in casserole right on platter with meat.

recipes.title: DUTCH POT ROAST
ingredients: 4 lb. rump, shank or chuck, cut for stew
directions: Dredge beef with flour and brown well in bacon fat or drippings. Place in a kettle with remaining ingredients, cover and cook on the stove about 3½ hours. Thicken remaining gravy with a flour-and-cold-water paste. Simmer a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: TOMALEE PIE
directions: Brown onion in fat. Add beef and brown. Add tomato juice and season. Cook cornmeal in water to a mush. Line baking dish with mush on the bottom and sides and in center put the meat and tomato mixture and put mush over top. Bake at about 325 degrees for 1½ hour.

recipes.title: STEAK GRAVY
directions: After broiling steak in spider, turning all the time, make a gravy of the juice and grease. Turn out gas, add about 2 large tbsp. dry flour to the grease. Turn on gas slowly, let flour cook, stirring constantly. Then add a quart of milk, or enough for proper consistency. Makes a lovely brown gravy.

recipes.title: YORKSHIRE PUDDING
directions: Beat eggs. Add some flour, a little milk and salt until all is used. Beat 5 minutes. Pour a thin layer in a greased pan, bake 20 minutes in a moderate oven until brown. Cut in squares and put around roast beef, put dish gravy on it.

recipes.title: POT ROAST
directions: Have beef fat 1/2 inch deep melted in Dutch Oven or baking dish on top of stove. Cover meat with salt and lots of paprika. Brown well in hot fat, then take the meat out. Add 2 cups of onion chopped real fine with salt and more paprika. Simmer onions in fat until done. Add 2 cans tomato pulp (seasoned) and 2 cans water. When this boils put the meat back in to cook about 3 hours. Serves 8.

recipes.title: MOCK DUCK
directions: Have meat cut in a thin slice. Spread with dressing, roll up and tie securely. Dredge with flour and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Put in roasting-pan and sear in a hot oven. Reduce heat, add a little water and cook until meat is tender (2 to 3 hours), basting frequently and adding more water from time to time if necessary.

recipes.title: SAVORY BEEF LOAF
ingredients: ¼ lb. salt pork, diced fine
directions: Fry pork until brown. Add it to the other ingredients and mix. Bake quickly for 15 minutes, 400 degrees, then lower heat a little for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

recipes.title: BEEFSTEAK WITH MUSHROOM SAUCE
directions: Beefsteak

Cream butter and the flour together in a frying-pan and let brown well, being careful not to burn. When well browned add cold water and lemon juice, parsley, salt, pepper, mushrooms, which have been drained and cut in quarters and browned in small amount of butter. Broil steak in the usual way, place on hot platter, and pour mushroom sauce over. Serve immediately. Time in combining, 40 minutes. One pound rump steak serves five generously.

recipes.title: MEAT PATTIES
directions: Take one pound round steak ground and shape in patties. Fry on both sides in fat. Add one can of tomato soup and cook 3/4 hour. Salt and pepper to taste. Very good.

recipes.title: MEAT BALLS
ingredients: 1 lb. salt or fresh pork, ground
directions: Mix all together and make into balls (about 16). Put soup and 1 can of water in kettle and bring to boil. Put in meat balls and cook slowly about two hours. Take out balls and thicken liquid, which makes a lovely tomato sauce.

recipes.title: BAKED SWIFT'S PREMIUM HAM
ingredients: 1 cup brown sugar, for rubbing fat
½ tsp. cinnamon, for rubbing fat
½ tsp. allspice, for rubbing fat
¼ cup vinegar, for basting syrup
¼ cup water, for basting syrup
directions: Plunge the ham into boiling water to cover, with bay leaf, 3 tablespoons sugar, ½ teaspoon cinnamon, onion juice, and grated lemon rind. Reduce heat and simmer until tender, allowing about 25 minutes per pound for a 10–12-pound ham.
Remove from water, peel rind and trim. Rub fat with 1 cup brown sugar, ½ teaspoon cinnamon and ½ teaspoon allspice. Pierce fat with whole cloves.
Bake in a 350°F oven 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until nicely browned. Baste frequently with syrup made by boiling 2 cups sugar, ¼ cup vinegar, ¼ cup water, and 1 teaspoon mustard.

recipes.title: LUNCHEON DISH
ingredients: 1 cup ham, ground, about ½ lb.
directions: Use center of fresh bread for crumbs. Mix with milk, and let stand 2 hours. Add cheese and let stand 1 hour. Add ham and bake 3/4 hour in buttered casserole at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: BAKED SLICE OF HAM
ingredients: Milk, sweet cider, or diluted peach-pickle juice, enough to cover
directions: A slice of ham may be baked until tender, covered with milk, sweet cider, or thinned peach pickle juice.

recipes.title: ESCALLOPED HAM AND POTATOES
directions: Cut ham into six portions. Melt fat, add flour and milk, cook until thick, stirring constantly. Put layer of potatoes in buttered casserole using one-third of them. Over these, slice onion and sprinkle with pepper. Put on these three pieces of ham, repeat these layers. Pour the milk sauce over all and bake 1½ hours in a moderate oven, partially covered.

recipes.title: BAKED SLICE OF PREMIUM HAM
directions: Slice of Swift's Premium Ham, 1 inch thick. Dot with Brookfield Butter. Cover with liquid made from: 4 tsp. dry mustard 1 cup light brown sugar 1 cup vinegar 2 cups water
Bake one hour, or longer, at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: HAM LOAF
directions: Mix and put in greased pan. Pour a little milk over loaf. Bake at 350 to 375 degrees, 1½ to 2 hours.

recipes.title: HAM LOAF
directions: Mix, and bake 2 hours at 350 degrees. Makes a large loaf, serving about 10.

recipes.title: HAM LOAF
directions: Mix thoroughly and bake in moderate oven, 350 degrees about 1 hour.

recipes.title: SWIFT'S PREMIUM HAM LOAF
directions: Mix and bake 1 hour. Easy to slice cold. Serves about 10.

recipes.title: SWIFT'S PREMIUM HAM SUPREME
ingredients: Brown sugar, to rub onto ham
Hot water, equal in volume to jelly
directions: Currant Jelly Place a 10 to 12 pound Swift's Premium Ham, fat side up, in an uncovered baking pan, in a 300 ° F. oven, allowing about 20 minutes per pound. Take from oven, remove rind, trim, and rub with brown sugar. Dot with cloves. Pour off the extra fat which is in the pan, and replace ham in oven. Baste frequently with currant jelly which has been mixed with an equal amount of hot water. When nicely browned, remove from oven. The drippings in the pan make an excellent gravy. Allow 2 tablespoons flour to each 3 tablespoons fat, blend, and add 1 cup water for each 2 tablespoons flour used. Garnish with cinnamon apple rings with currant jelly on the center of each ring.

recipes.title: ARABIAN STEW
ingredients: One pork chop for each serving cut about 1 inch thick. Brown
directions: in hot fat on each side. Place in a tight covered baking dish. On top of each pork chop put 1 tbsp. of washed uncooked rice; 1 large slice of onion, one slice of tomato cooked tomatoes may be used; and a slice of green pepper on top of all. Season well; add 4 cups water, let bake slowly for 2 hours.

recipes.title: PORK CHOPS ITALIANE
directions: Brown chops, put in baking dish and lay a slice of tomato, onion and pepper and 1 tbsp. rice on each one. Add some water, cover and bake 1 hour.

recipes.title: NEW ENGLAND STYLE SAUSAGE
directions: Boil sweet potatoes until tender. Peel and cut potatoes into ½ inch slices lengthwise. Place a layer of them on bottom of buttered baking dish. Cover with slices of apples which have been peeled and cored. Sprinkle with sugar and dot with butter. Fry sausage until golden brown. Cut in pieces. Lay upon the apple. Repeat with another layer of potato, apple and sausage and continue until dish is filled. Pour water and 2 tbsp. sausage fat over all. Cover dish and bake slowly 1½ hours or until apples are done. It may be necessary to add more water to prevent burning. Serve six.

recipes.title: PORK CHOPS WITH TOMATO SAUCE
directions: Place Pork Chops in baking dish. Lay slice of onion on each chop. Cover with tomato sauce and water. Bake in slow oven 1½ hours.

recipes.title: SMOTHERED PORK CHOPS
ingredients: Flour, if needed to thicken gravy
directions: Brown chops lightly, and put in baking dish. Put water in frying pan and make a gravy, pour over chops and bake about 2 hours. Salt.

recipes.title: CREAMED PORK TENDERLOIN
directions: Cut tenderloin in small pieces and fry. Make medium white sauce and add tenderloin and few pimentoes. Serve on toast.

recipes.title: PORK CHOPS BAKED
directions: Place pork chops in roaster. Cover with tomato soup, 1 can water, and peas. Bake in moderate oven, 325 degrees, about 1 hour.

recipes.title: BAKED BREADED PORK CHOPS
directions: Chops should be cut evenly but not very thick. Beat egg, adding 1 tbsp. milk. Dip chop in egg, then crumbs. Heap crumbs on chop and press down well. Turn chop over and repeat. (This may be done several hours before time of cooking.) Sear breaded chops in hot fat (about 1/4 inch deep) until nicely brown. Remove to baking dish and add enough milk or milk and water to just cover chops. Bake 50 or 60 minutes at 375°. Serve hot.

recipes.title: STUFFED PORK TENDERLOIN
directions: Select tenderloins of equal length and weight. Split lengthwise and pound out as flat as possible. Fill and round out with well mixed stuffing. Place another tenderloin on top and fasten both ends and sides together. Dust slightly with flour, salt and pepper. Sear in hot oven 450 degrees 10 minutes reduce to moderate heat, 350 degrees, and bake 1½ hours. Baste during last half with 1 pt. water. When baked remove from pan and strain liquid. Stir in 2 tbsp. flour in remaining fat. Add liquid slowly, and cook gently until smooth and clear. Serve with meat.

recipes.title: STUFFED PORK TENDERLOIN
directions: Split tenderloin lengthwise. Fill with dressing. Tie and dredge with flour. Brush with butter and roast until tender in a closed roaster. Open roaster the last half hour and brown.

recipes.title: MOCK CHICKEN LEGS
