directions: Cut cubes of meat and string alternately on the skewers, about 5 to each stick. Roll each "leg" in flour, and saute in butter until brown. Season well, and place in waterless cooker or in roaster with a little water. Cook slowly 1 hour at 325 degrees. May be varied by cooking onions, potatoes and carrots with it.

recipes.title: CITY CHICKEN
directions: Cut meat in small squares and arrange alternately on wooden skewers. Dip in egg and crumbs, arrange in baking dish, cover with water and a little butter and bake until done.

recipes.title: VEAL CROQUETTES
ingredients: 3 cups ground veal, cooked and cold
directions: Mix all ingredients while white sauce is warm. When cool, form into long, round croquettes. Roll in egg and cracker crumbs, and fry in deep fat. These are fine with Tartar Sauce.

recipes.title: TARTAR SAUCE
ingredients: ½ cup olive oil (or Mazola oil )
directions: Chop hard-boiled eggs and sweet pickles. Whisk vinegar, dry mustard, salt and cayenne together, then gradually whisk in olive oil. Stir in the eggs, pickles and minced onion; refrigerate until serving. For a smoother sauce, mash the eggs into the dressing.

recipes.title: VEAL BIRDS ( BEEF BIRDS )
ingredients: Veal cutlets or thin beef steak, ½ inch thick
½ loaf bread, moistened, for dressing
directions: Have veal (or sirloin or round steak) cut 1/2 inch thick. Cut steak in squares and roll around dressing, fastening with toothpicks. Dressing: ½ loaf of bread, moistened, seasoned with small onion, salt, pepper 1 tsp. sage 2 tbsp. butter, melted. Taste for seasoning. Fry birds in lots of lard or butter until brown all over. Remove birds to roaster, make gravy in spider, by adding water and thickening. Pour over meat, and cover. Cook about 1 hour at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: PRESSED VEAL
ingredients: 5 lbs. veal cooked in salted water with celery and onion until
directions: tender. Let cool and put through grinder. Dissolve 1 tbsp. Knox gelatine in 1/4 cup cold water. Pour 2 cups boiling stock over gelatine and add meat. Put salt and pepper to taste. Place ½ meat in bread tin. Place hard boiled eggs on meat and fill dish with remaining meat. Press down, cover and chill.,

recipes.title: VEAL LOAF
directions: shake of nutmeg Mix pack in pan. Brush top with white of egg and butter. Bake 2½ hours.

recipes.title: VEAL STEW AND DUMPLING
directions: Dredge veal with 2 tbsp. flour, and brown in hot fat. Add water, salt, pepper, bay leaf, and onion, and stew until tender. Add carrots last 20 minutes of cooking. When tender, remove the bones from the stew, thicken gravy with 2 tbsp. flour, mixed with a little cold water, add peas. Place dumplings on top of meat. Cover tightly, and cook until dumplings are done. Time 1½ hours.

recipes.title: DUMPLINGS
directions: Sift flour before measuring. Mix and sift flour, baking powder, and salt. Cut in shortening. Add milk gradually to make a soft dough. Roll and cut with biscuit cutter, or drop by spoonfuls on top of stew. Dumplings should rest on meat and vegetables, not settle into liquid. Cover kettle closely, and cook without lifting cover, for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: DUMPLINGS
directions: Mix and sift dry ingredients, and add just enough milk for a very stiff dough. Drop in lumps the size of an egg on top of meat and cook for 10 minutes without removing cover.

recipes.title: DUMPLINGS
directions: Mix ingredients in order given. Drop from a wet spoon on top of meat. Boil without taking cover off for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: CHIPPED BEEF AND CANNED CORN
directions: Chop beef fine, add corn, milk, and pepper. Pour into greased dish. Cover with 1 cup crumbs, mixed with 2 tbsp. melted butter. Bake ½ hour at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: CHINESE MEAT LOAF
directions: Mix and bake about 1 hour at 375 degrees.

recipes.title: MEAT LOAF FOR TWELVE
directions: Mix thoroughly, bake in bread tin 2 hours

recipes.title: MEAT LOAF
ingredients: 1 cup bread or cracker crumbs, soaked in as much milk as they absorb
directions: To the ground beef and pork, add onion, lemon juice, salt and pepper to taste. Add the two eggs, well beaten; then crumbs soaked inmilk. Bake in moderate oven from 30 to 40 minutes. This makes a good sized loaf.

recipes.title: MEAT LOAF
ingredients: 1 egg (mentioned in method, not listed among printed ingredients)
directions: Mix bread crumbs, flour, salt, pepper, onion, paprika, mustard and sage together and work into meat. Add the beaten egg to the milk and knead into the meat mixture. Mold into a loaf and place strips of bacon over the top. Bake two hours. Serves 8.

recipes.title: MEAT LOAF
directions: Mix bread crumbs, flour, salt and all seasonings together, and work in meat. Add the beaten egg to the milk and knead into meat mixture gradually. Mold into a loaf and place strips of bacon over the top. Bake 2 hours at 325 degrees.

recipes.title: MEAT LOAF
directions: Mix all together, and add a small amount of water. Place in a baking dish, and bake about one hour. Pour over this 1 can of tomato soup, and cook fifteen minutes longer. Serve hot. Serves about ten.

recipes.title: MEAT LOAF
directions: Shape into loaf, cover with water, and bake 1½ hours at 325 degrees.

recipes.title: CREAMED SWEETBREADS
directions: Remove tough fibre from sweetbreads; wash and boil five minutes. Drain, pull apart and dredge in egg and flour. Brown in pan with the butter, adding mushrooms, milk and seasonings. Thicken with flour. Serve in cases or on toast.

recipes.title: MEAT SOUFFLE
ingredients: ⅔ cup meat, put through food chopper
directions: Beat eggs separately. Add yolks to meat, and well seasoned white sauce. Fold in whites. Put in well buttered baking dish. Sprinkle top with paprika, or buttered crumbs. Bake in pan of hot water at 300 degrees until eggs are set.

recipes.title: FOR LEFT- OVER MEAT
directions: Chop meat in food chopper, and press into gem tins, leaving a hole in the center. Break 1 egg in each. Bake at 325 degrees for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: SHEPHERDS PIE
ingredients: Onion, green pepper or pimiento, optional
directions: On a well buttered pan place mounds of left over mashed potatoes, which have been mixed with milk to the right consistency; cut left over meat into small pieces, combine with equal amount of medium cream sauce (2 cups milk, 4 tbsp. butter and 4 tbsp. flour). If there is any left over gravy, mix with milk to make right consistency. Add 2 cups of the meat; onion, green pepper or pimento may be added for better flavor. Pour around the molds of mashed potatoes. Bake in a moderate oven until browned. If desired, the dish may be lined with the mashed potato and filled with the creamed mixture.

recipes.title: LUNCHEON DISH
ingredients: Cooked cold meat, preferably roast beef, diced
directions: Any cold meat (preferably roast beef), diced; 1 small onion; ½ green pepper, diced; and 1 can tomatoes. Add meat, onion and pepper to tomatoes and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Serve on buttered toast.

recipes.title: LAMB AND STRING BEANS
directions: Cut lamb into cubes and brown in fat. Add onion, and when brown add tomatoes and seasoning. Cook about 20 minutes. Add beans, broken in small pieces. Simmer until tender. Serve with a border of boiled rice.

recipes.title: CHILI CON CARNE
directions: Fry veal and onion in butter, add hot water and simmer. Add beans, tomatoes, and spaghetti, and continue to simmer. 15 minutes before serving add chili powder to taste.

recipes.title: CHILI CON CARNE
directions: Brown meat, add other ingredients, and cook 2 or 3 hours.

recipes.title: MEXICAN GOULASH
ingredients: 1 pkg. spaghetti, cooked in boiling salted water until tender
dash chili powder or ¼ tsp. paprika
directions: Fry ground steak in bacon fat until brown, with the sliced onions. Add salt, celery, tomatoes, cooked spaghetti, sugar, and seasoning. Simmer slowly 1 hour, stirring occasionally. If too dry, add ½ cup water.

recipes.title: CHOP SUEY
directions: Fry bacon or pork in pan slowly, add veal, frying for 10 minutes. Remove meat to another pan, leaving fat in frying pan. Fry onion and celery in frying pan. Put all in pan with meat, adding water to nearly cover, and chopped green pepper. Simmer 1 hour, adding more water if necessary. Add molasses and seasonings, and mushrooms. Thicken, with cornstarch or flour. Serve with Chop Suey Sauce. -Jane Rork.

recipes.title: CHOP SUEY
directions: Cut meat, onions, and celery in small pieces. Put oil or fat in pan and heat. Then put in meat and brown on all sides. Then add water and cook 10 or 15 minutes. Then add onions and celery, and sauce to taste. Cook about 1 hour. Just before it has finished cooking, thicken a little with flour and water. Then add mushrooms. Have rice boiled Chinese style to serve with this.

recipes.title: CHOP SUEY
directions: Cook meat 5 minutes in onion juice. Pour over it 2 cups water, 2 tbsp. brown sugar and 4 tbsp. "Show You" sauce. Thicken slightly with flour when meat is done. Add salt and pepper. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: CHOP SUEY
ingredients: ½ lb. of veal or beef
directions: Put in an iron spider 1 tbsp. lard and 1 tbsp. butter, add meat cut in small pieces, and cook ten minutes. Then add all the other ingredients, and cook slowly ½ hour. Add more water if needed. Thicken with a little flour. Serve with boiled rice. Serves four.

recipes.title: ITALIAN MACARONI
directions: Brown diced beef in a little fat. Add sliced onions and garlic and cook until softened. Add tomatoes, mushrooms and water; simmer gently, partly covered, about 2–3 hours, stirring and adding water as needed, until the meat is tender and sauce thick. (The original version simmered 6 hours.) Cook macaroni in salted water until just tender. In a buttered baking dish alternate layers of macaroni, sauce and grated cheese. Bake at 325°F for 35–45 minutes until bubbling. Makes about 12–16 servings.

recipes.title: MACARONI WITH CHIPPED BEEF
directions: Break macaroni in pieces, cook in boiling salted water. Butter a baking dish, put in a layer of macaroni and beef with a sprinkle of mustard. Continue until all is used, having a layer of macaroni last. Pour over milk, sprinkle with cheese and bake 35 minutes in quick oven.

recipes.title: CREAMETTES ( OR SHELL MACARONI )
ingredients: 1 cup dry creamettes or shell macaroni
directions: WITH MUSHROOM SAUCE 1 cup creamettes 1 pimento, cut up 1 cup scalded cream parsley to taste, minced 1/4 cup melted butter onion or onion juice to taste 1 cup soft bread crumbs ½ tsp. salt 3 eggs, beaten separately 1 cup grated cheese, Ame. or Nippy Cook creamettes as usual in large quantity of boiling salted water. Mix ingredients, folding in eggs last. Put in well buttered mold. Set in pan of hot water and bake 3/4 hour at 300 degrees. Turn out on chop plate, garnished with parsley. Use spatula to get out of mold. Fill center with mushroom sauce, made by adding 1 can mushrooms to 1 cup white sauce. Serve with vegetable salad (tomatoes and cucumber).

recipes.title: MACARONI WITH VEGETABLES
directions: Brown the butter in an iron skillet, and add meat, dice fine, and onions. When brown, add mushrooms and boiling water. Add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes. Add peas and cook 5 minutes. Add mushroom liquor and 1 cup boiling water and cook 5 minutes. Add macaroni and pour all into a butterd baking dish. Slice cheese on top and bake ½ hour in a moderate oven. Serves 8, generously.

recipes.title: EGG NOODLES
directions: Beat well and add: 1/4 tsp. salt and 1 tbsp. cold water Beat again and add flour to make stiff dough
Roll very thin on well floured board and stand two hours; roll and cut in narrow strips.

recipes.title: NOODLE RING
directions: Boil noodles in salted water until tender, drain, and pour over cold water, and drain again. Beat eggs separately, add yolks to whites. Add milk, butter and cheese to noodles. Fold in eggs. Bake in buttered ring in hot water for 45 minutes at 300 degrees. Put plate over and turn upside down. In center put chicken a la king.

recipes.title: LEFTOVER HAM
directions: Cook noodles. Make alternate layers of noodles, ham, grated cheese in deep baking dish. Add beaten egg to milk, and pour over mixture. Put a few slices of green pepper on top and bake at 350 degrees for about 3/4 hour.

recipes.title: CREAMED NOODLE WITH CHEESE
directions: Beat egg slightly with salt and water. Add flour, cutting mixture with a knife. Knead until smooth and stiff. One or two more tbsp. flour may be necessary. Roll on a slightly floured molding board until as thin as possible. Cover and let stand 20 minutes. Cut in tiny squares, and let dry for 30 minutes. Drop into 2 quarts of boiling water, salted, and cook 15 minutes, boiling rapidly. Drain and put into buttered baking dish. Pour over cream to make moist, sprinkle with cheese, and cover with buttered crumbs. Bake in a hot oven, 300 degrees, until brown.

recipes.title: SPAGHETTI WITH MEAT AND VEGETABLES
ingredients: ½ cup cold boiled ham, chopped
directions: Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water, and drain. Add vegetables and chopped ham, seasonings and milk, then add beaten egg and place in casserole and bake until brown.

recipes.title: NUT LOAF
ingredients: 1 cup cooked vegetables ( any variety, rice is very good)
directions: Mix well and bake. Pour tomato sauce over when baked. Serves 6.

recipes.title: SPAGHETTI KING
directions: Cook spaghetti in usual way. Put butter in frying pan, add chopped onion, then tuna fish and cook for 5 minutes. Add rest of ingredients and heat thoroughly. Put into hot dish and garnish with hard boiled egg pressed through potato ricer.

recipes.title: SPAGHETTI
directions: Boil in salted water the required amount of spaghetti for twentyfive minutes. Drain, pour cold water on, and drain again. ( This keeps it from getting sticky.) Butter the baking dish, and put in a layer of spaghetti, a layer of tomatoes, a layer of cheese, a layer of peas, a few slices of onion and bits of butter, pepper and salt, and so on till dish is full. Bake in a moderate oven until brown, about forty- five minutes. Serves 6 or 8.

recipes.title: SPAGHETTI RAREBIT
directions: Melt butter in double boiler; add cut up cheese and melt; then tomato soup and chopped onion; then two cans of spaghetti and let cool for at least twenty minutes. Serve hot on wafers. This serves six. Mrs. D. Boudeman.

recipes.title: SPAGHETTI WITH ROUND STEAK
ingredients: Ground round steak, about ½ lb. per ½ lb. dry pasta
Tomato sauce or other spaghetti seasoning, to taste
directions: Fix spaghetti as you usually do and add ground round steak fried brown and mixed through the spaghetti.

recipes.title: SPAGHETTI WITH MUSHROOMS
directions: Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water until tender. Drain, rinse with cold water and add to tomato soup. Brown mushrooms in fat and add with cheese to spaghetti. Heat thoroughly and serve. Time in combining, 15 minutes. Time in cooking, 20 minutes. Recipe makes four servings.

recipes.title: CREOLE SPAGHETTI
directions: Brown onion in fat, and add beef andbrown, seaso season, and add tomatoes and cheese. Cook this mixture slowly until cheese has dissolved. Then add cooked spaghetti. Mrs. R. A. Winslow.

recipes.title: SPANISH RICE
ingredients: A few slices Swift’s Premium bacon
directions: Wash rice six times; boil in salted water until nearly soft. Cut up green pepper, onion, tomatoes and bacon; add to rice, seasoning with salt and pepper. Use butter if not using bacon. Bake 1 hour at 325°F.

recipes.title: SPANISH RICE
directions: Mix thoroughly and bake in moderate oven, 350 degrees, about 1½ hours.

recipes.title: SPANISH RICE
directions: Cook for two hours in the double boiler.

recipes.title: SPANISH RICE
directions: Cook rice until tender. Brown steak in a little butter. Add steak and other ingredients to the rice and bake 1 hour.

recipes.title: FRENCH RICE
directions: Peel and mince onion. Add to peas and cook until tender in boiling water. Add salt last 10 minutes of cooking. Drain if necessary. Combine with rice, butter, and tomatoes, mixing well with fork. Turn into a well buttered baking dish and bake 15 minutes in a hot oven, 375 to 400 degrees. Garnish with hard cooked egg. Serve from baking dish.

recipes.title: Baked Cheese and Bread Custard (Cheese Soufflé)
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and butter a baking dish with the 2 tbsp. butter. Arrange alternating layers of buttered bread and diced cheese, ending with cheese. Beat eggs and milk together and pour evenly over the layers. Rest 10 minutes to soak, then bake 30–40 minutes until puffed and set in the center. Serve hot.

recipes.title: CASSEROLE OF RICE AND MEAT
directions: Season meat mixed with crumbs and beaten egg, and add meat stock to make mixture pour. Line greased mold or baking dish with 2 or 3 cups of rice. Pack rice well, and fill with meat, cover with rice remaining, and cover tightly and steam or bake about 45 minutes. Remove from mold. Serve with tomato sauce.

recipes.title: HEAVENLY HASH
directions: Mold hamburg, seasoning and rice into cakes. Fry brown on both sides. Cover with tomato soup and let simmer until rice is done.

recipes.title: CHEESE AND RICE RING
directions: Measure rice before cooking. Mix with rice, folding in the whites last. Bake one hour in hot water at 300 degrees.

recipes.title: CHEESED RICE
directions: Heat milk in double boiler, add rice and cook ½ hour. Add cheese, butter, salt and cook until tender. Serve as a substitute for potatoes.

recipes.title: CHEESE FONDU
directions: Place butter in chafing dish or double boiler. When melted add milk, bread crumbs, cheese, mustard and cayenne. Stir constantly, add eggs beaten light just before serving.

recipes.title: EGG AND CHEESE DAINTY
ingredients: 1 plain rusk or crisp toast, crumbled
Grated or broken sharp cheese, enough for 2 layers
Milk, enough to come halfway up the dish
directions: Butter a small baking dish. Crumble rusk over the base and scatter with a layer of cheese. Dot with butter, season, then crack four eggs evenly over the surface, breaking the yolks slightly. Top with another layer of cheese and rusk, dot with butter and pour milk down the side to reach halfway up the dish. Bake at 375°F for about 20 minutes, until eggs are set. Serves 4.

recipes.title: STUFFED EGGS AU GRATIN
directions: mustard

Boil eggs hard, and throw in cold water. Remove shells. Cut lengthwise. Take out yolks, and rub them to a paste with seasonings, crumbs and 1 tbsp. butter. Fill whites and place eggs in greased pie dish. Pour over 1 cup white sauce, sprinkle with more crumbs and dot with butter. Bake until browned in quite a hot oven, 375 degrees. Serve in this dish.

recipes.title: BAKED OMELET
directions: Make white sauce of butter, flour, milk, and salt. Cook to custard stage. Fold in beaten yolks and beaten whites. Pour into hot, buttered baking dish. Bake in hot oven, about 375 degrees, about 15 minutes. Try with knife.

recipes.title: HORSE RADISH EGGS
directions: Boil and prepare eggs as for deviled eggs. With the yolks mix 2 tbsp. thick mayonnaise and 1 tbsp. freshly ground horse radish to each 6 yolks. Fill egg whites. Serve on ovals of bread, which have been hollowed out to fit the egg. Either toast the bread ovals or fry it in butter until browned. Sprinkle top of egg with paprika.

recipes.title: ROAST TURKEY AND DRESSING
ingredients: 8–10 cups dry bread cubes for dressing
Sage, parsley, salt and pepper, to taste
Stock or water, as needed to moisten dressing
Butter or bacon fat, for rubbing bird
Water or stock, for pan and gravy
directions: Heat oven to 325°F. Remove giblets and pat the turkey dry. For dressing, toss bread cubes with sautéed onion and celery, melted butter, sage, parsley, salt and pepper; moisten lightly with stock. Bake the dressing separately in a buttered dish at 350°F for 30–40 minutes, until heated through and browned.

Season the turkey with salt and pepper and rub with butter or bacon fat. Place on a rack in a roasting pan with a little water or stock. Roast at 325°F, basting occasionally, until the thickest part of breast registers 165°F and the thigh is cooked through (roughly 3–4 hours for a 12–14 lb. unstuffed bird; check early). Rest 20–30 minutes before carving.

For gravy, simmer giblets separately if using. Skim fat from pan juices, whisk flour into a few tablespoons of fat, and add pan juices and stock until the desired thickness is reached. Season to taste.

recipes.title: WILD DUCK
ingredients: Bacon strips, for lining and topping
Prepared bread dressing, enough to fill cavity
directions: Simmer the cleaned wild duck with onion or carrot in water for about 1 hour, then drain. Line the cavity with bacon and fill loosely with prepared dressing. Lay bacon strips over the breast. Roast at 350°F until thoroughly cooked, about 45–75 minutes depending on size.

recipes.title: PHEASANT
directions: Heat oven to 375°F. Season pheasant with salt and pepper and rub with a little butter. Roast in a shallow pan, basting occasionally, about 35–50 minutes depending on size, until the thickest part reaches 165°F. Rest briefly before carving.

recipes.title: RABBIT
ingredients: Cold water and salt, for soaking
directions: Skin, cut up rabbit and soak all night in cold salted water. Rinse rabbit and bring to boil in cold water with 1 tbsp. soda. Take rabbit out and go over each piece cleaning it well. Cook until tender in fresh salted water with 1 onion and a bay leaf. The rabbit can be made into a pie or can be fried brown.

recipes.title: PARSLEY BREAD SAUCE
directions: Heat milk with onion in it. Remove onion, add bread cut up, butter, salt and beat to a cream, add parsley. Serve with fowl.

recipes.title: CHICKEN MOUSSE
ingredients: 1½ cups diced cooked white chicken meat
directions: Soak gelatine in cold water. Add chicken stock brought to boiling point. Add seasonings and chicken. When ready to set add cream, eggs and olives. Put in mold and chill for three hours. (Lobster may be substituted instead of chicken. )

recipes.title: CHICKEN A LA KING
ingredients: 3 cups chicken stock, or 2 cups stock plus 1 cup cream
directions: Cook chicken in stock until tender; cool and dice meat, reserving stock. Cook chopped sweet pepper briefly until nearly tender, then soften in chicken fat. Stir in flour, gradually whisk in 3 cups stock (or 2 cups stock and 1 cup cream), and cook until thickened. Add diced chicken, hard-boiled eggs and mushrooms; heat through and salt to taste. Serve over toast, rice or biscuits.

recipes.title: TIMBLES, CHICKEN OR VEAL
directions: Melt butter, add bread crumbs, and milk. Cook 5 minutes, stir, ring. Add meat, eggs, slightly beaten, and parsley. Season to taste. Turn into buttered, individual ramekins, making them ⅔ full. Set in pan of hot water. Cover with buttered paper and bake 20 minutes. Serve with Sauce Bechamel,

recipes.title: SAUCE BECHAMEL
directions: Cook stock 20 minutes with all the seasonings. Strain. There should be one cup. Melt butter, add flour, and, gradually, stock and milk. Use equal parts of stock and milk if you haven't enough stock.

recipes.title: BAKED BASS
directions: Mix with anchovy sauce until 1 pt. bread crumbs quite red 3 tbsp. butter Stuff fish with this compound and pour rest over it. Tomatoes can be used instead of anchovies. Bake 1 hour at 350 degrees. Shad, Pickerel, and Trout are good the same way.

recipes.title: BAKED FISH
directions: Clean and split fish down the back, remove bones. Dredge with flour on both sides. Spread baking pan with butter, or mixture of butter and meat fryings, generously. Place fish in pan, skin side down. Season with salt and pepper, and dot with butter. Bake about 50 minutes at 350 degrees. Make oven a little hotter at last if fish is not browned on top.

recipes.title: COD FISH BALLS
directions: Mix and form into balls. Fry in deep fat until brown. Serve with catsup or plain.
Use 2 eggs, beating them very light, and fry in balls in deep fat, and they will be Cod Fish Puffs.

recipes.title: BROILED WHITEFISH
directions: Clean, split, wash, dry and salt a fresh whitefish, 2½ to 3 lbs. Place in a shallow pan and baste thoroughly with a sauce made of ½ cup water, 3 tbsp. butter, juice of 1 lemon, 1 tbsp. Worcestershire sauce and cayenne pepper.
Place in broiler; broil 10–15 minutes, turn and baste thoroughly, then broil 10–15 minutes more. Turn again if necessary to cook thoroughly.

recipes.title: CREAMED CRABMEAT WITH MUSHROOMS
directions: To the white sauce add the flaked crabmeat and mushrooms. When these are heated through add the beaten eggs, grated cheese and lemon juice. Add other seasonings to taste and serve on small slices of buttered toast.

recipes.title: CRAB MEAT A LA NEWBERG
directions: Cut crab meat in pieces. Melt butter, add crab meat, and cook three minutes. Add seasonings, cream, and egg yolks slightly beaten. Cook until thickened stirring constantly. Time in combining, 10 minutes. Time in cooking, 5 minutes. Recipe makes four servings.

recipes.title: LOBSTER A LA NEWBERG
directions: Melt butter in heavy sauce pan. Add lobster, mushrooms, salt, and pepper. Cover and let simmer five minutes. Add wine and let simmer 3 minutes longer. Add cream and eggs which have been beaten together. Shake pan until it thickens, and serve at once on slices of toast. If allowed to stand it will curdle.

recipes.title: LOBSTER A LA NEWBERG
directions: Make white sauce with milk, flour and butter. Add other ingredients and cook until heated through. Serve on toast. Very nice with Chow Mein Noodles sprinkled on top. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: OYSTER PAN ROAST
directions: Parboil oysters in liquor. Drain when plump. Melt butter, add oysters, and other ingredients. When boiling serve on toast.

recipes.title: SCALLOPED OYSTERS
ingredients: Butter a Pyrex baking dish and put some butter in the bottom.
directions: Put in a good layer of oysters, salt, butter and pepper. Repeat layers, having crumbs on top, dot generously with butter, and seasoning. Add enough milk to come nearly to the top of oysters. : Bake about 3/4 hour at 350 degrees, increasing temperature a little at end.

recipes.title: SCALLOPED OYSTERS
ingredients: Butter, melted and in small pieces
directions: Use a shallow baking dish ( about 1/2 inches deep). Put a little melted butter in the bottom, and a layer of crushed (not pulverized ) crackers, then a layer of oysters. Season with salt and paprika, and pour over this cream. Add crackers, lumps of butter, oysters, and seasoning, until the dish is full. Over the last layer of crackers pour cream enough to moisten. Bake ten minutes in a very hot oven. The secret of good scalloped oysters, lies in using a shallow dish, so that the crumbs, rich with butter and cream, may be crisped with the cooking and the oysters not over cooked.

recipes.title: SHRIMPS BAKED WITH TOMATOES
directions: Put a layer of crumbs in a well buttered baking dish, add a layer of shrimps, cover with tomatoes, season with salt and pepper and sugar and dot with butter. Repeat, and cover with crumbs, dotting generously with butter and brown in a moderately hot oven, 375 degrees. A few drops of onion juice and a little minced parsley may be used. Minced celery is another variation.

recipes.title: DEVILED SHRIMP
directions: Make white sauce of first butter, milk and flour in double boiler. Add seasonings, and remove from hot water. Clean and cut shrimp. Dice eggs. Add eggs and shrimp to white sauce. Place in casserole, and cover with crumbs which have been mixed with melted butter. Bake about 25 minutes at 375 degrees, or until a nice brown. Serves 6 to 8. Salmon and Crab meat may be used the same way.

recipes.title: SHRIMP A LA CREOLE
directions: Melt butter, add flour and blend thoroughly, add milk gradually, stirring until smooth. Cook until thickened, add eggs slightly beaten, salt and pepper. Cook three minutes. Add chopped pimentos, grated onions, and canned or chopped tomatoes, shrimps, and seasonings. Re-heat. Serve in large deep clam shells. Sprinkle with paprika and finely minced parsley. Time in combining, 15 minutes. Time in cooking, 20 minutes. Recipe makes six servings.

recipes.title: SALMON TIMBLES
directions: Melt butter, add bread crumbs and milk and cook, stirring constantly until thick and smooth. Add lemon juice to salmon and mix well with a fork. Add egg slightly beaten to sauce, season with salt and pepper and remove from fire. Add fish. Fill buttered individual mold ⅔ full with the mixture and put into a pan of hot water. Cover with buttered paper and bake 30 minutes in a hot oven, 400 degrees. Remove from molds to serve.

recipes.title: CREAMED SALMON
directions: Make a white sauce. Flake salmon and add to it. Stir in beaten egg and mustard dissolved in a little water. Serve on toast.

recipes.title: SALMON LOAF
ingredients: Crumbs from 6 crackers or ½ cup bread crumbs
directions: Remove bones from salmon. Then add egg, beaten, salt and crumbs. Pour over this the milk, which has been thickened and made into white sauce. Last of all squeeze a few drops of lemon juice over it. This may be baked in an oven for 30 minutes or steamed for 1 hour.

recipes.title: RING OF SALMON
directions: Remove skin and bones from salmon and force through colander. Add bread crumbs, which should be from soft part of loaf, cream, add seasonings, and enough hot water to make moist. Mix thoroughly and fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Turn into a well buttered ring mold, and steam for 30 minutes. Remove from mold and fill center with creamed peas.

recipes.title: CREAMED TUNA FISH
directions: Flake a can of Tuna Fish. Add 1 cup diced celery, 2 hard boiled eggs, mushrooms, a dash of raw onion and a little pimento. Cover with cream sauce.

recipes.title: CALIFORNIA CHICKEN PIE
directions: Mix all together. Line a deep dish with crust, add the mixture, and cover with pie crust, which has been pierced to let steam escape. Bake 30 minutes or until crust is done at about 400 degrees.

recipes.title: BAKED TUNA FISH AND MACARONI
directions: Cook macaroni until tender. Add crumbled tuna fish, celery, white sauce and onion. Bake until brown in buttered baking dish.

recipes.title: DEVILED APPLES
directions: Core large apples. Fill centers with canned deviled ham. Put in baking dish with a little water and bake until tender.

recipes.title: NEW ENGLAND BAKED BEANS
directions: Cover beans with water and soak over night. Next morning parboil them until when you blow on some in a spoon they crack. Put half beans in bean pot, put salt pork in and rest of the beans. Add molasses and cover with boiling water. Cover pot and bake very slowly 6 hours, filling dish with water as needed. If pork seems very salt it may be parboiled with beans.

recipes.title: BAKED BEANS
ingredients: Salt pork (small piece for soup, plus 1½ lb. for beans)
directions: Soak 2 qts. navy beans overnight. Wash and drain. Cover with boiling water; at the boil add 2 large tsp. soda and boil a few minutes. Drain, add fresh water, and boil until skins curl.
If desired, reserve about 1½ cups beans for soup in some cooking water with a small piece of salt pork, seasoning, and onion. Boil soup about 2 hours, adding water as needed.

Layer bacon, onion, and beans in a large crock, burying 1½ lb. salt pork (part lean) just below the surface. Combine boiling water, mustard, catsup, molasses, oyster cocktail sauce, salt, and pepper. Pour over beans. Add reserved sauce as needed. Bake about six hours at 325°F. Serves 25.

recipes.title: BAKED KIDNEY BEANS
directions: Place all in glass baking dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar over the top. Bake about 1/2 hour at 325 degrees.

recipes.title: SOUR BEANS
directions: Boil water, sugar and vinegar until sugar is dissolved, when cold add to beans which have been cooked until tender, add onion finely chopped. Nice to serve with cold meat lunches. Serves 6. This will keep a long time.

recipes.title: LUNCHEON BEANS AND SPAGHETTI
directions: Fry bacon crisp. Remove from fat and keep hot. Peel and cut tomatoes into small pieces, and add to bacon fat. Add pepper minced, onion finely shredded, celery, salt, pepper, cloves (optional) and sugar. Simmer, stirring to prevent sticking, until a thick sauce is made. Cook beans until tender in slightly salted, boiling water. Let water cook away without draining beans. Add beans and spaghetti to tomato sauce, and bring to boiling point. Garnish with Swift's Premium Bacon strips.

recipes.title: SCALLOPED LIMA BEANS
directions: Parboil the green pepper and onion five minutes in one-half cup of water. Add beans, tomato, and seasonings. Put in a casserole and dot with butter. Cover and bake in a moderately hot oven. Time in combining, 15 minutes. Time in cooking, 40 minutes. Temperature, 375 °. Recipe makes six servings.

recipes.title: SCALLOPED LIMA BEANS
ingredients: 1 quart white sauce (8 tbsp. butter or margarine, 8 tbsp. flour and 1 quart milk)
directions: Wash beans and soak overnight in cold water. Cook until tender in boiling salted water; drain. Place half the beans in a buttered baking dish. Add a layer of sliced hard-cooked eggs, chopped pimento, onion and grated cheese. Cover with white sauce and repeat, leaving grated cheese on top. Bake in a moderate oven until brown.
Time in combining: 30 minutes. Time in cooking: 40 minutes. Temperature: 350°F. Makes 10 servings.

recipes.title: BEETS WITH SOUR SAUCE
directions: Wash beets ( 8) and cook in boiling, salted water until soft. Drain, reserving ½ cup of water in which. beets were cooked Plunge into cold water, rub off skins, and cut into cubes. Reheat in sour sauce.

recipes.title: SOUR SAUCE
directions: Melt butter and stir in flour; add reserved beet water, vinegar, cream, sugar, salt and pepper. Cook until thickened.

recipes.title: STUFFED BEETS
ingredients: Mayonnaise and pimiento strips, to garnish
directions: Select small beets and boil until tender. Cool and peel. Remove enough of center to form case. Then let them stand in a sweetened and spiced vinegar, such as you would pickle beets in. Let them stand for two hours or more. Drain and fill with chopped sardines or caviar, and hard boiled eggs, onions, and sweet gherkins. Garnish with a little mayonnaise and strips of pimento.

recipes.title: DRESSING FOR BEETS
directions: Beat all ingredients together before adding boiling water; then cook until thick.

recipes.title: CABBAGE AU GRATIN
directions: Make a white sauce with milk, butter and flour; add seasonings, cabbage and cheese. Pour into a buttered baking dish, sprinkle buttered crumbs on top and bake at 425°F until brown, about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: SCALLOPED CABBAGE
directions: Arrange cabbage and crumbs in layers in a baking dish. Make a white sauce of the remaining ingredients and pour over. Bake in a moderate oven. Time in combining, 5 minutes. Time in cooking, 20 minutes. Temperature, 350°. Recipe makes eight servings.

recipes.title: CARROTS AU GRATIN
directions: Melt butter, add green pepper and onion and cook three minutes. Add flour and blend thoroughly. Add liquid slowly and stir until thickened. Season with salt and pepper. Put carrots in a baking dish, pour sauce over them, cover with buttered crumbs, and bake until crumbs are brown. Time in cooking, 20 minutes. Temperature, 350°. Recipe makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: CARROT FRITTERS
directions: Scrape large carrots. Cook until tender. Slice about ½ inch thick. Dip in fritter batter, and fry in deep fat. Delicious with lamb chops or fish.

recipes.title: GLAZED CARROTS
directions: Parboil carrots for fifteen minutes. Drain, place in a saucepan with equal parts butter and sugar (½ cup each for 3 carrots). Cook slowly until tender. Serve with peas.

recipes.title: SCALLOPED CAULIFLOWER WITH MUSHROOMS
ingredients: ½ cup fine fresh bread crumbs
directions: Break cauliflower into flowerets and cook until tender. Drain and arrange in two greased casseroles.

Wash mushroom stems, cover with boiling water and simmer about 30 minutes or until the liquid is reduced to ½ cup. Cut mushroom caps into thin slices and cook for 5 minutes in 4 tbsp. fat, turning frequently.

To 6 tbsp. melted butter add the minced onion and cook until tender. Add flour, stirring constantly. When smooth, gradually add milk and mushroom liquor, stirring until thickened. Add salt, paprika and mushroom slices. Pour sauce over cauliflower, cover with bread crumbs and bake 30 minutes at 350°F, or until browned.

recipes.title: STUFFED CELERY
directions: celery Cream butter, add cheese, and work until thoroughly blended. Season with salt and paprika. Wash celery, cut into desired lengths, and chill. Fill inside of stalks with cheese mixture. Roquefort cheese is especially good for this purpose.

recipes.title: CORN FRITTERS
directions: Beat first four well, and add flour and baking powder. Bake like pancakes. Serve with butter and syrup or plain.

recipes.title: CORN MOCK OYSTERS
directions: Beat egg, and melt the butter. Mix dry ingredients, add corn, melted butter and milk, and beat until smooth. Add egg. Drop from spoon into hot fat in a frying pan. Brown first on one side and then on other. Serve on hot platter, or as a garnish for meat.

recipes.title: MOCK OYSTERS
directions: To the grated green corn add the egg well beaten, flour, butter, salt and pepper, and mix them well together. A tablespoonful of the batter will make the size of an oyster. Fry them a light brown, and when done, butter. Serves four.

recipes.title: GREEN CORN PUDDING
directions: (6 to 8 Servings) Cut corn from cob, selecting four firm young ears of good sized corn, with a keen beaded knife, cutting only the depth of half the kernel. Scrape off the rest. This leaves a large portion of the husk of the kernel on the cob and removes none of the cob. Melt one tbsp. butter and add 1 tsp flour, 1 cup milk and add the yolks of two eggs well beaten and added carefully to milk after it has begun to boil. Stir in the corn, 1/2 tsp. salt and the whites of the eggs beaten stiffly. Pour mixture into two deep pie plates and bake for 25 minutes in hot oven. I parboil my corn before using it.

recipes.title: SPANISH CORN PUDDING
directions: Blend all together. Pour into buttered baking dish and bake in a moderate oven, 350 degrees, for about 25 minutes. Serve as entree, or as main course for a light dinner.

recipes.title: SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients: 1 cup bread or cracker crumbs, lightly browned
Onion and sweet green pepper, chopped
directions: Heat oven to 350°F and butter a baking dish. Whisk egg into milk with salt and pepper. Layer corn, onion and green pepper with the browned crumbs, ending with crumbs. Pour egg-milk mixture evenly over. Bake 25–35 minutes, until set and lightly browned.

recipes.title: CORN AND CHEESE SOUFFLE
directions: Melt butter, stir in enough flour to make a salve. Add milk, cheese and seasonings, then beaten yolks of eggs. Strain corn, and add, stirring all the while. Beat whites and add last. Bake 30 minutes at 325 degrees, increasing at the last so that it will brown.

recipes.title: CUCUMBERS BAKED
ingredients: 4 cucumbers, 4 or 5 inches long bread crumbs
directions: Peel cucumbers, and cut in half. Take out center and stand in salt water 12 day. Peel tomatoes and slice. Fry in butter with onion, and thicken with crumbs. Season with salt and pepper and more butter. Stuff cucumbers with dressing. Place in baking dish, with a little cold water in the bottom. Bake until tender, about 15 minutes, in a hot oven about 400 degrees.

recipes.title: EGG PLANT VEGETABLE DISH
directions: Cook all together slowly for about twenty minutes or until the mixture is smooth. In a low calory diet, serve instead of potatoes or macaroni. Mrs. James E. Rork.

recipes.title: SCALLOPED EGGPLANT
directions: Pare eggplant. Cut in three-quarter-inch cubes. Cook in small quantity of boiling water until tender. Drain. Cook the onion in the fat until slightly browned. Add the chopped parsley and eggplant. Turn in buttered baking dish. Cover with buttered crumbs. Time for combining, 3 minutes. Time in cooking, 20-30 minutes. Temperature, 212-250°. Recipe makes six servings.

recipes.title: WILTED LETTUCE
directions: Shred lettuce. Fry bacon in small pieces. Pour over lettuce, add a little vinegar. Hard boiled eggs diced. Pepper and salt.

recipes.title: MUSHROOM WOODCHUCK
directions: Grind mushrooms, pimentos, green pepper, hard-boiled eggs and cream cheese; add to butter, flour and milk mixture. Serve in pastry shells or on toast. Serves eight.

recipes.title: PARSNIP PATTIES
directions: Parsnips

Boil parsnips. Cut in two, put into cold water to remove skins, and mash. Season with salt, pepper and melted butter. Flour hands slightly, and make mixture into small cakes. Dip the cakes in flour. Saute in hot fat until nicely browned. Time in combining, 5 minutes. Temperature, 350°.

recipes.title: SCALLOPED PARSNIPS
ingredients: Milk, enough to reach near the top
directions: Boil parsnips until fork-tender, then drain and slice. Butter a baking dish. Layer parsnips, salt and pepper, grated cheese and cracker crumbs; repeat until about 1 inch below the rim. Dot with butter and add milk to almost cover. Bake at 400°F for about 20 minutes, or until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: PEPPERS WITH FISH STUFFING
directions: Cut off tops of green peppers and cut in two lengthwise. Remove inner fibers and seeds. Drop into boiling water for 5 minutes. Remove and drain. Mix fish with crumbs and seasonings. Moisten with a little milk or cream. Fill pepper with mixture. Sprinkle grated cheese over top. Cover with buttered crumbs and bake in a moderate oven, 350 degrees until brown.

recipes.title: POTATO PUFF
directions: Beat to a cream and add 2 beaten eggs, and 1 cup flour Salt to taste. Bake 15 minutes at 400 degrees.

recipes.title: STUFFED BAKED POTATOES
directions: finely minced Wash potatoes well, and remove centers, the long way of potatoes. An apple corer may be used, not cutting through the potato. Combine bacon and veal with crumbs, and mix thoroughly. Add onion juice and egg, unbeaten. Mix well, and fill potatoes with mixture. Place on end in a dripping pan, and bake 1 hour in a hot oven. The cut end of the potato should be up. Serve like ordinary baked potatoes. Bake at about 400 degrees.

recipes.title: POTATO CHOWDER
ingredients: ½ lb. Swift's Premium bacon, cut in squares
directions: Fry bacon in kettle until brown and crisp. Add sliced onions, and cook until brown. Then add cubed potatoes and boiling water: Cover and cook until potatoes are tender, adding more water if necessary.

recipes.title: SPANISH POTATO
directions: Peel and boil enough potatoes for meal for 10 minutes. Drain, and, while hot, chop and mix 2 medium sized onions and 3 green peppers which have been run through the grinder. Fry all together until a light brown. Put in baking dish and mix with a cream sauce made of 1 cup milk, 1 tbsp. butter, 1 tbsp. flour and 1/2 cup cheese. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs, and bake until potatoes are tender and dish is well browned.

recipes.title: FANCY BAKED POTATO
directions: Select medium sized potatoes. Make a hole in each one lengthwise with an apple corer. Put a slice of bacon in the hole. Bake until potato is done. Sausages or frankfurters may be substituted for bacon. Sweet potatoes may be used.

recipes.title: POTATOES, EGG TIMBALES
ingredients: 2 level tbsp. butter, or other fat
directions: Time: Preparation and cooking, 30 minutes. Number served: 4 persons. Season the potatoes, sprinkle with flour, add milk, mix lightly. Put the butter into a saucepan; when melted and hot (not brown) put in the potatoes; pack down lightly, cook until deep brown on bottom; fold over as you would an omelet, cook five minutes longer, turn out carefully on a hot platter. While potatoes are browning prepare eggs. Grease small molds or cups, cover inside with parsley and ham; break an egg into each. Stand in a pan half full of water; cook slowly-on top of stove, or in oven-until eggs are set. Turn out on potatoes.

recipes.title: GLACÉ SWEET POTATOES
directions: Pare potatoes and cut in slices 1/4 inch thick. Parboil 10 minutes. Make a syrup of the sugar, water and butter. Put potatoes in a buttered baking dish, and pour over half the syrup. Sprinkle with nutmeg and bake in a hot oven, 375 to 400 degrees, until a pale straw color. Baste with remaining syrup.

recipes.title: SWEET POTATOES
ingredients: Salt and other seasoning, to taste
directions: Mash boiled sweet potatoes, adding hot water, seasoning and butter. Put in a buttered Pyrex dish with a few marshmallows on top and brown in oven.

recipes.title: SWEET POTATOES EN SURPRISE
directions: Bake or boil the potatoes, remove skins and mash thoroughly. Add butter, milk, and seasonings. Fill flat remekins with potato mixture, bury two pieces of cooked sausage in each. Brush tops with melted drippings. Heat through and brown in hot oven. Time in combining, 15 minutes. Time in cooking, 30 and 15 minutes. Temperature, 350°. Makes six servings.

recipes.title: SWEET POTATOES WITH HAM
directions: Have the ham cut in a slice about two inches thick, put into cold water and let it scald. Pare and slice the sweet potatoes. Cut ham into pieces for serving, but fit into a bottom of baking-dish as one slice, put in potatoes, sprinkle sugar over them, and pour hot water over all. Bake in a moderate oven, basting often with the syrup in dish.

recipes.title: SWEET POTATOES AND SAUSAGES
directions: Parboil sweet potatoes, remove skins, cut in halves. Place pieces of sweet potato in a shallow casserole, place partially cooked sausage on top. Finish cooking in a hot oven or under broiler. Time in combining, 15 minutes. Time in cooking, 10 and 20 minutes. Temperature, 375 degrees. Recipe makes six servings.

recipes.title: STUFFED SWEET POTATO
directions: Wash and bake sweet potatoes. When soft cut in two, take out the potato and mix with the cooked sausage meat and any fat extracted during cooking and the well-beaten egg. Refill potato shells, sprinkle with crumbs, put in oven to reheat and brown.

recipes.title: STUFFED ONIONS
directions: Peel onions and cook in boiling salted water for 45 minutes. Cool, cut a slice from the top of each and scoop out the centers, leaving a shell about ¾ inch thick. Combine nutmeats, bread crumbs, butter, salt, pepper and parsley; fill onion shells. Put in a buttered baking dish, add 1 cup boiling water and bake 20 minutes. Baste with 1 tbsp. butter melted in a little hot water.

For the sauce, melt 2 tbsp. butter, stir in flour and cook, stirring constantly until blended and bubbly. Slowly add milk and bring to a boil. Stir in cheese until melted; remove from heat and beat in egg yolk. Do not boil after cheese and yolk are added. Serve stuffed onions surrounded by sauce.

recipes.title: BAKED ONIONS
directions: Mix and put in buttered baking dish and bake 1 hour.

recipes.title: BAKED ONIONS
ingredients: Medium onions, all about the same size, skins on
directions: Select onions the same size. Leave all dry skin on without cutting. Bake in a dripping pan until tender. Then squeeze at the root end, and a juicy onion will slip out from the outer skin all ready to garnish platter around the roast.

recipes.title: ONION SOUFFLE
directions: Cream Sauce: 1 tbsp. butter 1 tbsp. flour 1 cup milk Make cream sauce with butter, flour, and milk. Chop onions rather fine. Add parsley and combine with sauce. Stir in beaten egg yolks, and last of all beaten whites. Pile lightly in buttered baking dish. Sprinkle top with crumbs. Bake in moderate oven until set. Time in combining, 5 minutes. Time in cooking, 20 minutes. Temperature, 212-300 °.

recipes.title: SPINACH LUNCHEON DISH
directions: Make a white sauce of the milk, butter, flour and seasonings. Add 2 egg yolks when cooked. To this add the spinach chopped very fine. Then add two beaten egg whites. Put in large Pyrex baking dish, making four dents for eggs. Bake in moderate oven for about 25 minutes, then break eggs on the top and sprinkle with grated cheese. Return to oven for about seven minutes. Serve immediately from baking dish.

recipes.title: MUSTARD SAUCE FOR SPINACH
directions: Heat vinegar and sugar. Add beaten egg, mustard. Cook until thick.

recipes.title: BAKED SQUASH WITH SAUSAGE
ingredients: Salt, pepper and butter, to season
directions: Cut squash in half and remove seeds. Place sausage in squash and bake until squash is done. Remove squash from shell and mash, add salt, pepper and butter. Arrange squash on platter and place sausage around and on top of squash. Link sausage is desired but the bulk can be used.

recipes.title: HUBBARD SQUASH IN CASSEROLE
ingredients: Butter casserole. Slice into it a layer of squash, small pieces.
directions: Sprinkle with brown sugar, a little butter and salt. Add another layer and season as before. Pour over all about 1/2 cup boiling water. Bake 1 hour in slow oven, 325 degrees, basting with hot liquor or boiling water, if it becomes dry. Cover first half of cooking time.

recipes.title: BAKED SUMMER SQUASH
directions: Melt butter and cook chopped onion gently until yellow. Transfer to a casserole. Add corn cut from the cob, chopped tomatoes and summer squash cut into small pieces. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and bake 30 minutes at 350°F.

recipes.title: BAKED SAUER KRAUT
directions: Add sugar to kraut, and place in casserole. Place chops and butter on top. Cover and bake about 1 hour at 375 degrees.

recipes.title: TOMATO AND CABBAGE MULLIGAN
directions: Melt butter, add minced onion and peppers. Cook until a delicate brown. Shred or chop cabbage very fine. Stir into onion mixture and brown. Turn into greased baking dish, pour over the well seasoned tomatoes, cover with buttered crumbs and bake in moderate oven until cabbage is tender. Bake 45 minutes at 350 degrees. Serves 8.

recipes.title: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
directions: Arrange in 6 layers in greased baking dish, sprinkling each layer with chopped green pepper. Dot top with butter. Bake 30 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: VEGETABLE DISH FOR OVEN MEAL
ingredients: Water or stock, as needed to moisten rice
directions: Fill a baking dish with layers of tomatoes, fresh or canned, onions, greenpeppers, season, sprinkle with raw rice, bits of butter, and repeat layers. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs and bake about an hour and a half. Potatoes, and biscuits may be baked at the same time, and the broiler used for chops or steak. Mrs. K. S. Russell.

recipes.title: VEGETABLE HASH
directions: Grind the vegetables and mix well with the hamburg, and add one rusk crushed fine. Put in casserole, and cover with the other rusk, crushed fine. Cover with milk and bake 2 hours in a slow oven, 300 degrees. Serves 6.

recipes.title: CREAM OF MUSHROOM SOUP
directions: Prepare 1 quart of thin white sauce (about 2 tbsp. butter, 2 tbsp. flour and 4 cups milk, cooked until lightly thickened). Drain and chop mushrooms, reserving a little of their liquid if desired. Stir mushrooms into the white sauce, simmer gently 5–10 minutes and season with salt and pepper. Thin with milk or mushroom liquid to serving consistency.

recipes.title: CREAM OF ONION SOUP
directions: Melt butter and fat in pan without letting the fats bubble, add onion slices and cook over a low fire 30 minutes. Keep the pan closely covered, letting the onions cook in their own juice and steam. When the onions are soft add flour and stir with a fork until thoroughly blended. Add milk, salt and pepper and bring to the boiling point, stirring constantly. Let boil 5 minutes, and rub through a strainer. Add egg slightly beaten and reheat over hot water if necessary. Whip cream and serve a spoonful sprinkled with parsley on each portion.

recipes.title: CREAM LIQUID LIFE SOUP
directions: Add milk to Liquid Life and season with butter, celery and parsley leaves. Heat 15 minutes, but do not boil. Just before serving add 1/3 tin Whole Grain Wheat.

recipes.title: CHICKEN SOUP
directions: Add celery, onion, and bay leaves to stock, and cook for about an hour. Then add rice and cook about half an hour longer. This makes a thick and tasty soup.

recipes.title: Providence Muffins
directions: Mix flour, bran, salt, sugar, and baking powder. Melt butter and peanut butter together, then add to dry mixture. Add the well-beaten egg, followed by milk; beat well. Bake in hot greased muffin tins at 375°F for 12 minutes. Makes six good-sized muffins.

recipes.title: Mahogany Cake
directions: Cook the first ½ cup milk with cocoa until thick and smooth; cool. Cream butter and sugar, then add beaten egg yolks. Sift together flour, baking soda, and baking powder, and add alternately with milk. Add cooled chocolate mixture and vanilla. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake in two greased nine-inch layer pans at 350°F for about 30 minutes. Spread Fudge Frosting between layers and over the cake.

recipes.title: Fudge Frosting
directions: Cook sugar, chocolate, corn syrup, and milk, stirring until sugar dissolves. Stir occasionally to prevent burning. Cook to 232°F or to the very-soft-ball stage. Remove from heat and add baking powder and butter. Cool to lukewarm, add vanilla, and beat until creamy and spreadable.

recipes.title: SWIFT'S PREMIUM HAM SMOTHERED IN MUSHROOMS
ingredients: 1 slice Swift’s Premium Savor-tite ham, about ½ inch thick
directions: Brown one side of ham in butter. Turn so the browned side faces up. Cover with mushrooms, cover the pan and simmer about 15 minutes, or until mushrooms are tender. Serve on a platter with sliced pineapple. If using canned mushrooms, reserve their liquid for gravy.
